row.name: CivIdle
row.detailed_description: Empire Must Grow Expand your empire's territory, production and influence, advance your population's science and culture, and make your people happy - the empire must grow, and numbers must go up! Every Run is Different Explore a procedurally generated map, scouting for resources and natural wonders. Expand your empire and take advantage of different terrains. As technology advances, you can even reshape the terrain. A Vast Tech Tree Research and unlock a vast tech tree with 100+ technologies: from hunting and gathering, through writing and math, all the way to virtual reality and artificial intelligence. As technology advances, you will unlock more game systems and mechanisms that greatly expand the game play. Trade and Diplomacy Trade resources and engage in diplomacy with other players via a global market. Exchanging resources, forming alliances and fighting for influence - can your culture stand in the end? Wonder-full Empire Throughout different eras, construct different world wonders that provide unique bonuses, unlock new game mechanism and make your map look pretty. Reborn with Great People When you prestige, you will be able to collect great people - historical great figures, each with unique bonuses and abilities that will help your next run reach new height. 90s Retro UI A 90's retro UI, that is a love letter to the golden age of desktop computing, will surely bring back some nostalgia. There's a 1-1 replicated mode which brings maximum authenticity and a 'eye protection mode' that captures the essence but is easier on your eye on modern displays. A Game For the People If your computer can run paint, you can probably run CivIdle. Similar to Industry Idle, the game will NOT include any micro transactions. Instead, the base game will be free of charge and you can optionally get more content, support the game's development and help cover the server expense by purchasing paid expansion packs.
row.short_description: CivIdle is an idle/incremental game that allows you to lead your own civilization through thousands of years from ancient times to the modern era. Expand your territory, explore a vast tech tree, build various wonders, and trade with global players: empire must grow and numbers must go up!

row.name: Ranger Danger
row.detailed_description: As a park ranger at Mountain View National Park, your job can be pretty mundane -- except for tonight. Something is lurking among the trees and bushes, and now a camper has disappeared. People have reported strange noises, loud stomping, and odd track prints, but no one has spotted any large animals in the area. Is it just another bear, or something.... worse? Play as the park ranger to discover the true reason why campers have been going missing in this first-person, stealth-based horror game. Use your evasiveness skills and tools around you to explore the park for signs of what may have happened to the missing camper. Your flashlight battery is limited so remember to conserve power!
row.short_description: A park ranger's life is changed forever as they discover what really lurks in their national park. A first-person horror, exploration, and stealth-based game.

row.name: Fallen Arena
row.detailed_description: Background: In 2100, the temperatures have risen by 4 ℃, and as a result, a doomsday disaster formed on the earth. So the survivors were on the road to self-redemption. One day, in a meteorite crater, the survivors found many Mayan monuments and crystals with mysterious power. Afterward, the battle for the crystal began… Main Gameplay: Kill your opponent in the arena, and grab the dropped crystals to gain points. Players with the highest points will win the game. The more points players get, the bigger they will become, and the attack range will become bigger. However, be careful, the movement speed will also decrease at the same time… Map Mechanics: The competitive map is full of crises, highly toxic contaminated liquid, hidden grass, weak and slow poisonous fog, and inaccessible tornadoes, making the battle more tense and exciting. Game Mode: '1P' is the individual battle mode for a single player; '3P' is the team battle mode for 3 players. There is also a custom open room mode to invite friends to play against each other. Heroic Characters: Many heroes with different skills make the battle process more strategic and interesting. Special Weapons: Distinctive weapons with different appearances make you the shining star on the battlefield.
row.short_description: This is a leisure competitive game, fighting for crystals in the arena, getting bigger, defeating opponents. New heroes, new skills and new weapons, call your friends to fight together~

It's up to you to either play fast, and strike your opponent when their Shikigami have not yet been fully developed, or steadily level up your Shikigami, and accumulate combo to launch one fatal attack. row.name: Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes (GOLD Edition)
row.detailed_description: Kingdom Under Fire : War of Heros Gold Edition Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heores is the world's first Online multiplayer game to utilize Locus Chain Blockchain technology to achieve serverless online gaming experience. We're thrilled to announce a brand-new player dashboard feature (User Game Record System) that's now available for all players of Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes, a serverless online multiplayer game. We're about to dive into the world of detailed match data, and it's all thanks to the groundbreaking technology of the Locus Chain blockchain, the rock-solid foundation of KUF: A War of Heroes. With this innovative feature, you're not just playing; you're witnessing the evolution of your gaming prowess. Dive into the numbers, and you'll find everything from your win rate and unit score to your building score and total playtime. Each match's distinctive characteristics are securely recorded on the Locus Chain blockchain. It's like having a treasure trove of your past battles right at your fingertips! What sets this apart is the way we're presenting your achievements. Every game result now leaves a footprint on the blockchain, carrying all the crucial metadata you could ever desire. Our blockchain-based leaderboard offers a tamper-proof view of your journey up the gaming ranks. It's the ultimate proof of your progression along the steep learning curve of Kingdom Under Fire: A War of Heroes. We firmly believe that introducing this blockchain-powered leaderboard is a crucial leap forward for esports, where individual player stats are the key to entering the realm of high-stakes battles. The application of blockchain to KUF involves implementing the blockchain as a distributed database, with no manipulation of NFTs or digital assets, including cryptocurrency. Kingdom Under Fire is a real-time strategy game created for the loyal fans of the original Diablo and Starcraft games. The current version is in Early Access with solid plans to release the full game with enhanced graphics preserving the spirit of the original KUF! In Bersia, the land of Helimo’s blessing, the god of light, there were many species living together, including a large number of humans, elves, dwarves, orcs, and ogre monsters, vampires, and lycanthropes. The humans of Bersia flourished, forming a state, serving the gods, and fighting monsters. The harmony of Bersia, which had been maintained according to its own laws throughout its long history, was broken by the war waged by Khilliani, a black wizard who learned to command monsters and dark forces with powerful magic. The dark forces systematically and meticulously invaded human territory, turning even the largest and most powerful of the countries that humans founded into ruins…Now it’s your turn to fight evil! Features: –Intense RTS action: build structures, manage resources, conquer your enemies! –Two factions to choose from: orcs and humans. –The game blends RPG and RTS elements. –Isometric perspective, high fantasy setting. –Looks and feels like Starcraft (the graphics will be overhauled in the full version) –Two modes: single player and multiplayer. –Play and explore 13 missions in single player mode, following along the story and fighting the AI. –Up to 8 players can play the game in multiplayer mode –Upgrade buildings, weapons, and armors to defeat the monsters. Alone or with friends!
row.short_description: - World first to achieve a successful serverless online gaming feature by utilizing Locus Chain Blockchain technology - RPG game mode with multi-play capability - Unique RTS/RPG Hybrid

row.name: South Pole Bebop
row.detailed_description: Features in-game purchases About the Game A turn-based multiplayer strategy game inspired by Into The Breach. Take down your opponent’s bases or characters to win. Strategize, position your squad, and battle both rivals and zombies. Customize your deck to boost your bases and characters. Pick 3 unique heroes, each with special abilities, and show off your strategic skills! Synopsis A tranquil village in the South Pole has been overrun by mysterious invaders. row.name: Of Moons and Mania
row.detailed_description: Of Moons and Mania is my account of experiencing a psychotic break, in game form. Inhabit my mind as I lose my grasp on reason. Attempt to piece together cogent responses to questions from doctors, friends, and family as psychosis takes over, and ultimately try to get back to stability. Key Features Inhabit the developer's mind and build your own responses to dialogue. Experience an Autobiographical story detailing the experience of a psychotic break. An hour of gameplay. Developer Statement I started making this game several years after being hospitalized for a manic episode. I was fixated on the experience for the whole time. Trying to piece together what was real and what was dreamt, trying to even remember the sequence of events in chronological order, and every so often when I thought I had shaken the grip of obsessing about the hospitalization, I would have flashbacks that opened up my freshly healed wounds. As a game developer, I was fascinated by some of the systems of thought that were going on in my head, and that gave me the idea for this game. I designed game mechanics and systems to tell the story of my psychosis in a different way than I have seen it expressed before. Making the game really helped me with my flashbacks and organized the way I thought about my illness, and the experience of my hospitalization. I hope that it gives other people some insight into my brain and also into the nature of psychosis and manic depression.
row.short_description: Of Moons and Mania is an interactive psychotic break, based on lived experience. It uses elements of its design to explain the struggles of psychosis, and tells a personal story about mental illness.
row.notes: Discusses a mental health crisis. Depicts a psychiatric hospital.

row.name: Football Club Management 2023
row.detailed_description: Football Club Management 23, is a football club management game written and developed by real football coaches and managers to give players a realistic day-to-day club management experience, that's full of depth yet quick to play. This is the only game available that allows you to become a director of a football club or for you to take over and manage a club as the chairman. Start your career as a Director of Football, either by creating your own club from scratch or by taking on a role at a real football club. Manage all aspects of the club from finances, sponsorships, staff, and player recruitment as you set out your philosophy and vision for the club and look to deliver success to the board and fans. Improve your reputation and move to bigger and better jobs as you earn reputation and build coins to one day being able to mount a takeover and own your very own club and become the chairman! No other game gives you a full club management experience and real day-to-day challenges that Football Club Management 2023 delivers, all with super quick gameplay and TV-style presentation. Can you manage difficult managers, and deal with the demanding sports media? Can you build a title-winning squad, and keep the harmony in the group whilst dealing with high-paid demanding players? Can you build success off the pitch and generate revenues and profits to develop the club? Do you have what it takes to deliver success? Be more than just a manager in Football Club Management 23 From the Makers of the successful Club Soccer Director Game! CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF FOOTBALL CLUBS Choose from 820 Football clubs in 38 leagues from 14 different countries across the world. Create your legacy and build your own team from scratch including home country, club, stadium name, and kit design and take them to the top! UNRIVALLED CLUB-LEVEL FOOTBALL MANAGEMENT Manage every aspect of your Football club’s development and how you invest funds. Develop & upgrade your club's facilities, inc the stadium, fitness centre, medical, training ground, & youth Academy. Increase revenues by negotiating sponsorships. Hire & fire your management team and build your dream squad by negotiating transfers & offers with player agents as well as handling contract negotiations with players and staff alike. EVERY DECISION COUNTS Just like in real life, your decisions affect the attitude of the board, team morale, & even the fans. How you engage with press and media, ticket prices, the quality of your squad & the potential of your Academy prospects all have a bearing. LIFELIKE STATS ENGINE Comprehensive live-action stats engine mirrors real-life player behaviour and match outcomes, processing over 1000 decisions per game & generates real-time statistics for both individual players and teams. DEVELOP THE CLUB Create your own area for the club & develop your stadium, training ground, academy, facilities, fitness centre & medical facilities. MATCH HIGHLIGHTS FCM23 shows key match highlights during the game so you can see those key goals and misses! TACTICAL FREEDOM Leave key decisions to the Football manager or overrule him by implementing your own play style and deciding on team line-up, formation, in and out-of-possession tactics, substitutes and more. COMPREHENSIVE PLAYER DATABASE Buy or loan players from a database of over 30,000 players, each with their own unique play styles, stats, personalities and behaviours. FCM23 continuously generates new players on a regular basis, ensuring you have plenty of talent to choose from whether you’ve been in the hot seat for 1 season or 10! Player cycles continue beyond the pitch as some retiring players go into staff roles just as they do in real life! FULL EDITOR FCM23 has a Full in-game editor that allows you to edit Football team names, ground, kits, players avatars, staff avatars and share them with other players
row.short_description: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own club, in Football Club Manager 2023 a fast-paced Football Club Management Game. Download Football Club Manager 2023 now for FREE & start your Football management journey.

row.name: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead

When Ina enlists Abe to help with her investigation, they become ensnared in a web of conspiracy and horror that pulls them into the deepest depths of the ocean. row.name: Blackout Football Manager
row.detailed_description: Build your dream football team from the ground up and manage their way to fame and glory with one of the most robust sports management sim systems available, designed from the ground up by passionate sports fans, the same team behind Blackout Rugby. Blackout Football Manager puts you in charge of your team’s most critical functions, from deciding the best training regimes to installing the perfect club facilities and even managing your team’s finances – but only the fun parts. Your club’s board handles the mundane things like actually keeping track of money so you can just make and spend it. Blackout Football Manager features a card system that helps you organize your day and rewards you with boosts for certain actions. Whether you prioritize training or strategizing for an upcoming match is up to you, but every action has consequences on how your team performs. Think carefully before deciding who to bench and how best to build your club. Every potential team member has a unique set of mental and physical traits that distinguishes their performance on the field and helps inform your match-day plans. Scout the opposition and create a strategy that plays to your team’s unique strengths,and if you have a gap that needs filling, head to the in-game market or scout the competition to sign some new talent with Blackout Football Manager’s streamlined negotiation system. Key Features: ● Deep, yet easy to learn team and club management ● Unique player attributes to help build strong and varied teams ● Customizable lineups and team formations! ● Extensive tech trees for customizing your club and infrastructure ● Robust in-game market for easy player trading ● Streamlined money and contract managing ● A innovative, unique card system, allowing you to prioritize performance! ● Deep and highly customizable training regimes. ● Extensive customizable tactics, allowing you to show off your football knowledge. ● And much more!
row.short_description: Take your place as head coach and club manager in this Online Multiplayer Football Manager game. Your knowledge will be tested as you take your club to new heights and square up against other real users world-wide. Do you have what it takes to be the greatest Football Manager?

row.name: Vitamins
row.detailed_description: Vitamins is a free control parameter scripting software that targets Live2d. It can connect to supported applications for IOS and Android as wifi or usb. Calibrate and Calculates capture data into control parameters via user-created scripts and sends them to VTube Studio. In Vitamins script editor, short expressions or complex functions can be writen to customize parameters. With this feature, Live2d models can be endowed with powerful logic, more interactive animations, and more accurate capture experience. Vitamins' pre-processing design allows riggers, actors, and parameter script developers to work independently in their own workflows. This makes Vitamins better suited for personal or small studio use. If you are looking for more accurate capture performance or want to power a Live2d model with programming , try Vitamins!
row.short_description: Vitamins is a free control parameter scripting software that targets Live2d. It can help drive Live2d model in a accurate and creative way.

row.name: Ninza
row.detailed_description: The level is both your weapon AND your enemy! Every single part of the level can be pushed around by your attacks. Anticipate your opponents movements to squash them between blocks or to throw them out of the screen. Intuitive, intense, and delightfully brutal! Up to 4 players, local and online, solo training modes Online, you can fight against random opponents or host your own casual games to play with your friends. Enjoy a smooth brawling experience thanks to rollback technology (lag compensation system). If you'd rather fancy a delightful evening of friendship ruining chaos, just gather up to 4 players to fight on the same screen. Pick your character, master their powers Choose between a diverse cast of vibrant and original characters, who each got their own moveset and abilities. Learn to master their strengths and weakenesses to shine on the battlefield! Enter the competitive scene and become a legend Participate in the competitive scene through ranked matchs. Level up your ranks and grind your way to the top of our leaderboards! Every new season is filled with unique rewards and a new playable character. Easy to play, fun to master Ninza is easy to play, but don't be fooled, there's a lot of spectacular and creative moves you can pull out if you're up to the task. The game offers plenty of options to help you improve in solo mode and to become a pro in no time: videos, tutorials, practice mode, or even trials. Your journey to the top is already laid out! A big collection of unlockable cosmetics Take on the challenges of the Mo0n to unlock more than 200 unique cosmetics to show off your style and skill. Choose from a wide selection of wacky in-game taunts and express yourself with a profile customisation system that offers a ton of possibilities. A Free to play game but with a no bullshit strict policy No pay-to-win. DLCs are cheap and limited to new characters and access to some very specific cosmetics only. Basically, it's a no to annoying and intrusive microtransactions because, we all hate that. The Mo0n. Floating up in the sky, observing every one of your moves, and offering highly judgmental commentary on them. Also, it's essential to know that the Mo0n is everything.
row.short_description: Ninza is a free multiplayer game like no other! Instead of directly attacking your opponents, you crush them by pushing pieces of the level. Embrace chaos and dive into an entirely new level of frenzied and creative gameplay, where the environment itself becomes both your weapon and your enemy.
row.reviews: “Even in its current Beta form it’s already in the one of the most entertaining competitive multiplayer party games around and it’s only going to get better. Highly recommended.” Alpha beta gamer

row.name: Blindsight: War of the Wardens
row.detailed_description: JOIN THE BLINDSIGHT: WAR OF THE WARDENS DISCORD About the Game Blindsight: War of the Wardens is a story-driven brawler where you play as Iggy Yin, a martial arts master with echolocation abilities, as he retrieves a stolen family heirloom that may bring unintended consequences to the universe. Throw punches and swing kicks at hordes of enemies, chaining them together to unleash epic combos! With the power of your amulet, nothing can stand in your way. String together attacks, counters, dodges, and finishers with the beat-em up combat system Harness your amulet to sense surrounding environments, heal between fights, and blind enemies with explosions of light Face bosses on their own turf in your journey to recover the relic In a world balanced by 5 powerful relics, there are great mysteries around every corner. On your journey to reclaim Iggy's family relic, you will travel from shrines to cities, down racing rivers, and even through portals! Explore 3 distinctly themed areas, inspired by the likes of 80s kung-fu movies and EDM venues Bash your way through gangs of enemies as you make your way towards boss fights Use your sense of sound to 'see' your way through each level Play as Iggy, a blind martial artist who is on a quest to recover a stolen family relic. He was born into a family of wardens who protect the Relic of Life, one of five mystical relics scattered across the world. But because of his blindness, his mom wouldn't let him be a warden. When his dad goes missing and the Relic of Life is stolen by another warden family, Iggy finally gets the chance to prove himself--and find out what happened to his dad in the process.

row.name: Mech vs. Bugs
row.detailed_description: In Mech vs Bugs, your role as a solo mech pilot will see you defending against relentless alien invasions on remote planets. This game is an exciting merge of top-down, third-person action reminiscent of titles like Vampire Survivors and Brotato. Brimming with intense battles, strategic loot collection, and in-depth crafting, you'll continuously improve your mech to combat waves of insectoid foes. With each planet you liberate, the stakes increase in this thrilling journey from one alien world to the next. Mech vs Bugs places you at the helm of an advanced mechanized unit, the last line of defense against an alien invasion. As a solo pilot, you will traverse various planets, combating swarms of insectoid enemies in adrenaline-fueled, close-quarter combat scenarios. The game's third-person top-down perspective puts you right in the center of the action. Insectoid enemies will relentlessly rush you in melee waves, each one tougher than the last. With your piloting skills and strategic mindset, you'll maneuver your mech, hold your ground, and collect precious loot from your defeated enemies. Beyond the battlefield, engage with the game's comprehensive market and crafting systems. Use your loot to trade on the market, negotiate for valuable goods, and purchase upgrades for your mech. Craft advanced weapons and shields from your resources, reinforcing your mech to face the next wave of alien onslaught. As you liberate each planet from the insectoid menace, the challenges grow fiercer, the alien hordes more intense. Adapt and thrive or fall under the alien wave. Your mech stands as the only barrier between these invaders and total galactic domination. Key Features Frenzied Solo Mech Combat: Hold back hordes of melee-rushing insectoid aliens with your high-tech mech. Experience the thrill of top-down bullet heaven gameplay. Strategic Looting and Trading: Gather valuable loot from defeated enemies. Trade at the market, and utilize your resources to bolster your mech's defenses. In-depth Crafting System: Combine your loot and purchased goods to craft potent mech upgrades, enhancing your combat performance against the ever-escalating alien threat. Dynamic Progression: Every liberated planet increases the intensity of your battles, pushing your skills and strategy to the limit. Immersive Visuals: Delve into stunning, Unreal Engine-powered alien landscapes that set the stage for your epic defense of the galaxy. In Mech vs Bugs, fast-paced mech combat, tactical gameplay, and a deep progression system combine to create an electrifying gaming experience. Can you withstand the insectoid onslaught and save the galaxy?
row.short_description: In Mech vs Bugs, you'll pilot a mech to fend off alien insects on remote planets. Combining intense top-down combat with strategic looting and crafting, your goal is to liberate the galaxy, one insect-infested planet at a time. Ready for your thrilling, third-person adventure?

row.name: AMBER Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Play AMBER - the next generation of free-to-play Battle Royale. Jump from a plane to Misfit Island and land with a Jetpack. Collect weapons and destroy enemies in three PvP modes: Battle Royale, Elimination, Deathmatch. Collect first aid kits, shield, and fuel. Up to 200 players in one match! Battle Royale: Take on the next generation of Battle Royale with a drop by plane to an island! Land with the Jetpack and use it during battle to fly across the map. Avoid the zone, which constantly shrinks, building up tension during the game. Collect all the weapons, stock up on ammo and shields. Kill all enemies and score a royal victory Elimination: It's the same as in Battle Royale but this time you don't have to drop from the plane, instead you spawn on the map with 4 lives and your task is to survive and kill all the players. You and your enemies will be brought closer together by a constantly shrinking area. The bravest and toughest player will win Deathmatch: traditional combat mode where you fight against all other players. To win you need to accumulate 25 kills, Use a variety of weapons, grenades, and Jetpack to find your style of play and defeat all enemies. Features - Up to 200 players in one match - Modern multiplayer servers with lag compensation - Fly across the map with Jetpack - A variety of weapons, from pistols to assault and sniper rifles - A fantasy world where modernity and antiquity meet

row.name: Exhibitors
row.detailed_description: Deep within the clouds of a gas giant, supermassive creatures occupy the sky, each exhibiting an ecosystem. Exhibitors is a Factory building game with elements of farming and exploration. Exploring deep within a gas giant, you did not expect to find life beneath the clouds. Upon closer inspection super massive floating creatures called exhibitors can be observed, each holding an ecosystem upon their backs. These ecosystems range widely depending upon the exhibitors' size, material composition and temperature. You decide to explore each of these biomes, learning about the ecosystem and the organisms that inhabit them. As you learn more about them, you decide to begin ranching and farming. Eventually you begin to increase production and efficiency as you continue to research the organisms. This increased production slowly harms the parent creature and its ecosystem. Good thing you can always jump between newer and bigger ecosystems as you find them. Features: Explore the different worlds. Each biome has over 10+ plants and animals for you to observe. Each biome/ecosystem is unique in their own way where the plants and animals within them have evolved in their into their own biological niches. Learn about these organisms and understand their behaviors by observing and researching them. Be a part of the world. As you run around and observe these organisms, you stop to take notes and create quick sketches of these plants and animals. The further you observe the organisms, the more detailed these drawings become. The more you get to know these plants and animals, the more you learn about how to utilize them. Make the exhibitor your own Work towards terraforming and controlling the exhibitors. Start with small outposts and slowly move towards megafactories. As you learn and discover new exotic recipes, the production possibilities increase. But be careful, each exhibitor only has a finite amount of resources and a delicate ecosystem. When an ecosystem falls out of balance, the exhibitor may begin to sink into the depths of the planet. Venture deep into the planet. When you venture deeper into the planet, the sizes of the exhibitors increase by the magnitudes. The larger these ecosystems become, the more biodiversity there is. These larger ecosystems provide the energy needed for larger and more niche species to thrive. Possibly increasing the production possibility and unlocking more exotic recipes. Make the planet your own Once you reach a certain level, everything becomes possible. These exhibitors become your world, allowing you to control where they move and how they behave. Create meta-structures to control the temperature, humidity, air composition and more. Eventually you may even be able to create your own exhibitors.
row.short_description: Deep within the clouds of a gas giant, supermassive creatures occupy the sky, each exhibiting an ecosystem. Exhibitors is a Factory building game with elements of farming and exploration.

row.name: VED: Purification
row.detailed_description: VED is a story-driven RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and rogue-lite elements. Embark on a magical adventure set in a vivid world in stunning, hand-painted graphics. Explore mysterious islands, defeat monsters, and master the magic of the Veds!  The free version 'Purification' serves as a prologue to the main game so you can sample its combat system, narrative style and teleportation between the magical and human worlds, but not spoil the full story for yourself!  Its events are set 30 years prior to the narrative of VED, following a different character, a Vedic warrior by the name of Dook, who fell in love with a magical being. But as the Vedic order is sworn to keep the magical and the mundane worlds separate, eliminating any semblance of magic from the human world, theirs is certainly a complicated love story; and it’s up to you to decide how it will end…
row.short_description: VED is a story-driven RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and rogue-lite elements. row.name: ALLON3
row.detailed_description: Awakening in a dark, seemingly abandoned city, the sky obscured by dripping concrete, you hear a voice. 'Help!' it cries. A sound of fearful desperation amidst threatening halls. Do you follow the voice, or look for a way out? Enter the city, and make your choice. Some voices cry for help, someone's whispering, shouting, talking to you, waiting, pushing you to find what's hidden in this empty town. Explore the back alleys and corridors of abandoned and trashed streets, buildings and stairs, leading you closer to the cry for help that's screaming for you to come. ALLON3 is a surreal and atmospheric horror experience, that features 3D sound driven story. So many voices are guiding you, yet you are completely alone and abandoned. Find your way out, find out who's calling for help, who's whispering into your ears and what kind of place did you end up in in the first place.
row.short_description: A phychological horror experience of voices and screams.

row.name: Lantern Light (DEMO)
row.detailed_description: Lantern Light is a first-person action horror puzzle game where you explore a decrepit manor and face twisted monsters. While clinging to your axe and the fragile glow of your lantern, the only thing keeping you from madness. Utilize the light from your lantern to blind enemies and the oil inside to burn away corrupted vines blocking your path. row.short_description: A simple experience designed to capture the scale and essence of Stonehenge in a virtual reality environment. Enjoy strolling through this simulation at the pace of your choosing on an Infinadeck omnidirectional treadmill.

row.name: さらば劇薬 -encore-
row.detailed_description: ・あらすじ 本作『さらば劇薬 -encore-』は有名な劇団の「主役」を目指す二人の少女が、オーディションとしてエチュード(即興劇)をするノベルゲームとなっております。 彼女達が舞台の上でどう芝居を演じるのか、そしてどんな幕引きとなるのかはプレイヤーである貴方の選択次第です。 ・ゲーム説明 観客としても演者としても楽しめる、新ジャンル「演劇体験型ノベルゲーム」ついに登場！ もちろん演劇に詳しくない方でも楽しんでいただける、「演技(うそ)」とにまつわるお話です。 最初にルート選択があり、選んだキャラの視点でお話が進みます。二周することで物語の全貌が見えてくるゲームです。 ゲームはいつでもセーブ・ロードすることが可能です。 ※一部ショッキングな描写が含まれるため、12歳未満の方のプレイはご遠慮ください。 『さらば劇薬-encore-』はマルチエンディング採用のノベルゲームです。プレイヤーの選択によって、キャラの演技や舞台の結末が変化します。 【キャラクター紹介】 ソワレ： いたって平凡な女子高生。演劇未経験者。「特別な存在」に憧れ、普通の自分から脱却してスポットライトを浴びるため劇団のオーディションを受けることを決めた。影が薄く、気弱で流されやすい性格。 マチネ： 元天才子役の女子高生。幼い頃から演劇の世界にのめりこんでおり、高校でも演劇部のメイン役者を務めている。平田オディールの作る芝居の大ファン。クールで淡泊な振る舞いだが、情熱的な面もある。 平田オディール： 劇団「夢枕」の演出と脚本を務める演劇界の風雲児。「究極のリアルを追求する芝居」を作ることに人生をかけている熱き志の持ち主。女性的な口調で気さくな性格。役者より見た目がハデ。 ・利用規約 二次配布・無断転載・自作発言は全面禁止しております。 二次創作や実況については、基本的に歓迎しております。(公序良俗に反するもの、誹謗中傷やからかい目的のもの、世界観を壊すものを除く) ★実況(プレイヤー自身の音声やテキスト)の無い、ゲーム映像をそのまま流すだけのプレイ動画はご遠慮ください。 ★動画・配信の場合、必ずタイトルに作品名を入れて、概要欄に作品ページのURLを貼るようお願いいたします。 ★動画・配信上でプレイできるのは１ルートまでとします。（ソワレかマチネか、どちらかのルートしか遊べません。） ★規約に反する二次創作・実況を見つけた場合、削除要請をさせていただきますのでご了承ください。 スタッフ： 製作：ひとりサークル「匙投げ部」 ・成人向けコンテンツの説明 開発者はコンテンツを次のように説明しています： テキストによる暴力描写が発生するシーンがあります。演出上、血しぶきなどのビジュアルによる暴力表現はありますが、ゴア表現などは存在しません。
row.short_description: 普通の女子高生・ソワレは、普通な自分を変えるために普通じゃない劇団のオーディションを受けることにした。そこで出会ったのは元子役の女子高生・マチネ。彼女もまた、ソワレと同じく主役の座を狙っていたのだった……。
developers: ひとりサークル「匙投げ部」

row.name: Shotgun Shenanigans
row.detailed_description: Shotgun Shenanigans combines Soccer and an FPS to make a movement based sports game. Each player is wielded with a shotgun and uses it for movement and to propel the ball in to the net. Play in a public match or in a private match with friends. 4 Gamemodes: Soccer Hoops Knockout Volleyball Join the official discord channel
row.short_description: A multiplayer FPS sports game

row.name: Planet Breakout 2
row.detailed_description: A completely free and open-source breakout clone written in C++ and Direct2D. This space-themed breakout game has unique powerups, a built-in level editor, high scores, and easy mod support to add new bricks and campaigns. Planet Breakout 2 is a sequel to the original game created in 2007, keeping true to the original 4:3 aspect ratio and delicious chunky programmer art.
row.short_description: A free space-themed breakout game with unique powerups, level editor, and easy modding support.

row.name: Age of Pyramids
row.detailed_description: Age of Pyramids is a sandbox city builder and simulator set in Ancient Egypt. You take on the city governor and architect’s mantle to build the most incredible city on Earth. On your journey to please Gods and Pharaons alike, you will relive the authentic life in one of the most epic civilizations that ever existed on Earth. Experience the simulation of this world like never before and build unseen monuments. You will discover and learn how much time and what resources it takes to build monuments and landmarks that defy the hand of time. In the Age of Pyramids, the only limitation to achieving your dreams is your own imagination. This game is for players who love relaxing games where you are not punished for your mistakes. As a player, you will build a city and generate enough resources to build one or more ancient great pyramids. To achieve this high goal you have to build road infrastructure, water canals, residences, temples, food gatherers and other buildings. Also, you need to supply your people with various kinds of food and water. Most important of all is keeping your people happy. People's happiness brings you enough manpower to build ancient wonders. The Nile is a great river with flood cycles, and you must use it well. Each building has to be built in the right terrain spot because resources are located in few places in their amount is limited. The growing city brings new challenges regarding resource management and new opportunities to unlock more buildings.
row.short_description: Age of Pyramids is a sandbox city builder and simulator set in Ancient Egypt. You take on the city governor and architect’s mantle to build the most incredible city on Earth. You will have to gather dozens of resources to maintain happiness of your people and prosperity.

row.name: Grimdark Survivors
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE GAME! About the Game Survive the onslaught of an endless horde of monsters! Kill monsters, gather their eyes, improve yourself! In this roguelite survival game, all you can do is survive as long as you can. Gather resources for level up current run. Gather credits in each run to buy upgrades and help the next survivor. A lot of Weapons Unique Builds Every Run. Select from a variety of upgrades to create a unique and overpowered builds every run. You can be a summoner-Drone Operator, for example, and destroy monsters with drones, or ranged sniper who use electrobullets to pierce enemies. Select Your Hero Choose from a diverse selection of characters and weapons that offer a variety of gameplay experiences. Features Over 30 different upgrades too choose from for a unique experience every run! Wide cast of characters and their personalities, with more to come post-launch. Casual quick 10-20 minute play sessions, for busy gamers. Weapon, Mechs and Meta System helps you become stronger
row.short_description: To save your world, take out an expanding horde of monsters. To develop one-of-a-kind and game-breaking builds, select from a selection of upgrades. Unlock a wide variety of characters and weapons with special abilities.

row.name: Relaxing Lawnmower Simulator
row.detailed_description: Ever wanted a relaxing game to play while watching movies, or just to distract yourself? Relaxing Lawnmower Simulator is simple, calming game to play when stressed, or while you're watching movies in the background. It features a freeroam mode, where you can freely roam in a wide field of grass to mow, while listening to the sound of distant waves and birds. Additionally, you can play the 'Challenge' mode, where you have to mow various residents lawns in time before they get annoyed at you taking too long.
row.short_description: Sit back and relax while calmly mowing grass in a wide field near the ocean. Or, if you want a challenge, try to mow the residents lawn before they get annoyed at you...

row.name: Krusenstern: A Stellar Sail
row.detailed_description: Thundering cannons, sails flapping in the wind, and the ship’s deck creaking – one of the most dangerous sea voyages of the 19th century lies ahead. Walk in Captain Ivan Kruzenshtern’s shoes, recruit a ship crew, secure the Emperor’s backing and sail out on Russia’s first, history-making circumnavigation. Kronstadt, Nuku Hiva’s indigenous cannibal tribes, snowy Alaska, unapproachable Japan, and China with its perils, and all this against the backdrop of violent storms, major sea battles, geographic discoveries, overcoming the challenges of maritime navigation, and a delicate interplay between onboard diplomacy and international relations. Kruzenshtern. A Stellar Sail is a monumental immersive project that tells the story of Russia’s first circumnavigation, undertaken by captains Kruzenshtern and Lisyansky on board Nadezhda and Neva. We re-enacted the chronicle of this historic voyage by relying on the protagonists’ diaries and hundreds of historical documents. The two ships spent over three years at sea, sailed through six seas and three oceans to accomplish a legendary feat. It is now your turn to become part of Russian naval history.
row.short_description: This is a monumental immersive project that tells the story of Russia’s first circumnavigation by captains Krusenshtern and Lisyansky on board Nadezhda and Neva. Walk in captain’s shoes, recruit a ship crew, secure the Emperor’s backing and sail out on a history-altering journey.

row.name: Undead World
row.detailed_description: The world is getting into a dark era, you must be the hero that save it. Action rpg that containst fast-Paced combat and survival elements. Use your skills to defeat the Undead. Try to find equiment and kill the enemies that are close. Find a way to escape the island. Features different gameplay options. -Fight the enemies and try to survive as much possible. -Use different kind of weaponry and magic. -Find hidden items across maps.
row.short_description: Action rpg that containst fast-Paced combat and survival elements. Use your skills to defeat the Undead.

row.name: Last Kids on Earth: Hit the Deck! Playtest
The Hidden and Unknown
row.detailed_description: The world is filled with The Hidden and Unknown . A lot of things remain that way, but there are some things that shall be shared as they are crucial for the evolution of our civilization. The easiest way to share some of these facts is through made-up stories that let real people save face, and yet still teach us the necessary lessons. The first story shows us just how much a seemingly small and insignificant action can change one's life. Many times, these actions are not even in our hands or are seemingly random. The details of the stories are not even as important, the lessons that we learn from them are the ones that we should remember. Everyone has a story that can teach them something, so do not ignore the reality you are facing and try to think about it instead. If you are often getting offended instead of reacting rationally, avoiding this game would be a wise action.
row.short_description: The Hidden and Unknown is a story-based game, that aims to widen the perception of its audience in the areas of psychology and philosophy.

row.name: World Of Mystery
row.detailed_description: Jump into the World Of Mystery and become the best Supernatural Detective! Uncover all the mysteries of every monsters and spirits to unlock the secrets of this mysterious land. World Of Mystery is a 3rd person casual RPG where you are put in the shoes of a supernatural detective tasked to help the people of Mystery Town from threats of Monsters & Spirits inspired by various mythologies from around the world! Explore various regions each with its own unique themes, collectibles, creatures for you to discover! Key Features: - Learn all the basic and ultimate skills to become the best fighter - Fight more than 30 enemies that are inspired by mythologies around the world - Collect all the rare equipment and swords inside the game! - Discover all the monsters and spirits with your very own Mysterydex - Unlock unique mounts to travel around the world in style - Customize your character to fit your personality Join the Supernatural Detective division and uncover the mysteries of the town!
row.short_description: Jump into the World Of Mystery and become the best Supernatural Detective! Uncover all the mysteries of every monsters and spirits to unlock the secrets of this mysterious land.

row.name: Naval Battle Online
row.detailed_description: Upgrade your ship, level up and make sure you're strong enough to send your enemies overboard. Equip your ship with advanced cannons, elite cannonballs, a qualified crew and skilled pirates. And don't miss out on the many special materials that will help you on your way to becoming a glorious pirate. Build your own mighty army and strike fear into your enemies by building or joining a fleet in Naval Battle Online. Together you can conquer the islands and become a very strong wedding ring. Be the ruler of the great seas. By taking daily quests, you can gain more experience points and speed up your development. Reinforce your friendships and show that you are a great team player by participating in regular events. If your ship is stronger than other players, you can see your ship name in the game ranking.
row.short_description: Are you ready to conquer and plunder the seas with your fleet?

row.name: Don't Remember
row.detailed_description: Horror made anew Don't Remember aims to rethink how both players and developers approach horror games, and bring a new and fresh experience to the table. Immerse yourself in this dark and atmospheric environment with dynamic audio which adapts to the way you play and makes each playthrough slightly unique. Uncover the story of William, a once renowned alchemist, now lost to his own schizophrenic mind. Dig up the remnants of Williams forgotten past and the reason for his amnesia through the power of colors, which allow you to solve many puzzles scattered throughout this inconspicuously twisted mansion. Features: Power of colors: A lightsource has been a staple in nearly all horror games, use it to your advantage! Find and unlock new colors to your lantern which allow you to explore the mansion further and progress the story in this semi-open, metroidvania-style mansion. Procedural experience: Experience procedurally generated events and scares in the game, making each gameplay feel just a little different. Tense narrative: Experience a thrilling story told through professional voice actors and award-winning writers
row.short_description: In Don’t Remember, some things are better left forgotten. Fight your amnesia in this atmospheric, first person psychological horror game. Solve the mystery of the old mansion in 1900’s England through the use of your lantern’s various colors and face its hidden grotesque visage.
row.notes: Implied violence. Implied use of alcohol and drugs. Implied domestic abuse through audio and voice acting

row.name: Koboo: The Tree Spirit - Prologue
row.detailed_description: CHECK OUT THE FULL GAME About the Game Enjoy the prologue for Koboo: The Tree Spirit. An new take on action roguelike platformers drawing inspiration from the 2D souls-like combat from Dead Cells, the scale of Shadow of the Colossus and the enchanting world of Princess Mononoke. Master challenging combat, befriend woodland creatures and restore balance to the ancient ecosystem. Features A short and sweet experience with 20 minute runs Difficult combat requires skillful movement and positioning Unlock weapons and animal abilities to customize your build each run Many accessibility and gameplay options Plant your own garden in between battles Full controller support Koboo: The Tree Spirit wouldn't be possible without the incredible support of our amazing Kickstarter community. Their passion and constructive feedback continue to shape the game, making it even better than we ever dreamed! You can follow our development and talk to us live on Discord anytime, we will respond as soon as possible. Thank you! ❤ - Jerome and Simon
row.short_description: Explore the free prologue of Koboo: The Tree Spirit! An action rogue-lite platformer where you battle against towering hunters as a tiny spirit. Forge powerful synergies, battle seemingly gigantic bosses and rebuild your home.

row.name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland Playtest
Ferromon Together
row.detailed_description: Journey with your friends in the world of Ferromon Together and take on the 10 towers with over 140 Ferromon to save the world's inhabitants from the Tainted. The entire game is free to play, with a cosmetic pass DLC available to those who want to support development. Work together with your friends to build, craft, and train to progress in this fun to play RPG. Now arguably most importantly, what exactly can you do with your friends? The answer is everything! Every non pvp battle that occurs in the world can be joined by 9 players! This is done through the Link System. When you are linked in a battle, all damage, jamming, and healing to the enemy is replicated, as well as half the damage to your monsters and half of friendly healing. This allows you to strategically work with your friends to take down strong enemies. Work together to clear the 10 Towers that are spread out across the map, and the final boss that comes after that!
row.short_description: Journey with your friends in the free to play world of Ferromon Together and take on the 10 towers with over 140 Ferromon to save the world's inhabitants from the Tainted!

row.name: Traveler's Bastion
row.detailed_description: Primarily Inspired by Vampire Survivors and Plants vs Zombies. Automatically attack and cast abilities as you move between lanes defending each from incoming soldiers. At the end of each wave, you will select one of three abilities to assist you. Survive the invasion of the four armies and you win! Features Horde survival gameplay with tower defense elements Travel to 5 different realms in 20 minutes Recruit allies to help defend your side lanes Rogue-lite progression Uncover secrets... Enjoy! - Jerome Labelle / Simon Labelle👋
row.short_description: A horde survival and tower defense mashup. Guard your traveling castle from an imperial army trying to hunt you down. Combine elemental bending styles and theorycraft the perfect set of game-breaking ability chains.

row.name: The Keyless: Awakening
row.detailed_description: The Keyless: Awakening is a journey through a dreamlike, surreal world where the lines between reality and fantasy blur. In this first-person 3D experience, you play as a protagonist trapped in a mysterious, endless place. Explore endless corridors and fields of red roses, face simple metaphorical challenges, and encounter bizarre creatures. Those who have found themselves in this strange place before you have left a note for you to read with their last thoughts. The game has many interpretations and the gameplay consists of walking and running, alternating simple challenges with bizarre, metaphorical and surreal scenes, each fork in the road will slightly modify the environment and the paths. It's about going through metaphorical situations, watching the environment transform as you choose a path, and interpreting what you see through the lens of dreams, life and death. Developed by a single person with Unreal Engine.
row.short_description: The Keyless: Awakening is a journey through a dreamlike and surreal world, witnessing bizarre, metaphorical and surreal scenes as you overcome simple challenges.
row.notes: in some scenes there is blood and there is talk of death, but not in a serious way ..

row.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 24
row.detailed_description: This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items. FC Points not available in Belgium.
row.short_description: EA SPORTS FC™ 24 welcomes you to The World’s Game: the most true-to-football experience ever with HyperMotionV, PlayStyles optimised by Opta, and an enhanced Frostbite™ Engine.

row.name: 胡辣三国
row.detailed_description: 《胡辣三国》是一款策略类实时对抗游戏。玩法别具一格，以民、枪、弓、骑、智、将、主等角色形成循环克制，还有雀神玩家熟悉的玩法融入，玩家可以策略出牌、以智取胜。该游戏可同时容纳多名玩家进行紧张刺激的对抗，在调兵遣将之间，更有细腻生动的特效地图，帅气美腻的三国英雄现身，陪伴你的群雄争霸之路！ 开创绝无仅有的新奇玩法，融合雀神、消消乐等游戏形制，在施展谋划策略的同时享受碰杠胡的乐趣，让你回味无穷，欲罢不能。绝对找不到第二个拥有如此脑洞大开玩法的游戏！ 重返三国战场，统帅三军，实时对抗。一键开启在线对局，尽情享受与其他玩家对抗的乐趣。这世界，只看你如何调兵遣将，以智取胜，走上巅峰！ 江山如画，如此多娇。3D战局地图，动态特效，陪伴作战使对抗赛事不再乏味。局内更有英雄人物全彩帅气立绘，美女国色天香，陪你踏遍山河。 烽烟四起，谁主春秋。即时战略玩法使战局风云多变，上一秒旗开得胜，下一秒潦倒失魂。当你血流成河，是采用快攻流加快结束战局，还是乌龟流打法先苟一波再说？权谋博弈，风起云涌，全看足智多谋的你如何扭转局势。 《胡辣三国》期待你的加入，点亮对局，成就霸业！官方QQ群：731209487
row.short_description: 《胡辣三国》是一款策略类实时对抗游戏。该游戏可同时容纳多名玩家进行紧张刺激的对抗，玩法别具一格，以民、枪、弓、骑、智、将、主等角色形成循环克制，还有雀神玩家熟悉的玩法融入，玩家可以策略出牌、以智取胜。

row.name: Hallowed Pumpkins
row.detailed_description: The game sets on a pumpkin farm where two teams are fighting against. There's the Farmers whose main objective is to water a given amount of pumpkins and the other team called Lurkers are trying to prevent that by catching them. The lurkers have the ability to transform themselves into a pumpkin to blend into the environment and emerge as soon as they feel ready to go. The farmers are carrying a shotgun with limited ammo along with a watering can that can run out of water. These can be recharged at one of the two barns located on the map. There are three main adjustable parameters that determines one game: How many pumpkins to spawn, How many pumpkins to water, How many Lurker AIs to spawn (set it up if you wish to play in coop with your friends). A game will end if the number of pumpkins to water are met or all farmers or lurkers are dead. The game only supports friend based matchmaking through Steam overlay.
row.short_description: Hallowed Pumpkins is a simple survival light-horror with shooting and hiding mechanics. For the best experience this game is recommended to be played in multiplayer mode with your friends to fight with or against each other.

row.name: Darkenstein 3D
row.detailed_description: Step into the chaos of Darkenstein 3D, a bullet-dodging retro FPS set deep behind enemy lines. Inspired by the brutal pace of Return to Castle Wolfenstein and the glory days of late 90s shooters, this game blends secrets, explosive physics, and a story driven by desperation… and a dog. You play as the Hobo Guy: a furious American drifter lost in enemy territory, armed with nothing but a shotgun and pure vengeance. It’s 1940s Germany, and though you’re outnumbered and outgunned, you won’t back down. This isn’t about justice, it’s personal! Gunther, your loyal companion, was taken during a Nazi raid. Now he’s locked away deep inside enemy fortresses. To get him back, you’ll need to push your limits through an uphill battle against the Axis forces. Along the way, you’ll uncover alien secrets, strange powers, and hidden horrors in a world crumbling under war. Fast, brutal, skill-based. Darkenstein 3D doesn’t hold your hand. Enemy projectiles can be dodged, but survival requires sharp movement, precise aim, and quick thinking. Every battle is a deadly dance of strafes and corners. No cover mechanics, no aim assist, just raw gunplay. Take on 13 handcrafted levels that steadily raise the stakes. Explore castles, caves, valleys, and desert towns. Unlock doors with hidden keys, discover secrets, hunt for treasure, and push your score higher and higher. You won’t fight alone. A vicious rat companion joins the bloodbath, lunging at enemies and sowing chaos in close quarters. Combine him with grenades and mines for maximum destruction. He’s small, angry, and always hungry. Explosive gore, ragdoll physics, and debris-filled firefights: every shot feels heavy, and every kill looks painful. Enemies fly, gib, and collapse in glorious carnage as the battlefield crumbles around you. No microtransactions. No battle passes. No currencies. Just one complete, standalone retro FPS the way it used to be. Built over four years by a single developer, Darkenstein 3D is a passion project turned full campaign. It’s hard, it’s funny, it’s handcrafted, and it’s packed with hours of replayable carnage.
row.short_description: A retro shooter inspired by classics like Wolfenstein and Doom. Think of it as a tribute, a love letter to the games that defined a generation, with a few modern touches of my own. It’s tough, fast, and demands skill, just the way those old-school shooters did.
row.notes: - Lots of blood. - Enemy gibs. - Depictions of WWII symbology.

row.name: Orbit
row.detailed_description: Orbit is a Multiplayer Platformer game. Battle against other Players and/or AI controlled Bots across a variety of different planets. Gain the advantage by earning XP and looting each Planet before your opponents do! Features: - Gravity Mechanic - Players can travel around all 4 sides of a Planet, adding new ways to explore the map. - Full Multiplayer/Online Support - Players can easily host and join other games at the click of a button. - Random Procedural Generation - Planets are randomly generated meaning levels/maps are different each round. - Customisation - Characters can be customised with a variety of different Armours and Colours. - XP/Leveling System - Earn XP by looting and fighting. This can then be used to gain new abilities and upgrade stats of your choice, depending on your own playstyle. - Weapons - From a 'Giant Battery' to a 'Snake-Whip', there's many weapons to find to defeat your enemies with. - Abilities/Finishers - Each weapon has a 'Special' attack linked with it. Save these attacks for just the right time to surprise opponents! - Retro-Like Aesthetic - The game is heavily inspired from 16-bit games and follows a similar art style. Join the Discord!:
row.short_description: Orbit is a Multiplayer Platformer game. Customise your own character and battle other Players and/or AI controlled Bots across a variety of randomly generated planets. Gain the advantage by earning XP and looting each Planet before your opponents do!

row.name: KABENAGURI
row.detailed_description: I like to watch live fighting game videos. However, I dislike playing fighting games. Because the stress of losing in a fighting game drives me crazy. I made this fighting game 【KABENAGURI】 to escape from that stress. 【KABENAGURI】 is a game in which you punch a wall for one minute. You can attack the wall as much as you want. You can attack as much as you want. Take all the stress you usually accumulate and throw it against the wall. The damage on the wall will be your score, and you can aim for the top ranking! In order to bring you closer to the feel of a fighting game, you can use a single attack button for both weak and strong attacks, and there are also command moves that are familiar to players of fighting games. Let`s KABENAGURI !!
row.short_description: This is a game of punching walls.

row.name: GrassGames Hearts 3
row.detailed_description: GrassGames' Hearts is a beautiful 3D computer game version of the popular Hearts card game for 3 or 4 players. Main Features: - Play locally, online, or over your home network - 'American', 'Omnibus Hearts' and 'Black Maria' variants included - Intelligent Computer opponents - Online rankings system - Replays & Statistics
row.short_description: The best Hearts Card Game around.

row.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaíra Playtest
Escape!!
row.detailed_description: ESCAPE!! is an endless runner through a haunted forest. Jump, slide, kick and close your eyes to survive. Beautiful handmade pixel art, with frightening monsters and a terrified survivor. In the 5 level Story Mode, Sally Holmes sprints through a terrible forest, trying to find her fam. She must avoid not only the monster chasing her, but also each of the frightening things she encounters. Infinite Mode has Sally running from a monster for as long as she can, everything getting faster and faster. Siesta Mode gives Sally a chance to relieve all the Tension she's built up running from monsters. She can Sleep, Eat, or Relax in the hot springs.
row.short_description: ESCAPE!! is an endless runner through a haunted forest. Jump, slide, kick and close your eyes to survive. Beautiful handmade pixel art, with frightening monsters and a terrified survivor.
row.notes: Frightening Scenes, Violence

row.name: Engine Evolution 2023
row.detailed_description: I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated terrains into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game. Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to World of Tanks - with each race against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines of 1906. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery? Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion for riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics and you need to keep that in mind. - 100 historic vehicles from 7 nations - 40 real and custom tracks - 1000+ of various vehicle setups - 100+ vehicle patterns - 10 different biomes Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. You can paint your vehicles with any combination of colors or hundreds of available patterns. The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers! CONQUER THE RESEARCH TREE!
row.short_description: Your favorite racing MMO is back with amazing tracks, more entertaining physics, and much more! Enjoy multiplayer racing action more intensely than ever before!

row.name: My Swordsman
row.detailed_description: Open world, multiplayer online tower defense confrontation game. Fight with teammates to upgrade your heroes, build bases, produce your own troops, command troops to form formations, and defend or attack enemy positions. Come and build your online fortress together.
row.short_description: Open world, multiplayer online tower defense confrontation game. Fight with teammates to upgrade your heroes, build bases, produce your own troops, command troops to form formations, and defend or attack enemy positions. Come and build your online fortress together.

row.name: Big Survivor
row.detailed_description: Big Survivor is a game all about surviving, bigly. More specifically it's a roguelike survivor game, original ik. You might be thinking, 'It has to be unique in some aspects right?'... yeah, well, you know... there's some stuff... I drew the enemies myself that's a big one. This description was written by multiple people so prepare for a mood shift. There are lots of powerups to try out and have fun with, discover what they do and figure out which ones you like the most! Some of the key features are... Being able to move Choose power ups Levelling High score comparing No Menu Timed gameplay Bearing no resemblance to Vampire Survivor I don't know what it will take for this description to get approved, so here's a step by step instruction how to play the game: 1. Open file 2. Press big play button 3. Move with WASD or mouse 4. Manoeuvre around enemies, attacking is automatic 5. Level-up by collecting orbs/killing enemies 6. Choose a good power-up 7. Die -> 2. 8. Press big exit button. You can't get here, I couldn't be bothered making one. It's a free game, with great replay value so try it out now; It's free so why not?! Did I mention it's free? Thanks for playing!! Music by Karl Sandegren
row.short_description: Survive, with a smile on your face! Fight your way through the scribbles, as you power up and become stronger. Vibe with the tornadoes and get a useless pet. Increase your sucking and suck away!!!!!!?
row.reviews: “I couldn't stop playing it.” 10/10 – Visual Cordelia

row.name: Castle Of Secrets: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Special Offer About the Game The curse of the ancient Trantons family forces young Miss Susan leave for a deadly journey, where she is about to face many inhabitants of the world of the dead, find both friends and enemies, and get answers to the most important questions on who is the true killer of her entire family. 'Castle of Secrets is a beautiful and enthralling visual novel featuring many interesting quests, mechanics and puzzles, such as crafting items, inventory, camera control and character control in 3d space. Puzzles can be regular, where you have to connect the right items to each other, or these can be mini-games, where you have to think a little differently. As you progress through the game, the complexity of puzzles and quests increases and solving them will not be as easy as at the beginning. The game offers a tutorial level that will guide the player through all the its mechanics. Enjoy beautiful graphics and nice animation. Use all the tools that the game offers you to solve the most difficult puzzles and mini-games.' The prologue includes: - Tutorial level - 2 full levels - Additional mini-game - 5 characters - 10 cut scenes - 25 quests
row.short_description: The Castle of Secrets — a game with a deep and mysterious storyline, beautiful 3D graphics, unique gameplay and mechanics, will immerse you in a fairy tale of reality and mystery. How will this fairy tale end? It's your call.

row.name: BRoS - Battle Royale of Survival Playtest
White Mourning: Museum In Pale
row.detailed_description: This is a Disco Elysium fan game. In the way of pixel RPG, this museum is built to display the illustrations in White Mourning, the fanart collection. You can wander around freely as Harry. The game contains some puzzles, and there is no linear task or plot - time is invalid here. Just explore and collect, this museum is all about YOU, Harry.
row.short_description: White Mourning: Museum In Pale is a fan game of Disco Elysium, based on White Mourning (the DE fanart book). You can wander around as a pixel RPG character. Meet with familiar people, review your familiar past, and collect all kinds of artwork.

row.name: Welme
row.detailed_description: We are the virtual reality streaming platform that improves the relationship between streamers and their community, we turn the hours of content consumption into living unforgettable experiences. A world full of possibilities where creativity is the strongest weapon that will make you stand out from the rest and gain popularity. At Welme we give total freedom to all those streamers who like to use their personalized avatar to attend events and role-play. Events From Welme you can create your own events where other users can sign up to participate. Customize the room where the event will take place with your favorite colors and channel logos. Any user can create these events to connect with their friends without any limit. Chat Thanks to our 2D voice chat you will have a realistic experience adapted to the environment at all times. Complement the experience with real-time reactions or dances that will express your feelings at that moment. Interact Roleplay and play with other users in Welme, your creativity has no limits within the immersive stadium where you can organize all kinds of events with your community.
row.short_description: We are the first virtual reality streaming platform that improves the relationship between streamers and their audience. We connect streamers with super fans who want to have a more direct, immersive and exclusive relationship than the current one.

row.name: EXTERMINATOR
row.detailed_description: EXTERMINATOR is a simple casual 2D shooting game. prologue One day, an anomaly that gave people mysterious pain began to spread. While the damage is increasing day by day for unknown reasons, Jayden As a brilliant inventor, you create a device that allows you to see anomalies. While solving an anomaly around town, one day a mysterious phone call comes in. I'm not sure about the phone call, but I'm going to take a look. features Simple operation keys Enjoy the game with helpful information for play along with guided operation explanations. We have information to help you play. limited vision What might give you trouble is the limited field of view. Pay attention and move forward. upgrade There are things that can help you when clearing a stage. Choose what you need. be careful. If you fall, you have to start over. Complete the quest by clearing the final stage.
row.short_description: A sudden outbreak of anomalies all over the world. It is invisible to others, but you can see it. Only you can solve this situation. Go to the suspected source and listen to the request of the client. It's hard to figure out the location of the monsters, so you have to be strong and go.

row.name: Dawnlands
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord About the Game Create your own epic adventure! Indulge yourself in the stunning open-world NOW! EXPLORE A variety of biomes, relics, puzzles dot the landscape... An ancient land that has laid dormant for centuries is waiting for you to awaken it, and all new stories are waiting for you to pen. SURVIVE When all has vanished, all but rich natural resources that can be found all over the land. What matters is how you use them. Start from the very beginning and survive on your own! BUILD Collect all the materials you need in the world, design and build your dream home! COOPERATE Go alone or group up with other warriors and enjoy the journey together! CHALLENGE Potential dangers don't give up their areas easily. You need to find and defeat the darkness before it engulfs the land because you were fated to be the chosen savior of the world. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ For those looking to dive deeper into the game, item purchases and battle passes are available via in-game purchase.
row.short_description: Dawnlands is an Open-World Survival Crafting cross-platform game with a massive world and epic lore. A variety of biomes, relics, and puzzles dot the landscape... an ancient land, lain dormant for centuries, is waiting to be awoken. New stories are waiting to be written.

row.name: Iron Mandate
row.detailed_description: Iron Mandate: A roguelike with a wholly original fighting mechanic! Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne. Defeat great foes Learn the subtleties of Juggernaut piloting in order to better destroy your rivals. Iron Mandate has over 30 weapons to both fight with and learn to fend off. Forge your own path Every attempt to reach the throne is unique. Different path, different arsenal, different upgrades. You will need to learn the intricacies of the Juggernaut and its many variations in order to survive your climb to the top. Prove your worth Iron Mandate includes 20+ unique challenges to prove your Juggernaut piloting skills. You can also play local multiplayer in the versus mode with up to 4 players.
row.short_description: A steampunk roguelike with a unique fighting mechanic. Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne.
