row.name: Chippy's Escape from Seaberry Keep
row.detailed_description: Help Chippy escape from Seaberry Keep! Along the way, discover secrets about the witch's potion business, team up with a bunny, play games with ghosts, and re-decorate the mansion! Features Point & click gameplay 2D exploration adventure Story voiced in English Decorate rooms with cute furnishings using a drag-and-drop system!
row.short_description: Bust out of the terrarium, uncover the witch's secrets, make new friends, decorate a mansion, and explore on a great adventure!

row.name: Just Hit The Button
row.detailed_description: Just Hit the Button is an incredibly simple arcade game where the only task is to press the buttons. It sounds easy, right? But there will be a unique challenge along the way. Test your reflexes and see if you can master the art of button-hitting in this addictive and straightforward game! FEATURES 30 levels, you can beat in seconds. Leaderboard One music track and like 3 sound effects.
row.short_description: Hit the button to win. The simplest game ever.

row.name: The Winter Tower
row.detailed_description: In the very year that Ekaterina Ivanova turns 17, her father suffers a grave injury from falling off a horse. Now the stepmother and her son threaten to take away Ekaterina’s rights of succession. To protect her rights to succeed the Lord of the House, Ekaterina decides to perform the rite for her coming-of-age at the Winter Tower. The coming-of-age ceremony will last for the entire year. Will Ekaterina be able to safely complete her coming-of-age ceremony and emerge as the rightful successor to the House? The Winter Tower is a narrative-driven, story-rich romantic visual novel, with beautiful arts and music to enrich your experience. Your decisions influence the ending of the story. Discover the true path to the true ending and complete your collection of illustrations along the way.
row.short_description: Will Ekaterina be able to safely complete her coming-of-age ceremony and emerge as the rightful successor to the House?

row.name: Utopia
row.detailed_description: About Utopia: It is a game that plays with a view that looks down on the 2D top view. You can avoid the incoming enemy's ammunition by moving and sliding, and handle the enemy by matching your attack with the enemy. The goal of the game is to strengthen the character and achieve the reconstruction of the final Utopia Island by eliminating the boss at the end of the dungeon to complete the main quest and the auxiliary quest with various goals. Game Story: Utopia Island, known as a fertile paradise all year round, was considered a legendary island. Then one day, a mercenary caught in a storm accidentally reaches the coast of Utopia. From the landscape to the topography, it resembles Utopia Island, but the atmosphere of the desolate island turns out to be a desolate ruin, with the door of hell opening on the island and the demons pouring out, except for some villages. Islanders asking foreign mercenaries to solve the island's problems. Mercenaries must build up their strength and solve the island's problems in their own way. Additional explanation: Utopia is a game that incorporates RPG into the top view ammunition game, and avoiding enemy ammunition and adapting my skills to enemy will be a major gameplay factor. Through the combat system of the above-described game, players can clear quests granted by NPCs and strengthen themselves to strengthen existing skills or acquire new skills. Dungeons with high difficulty will have to think about what skills to use and what tactics to play.
row.short_description: Utopia is a 2D top-down view barrage shooting RPG game played alone. The protagonist sets out on a journey to face various threats that befall the utopia world. Fight against a variety of incoming enemies and save the utopia world!

row.name: Frupu VR Fruit Punch
row.detailed_description: Get ready to dive into the ultimate action-packed VR adventure with Frupu VR Fruit Punch! Battle against the monstrous Mu and his army of fruits, as you mix and match to create delicious fruit cocktails that pack a punch. But be warned, these fruits are not your average ones. They're explosive and ready to knock you off your game. It's up to you to stay on your toes and use your lightning-fast reflexes to dodge and strike back. With Frupu VR Fruit Punch, you'll have access to an array of combat moves, from left and right jabs to swift dodges, all designed to help you fight off Mu's minions and become the ultimate fruit punch master. As you progress, the challenges get tougher and the stakes higher, but don't worry, the rewards are even sweeter! So, if you're ready to put your VR skills to the test, head to download Frupu VR Fruit Punch now. It's time to mix, match, and punch your way to the top!
row.short_description: It is an action-based fighting fun game. Monster Mu throws fruits to you. He throws faster and faster, sometimes throwing multiple fruits at once. Punch the fruit at the right time and finish your fruit cocktail or the fruit will explode in your face. Caution: Don't let the toaster hit you.

row.name: Constructo - Dungeons Builder
row.detailed_description: WHAT IS CONSTRUCTO - DUNGEONS BUILDER? Constructo is a tool that turns your imagination into reality. A virtual tabletop that packs a set of tools for your favorite tabletop RPG! Say goodbye to those unappealing last-second sketches and instead see maps with your own eyes in an incredible pulsating 3D full of life. That fire-breathing dragon has never looked so realistic! HOW TO CREATE A MAP? With the internal editor, you create your favorite maps. You can add walls, floors, columns, and anything else you need to lay the foundation for your dungeon. DO CLASSIC INDOOR SETTINGS FEEL CRAMPED? Expand your boundaries. Bring the world to life with the terrain editor. Raise and lower the ground to your liking; level it, smooth it, create your ideal world. Afterwards, color and customize it. Give free rein to your imagination. FREE FOR PLAYERS This version gives players free access to the GM's game. Only the GM will have to purchase the DLC 'Constructo - Dungeons Builder (GM Version)
row.short_description: Constructo is a tool that turns your imagination into reality. A virtual tabletop that packs a set of tools for your favorite tabletop RPG! Say goodbye to those unappealing last-second sketches and instead see maps with your own eyes in an incredible pulsating 3D full of life. FREE for players!

row.name: VrScreamer
row.detailed_description: VrScreamer is a bridge between viewers and your adrenaline, opening up new dimensions in the world of streaming and entertainment. Let the viewers scare you at the most unexpected moment with the help of donations, bits or rewards on Twitch! Assign a cost to each individual screamer, or combine them into groups with the same price for random selection.
row.short_description: A program for displaying jumpscares for donations, bits and channel points (twitch).
row.notes: The application demonstrates various monsters (zombies, demons), blood during operation

row.name: One Last Time
row.detailed_description: Life can change in an instant, sometimes in the wrong way. After losing someone close, a mysterious person shows up to help you get your life back together. Overcome the stages of grief in this intriguing puzzle-centric, dialogue experience and see how the story unfolds. A short and sweet, solo developed indie game full of memorable conversations and simple, yet fun, puzzles. Features A compelling story told through the conversations between two people. 50 relaxing, grid-based puzzles. Different outfits to express themselves with. Additional side story. Soothing backgrounds and calm music. Beautifully minimalistic art style.
row.short_description: Life can change in an instant, sometimes in the wrong way. After losing someone close, a mysterious person shows up to help you get your life back together. Overcome the stages of grief in this intriguing puzzle-centric, dialogue experience and see how the story unfolds.

row.name: Echo of the Last Light
row.detailed_description: Student Collaboration With the University of Utah: The Fat Bear Society, a studio consisting of 2 producers, 5 artists, 5 engineers, 4 designers, and 2 musicians, worked for 10 months to deliver Echo of the Last Light. This 3D action-adventure puzzle game was created in a simulated-studio environment at the Graduate Games Lab at the University of Utah, but the project is 100% student-run and student-owned. Prepare to be blown away by our incredible non-profit project! Overview: In a world where The Echoes used to light up the sky, the last light is your only hope. Together with the Echo, a creature of light, you embark on a mission to rescue the world from the encroaching darkness. Will you save the world or become consumed by the Abyss? In Echo of the Last Light, you will explore a beautiful yet perilous world, team up with a mysterious creature, and engage in combat against the enemies of The Royal Eclipse. With a captivating story, puzzles, and thrilling action, this game seamlessly blends exploration, combat, and adventure. Collaborate with your companion to unlock new abilities and uncover hidden secrets in the world. Play as Tamasis, Humble Light Follower In Echo of the Last Light, you play as Tamasis, a follower of The Humble Light, a group of moths dedicated to preserving the world's light. Your mission is to find the only remaining source of light, a creature that becomes your companion. You must bring the last light to The Tree of Humble Light to save the world from The Royal Eclipse, who seeks its destruction. Along the way, you will team up with The Last Light, fight the enemies of The Royal Eclipse, and uncover secrets that will alter the world's fate. Fight Enemies With Your Companion Join forces with your trusty companion to overcome challenging puzzles and take down the enemies of The Royal Eclipse in Echo of the Last Light. With the Echo ability, you'll be able to uncover hidden secrets and see what others cannot. Collaborate with your companion to use your enhanced abilities to your advantage, and work together to fight your way through hordes of enemies. Uncover Secrets in The World, What Cannot Be Seen Your companion possesses a powerful Echo ability that reveals hidden elements in the world. As you journey through the world, you will learn how to command the companion and take advantage of this ability, allowing you to uncover hidden parts of the world and enemy weaknesses. By using this ability to your advantage, you'll be able to navigate complex puzzles, overcome The Royal Eclipse, and ultimately determine the fate of the world. Whether you're exploring the mysterious landscapes or engaging in fast-paced combat, Echo of the Last Light offers a unique and immersive experience that will keep you engaged from start to finish and leave you with lingering questions…what are you willing to give up to save the world? Whose freedom is truly at risk? And what beliefs are worth fighting for, even when they may hurt some beings?
row.short_description: The worlds of light and dark are in danger. Will the creatures of the light be the key to saving your homeland in the dark? Journey with your new companion to discover how you can save the world while fending off those who would harm you and your companion.

row.name: Velocity Rift
row.detailed_description: Velocity Rift is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you shoot orbs to defeat enemies and save the world. The number of orbs is limited and take time to return once fired. Shooting enemies' weak spots returns the orbs faster! Also, the faster you move, the slower the world becomes, so always be on the move! Key Features 4 Levels, 4 Worlds Each level is a different dimension, filled with its own thrills and dangers. Speed through and pass through the rift at the end to reach the next dimension! Time Dilation Speed is the name of the game! The faster you move, the slower the world becomes! Keep up the pace and everything will slow to a crawl... and you’ll be glad they did. Combat Ammunition is limited! Orbs you fire take time to travel back, longer if they go wild. Improve your accuracy and make every shot count! Additionally, different ways to eliminate your pursuers are learnt as you pass from dimension to dimension. Using each in the right situation is key to swift victory! 3 Movement Abilities Your movement is augmented over the course of your journey. Combine these abilities to speed your way through each dimension to get the best time possible. Steam Leaderboard Login to Steam before launching the game to access the Steam leaderboards. Compete with others to reach the top and strive for better clear times on all levels! Boss Fights Each dimension has its own guardian, blocking your path to the next... If you can keep up with life on the fast lane, we’ll see you through the rifts!
row.short_description: Velocity Rift is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you shoot orbs to defeat enemies and save the world. The number of orbs is limited and shooting enemies at their weak spots return the orbs faster. Also, the faster you move, the slower the world becomes, so always be on the move!

row.name: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin'
row.detailed_description: FingerBang: All Bullets Pointin' is a first person shooter game taking inspiration from the “boomer shooter” games of old. It combines elements from games both old and new, and includes a ranking system based on player performance. You play as a former police officer taking justice in your own hands (literally), as you tear your way through the criminal element of the city, trying to put an end to the manufacturing and spreading of a dangerous new drug known as Strutusol. Fast-paced gameplay with several different powers to help you overcome your enemies Master your tools to improve your ranking Test your mettle throughout multiple levels, each requiring different approaches Discover hidden secrets throughout each level Special thanks to Janne Mustakallio and Eerik Annola for producing the original music in this game. *This game is a student project originally created in a period of 9 weeks, this version of the game being available as the demo version. Current release version has already surpassed the original release and will continue to receive updates for the foreseeable future.
row.short_description: Fingerbang: All Bullets Pointin' is a fast-paced FPS inspired by both retro and modern FPS games. Fingerbang combines elements from each in order to create a mix of its own, with a scoring system added on top to gauge your performance through the different levels.
row.notes: Depicts cartoon violence and gore, use of fictional drugs and mildly crude language.

row.name: My Little Miniatures
row.detailed_description: My Little Miniatures will be available in November 22nd,2022 Do you hear the roar of battle? Yes,it's time! Let's head into the World of Miniatures! Assemble your team of little miniatures, and take part in the epic battle! It is an absolute honor to have you playing My Little Miniatures. Since the game is still being polished, it would be great if any kind of comments, suggestions, or criticism can be provided. Please, let us know! About this game My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds! About the Game Assembling cute miniatures with different skills, forming your crew and destroy your rivals. At the beginning of each game, you can summon your favored miniatures from several random choices. In addition to the different numbers of attack, defense and health, miniatures have their own unique skills. Fully thinking about matching different miniatures will make your crews more powerful! All miniatures are available for level-up. With the level-up of miniatures, the crew can be upgraded with both attack, defense, health and more powerful skills! Opponent crews would be stronger in every next round, are you ready for more challenging lineups?
row.short_description: My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds!

row.name: Aohri's Uprising
row.detailed_description: After a series of cataclysms, the Ahori tribe lost faith in their god. They decided to send their fiercest warrior to put an end to his wrath. Propelled into the divine dimension, our heroine Aohri set off armed with her bow to slay her fallen god. Fight for survival in this third-person shooter. Pursue a ruthless enemy in explosive battles full of twists and turns and projectiles. : -Shoot -Move -Modify your shot -Dash -Slow down enemy projectiles Explore a vast world full of danger: -Towers that fire projectiles -Platforms that break -Trapped temple walls -Sharp blades -Temple axes -Rotating blades
row.short_description: Embark on an adventure, driven by vengeance, to hunt down your former god and put an end to his reign to restore balance to the world!

row.name: 13 Candles
row.detailed_description: 13 Candles is an atmospheric horror game where you play as Sara, 13-year-old girl who wakes up in an abandoned hospital. Find your way to the light switch and wake up from your nightmare. Candles - Candles are your only light source; try to find as many as you can to keep the darkness from consuming you... Clues - Find clues as you go, and discover your past. Be careful! Credits: Coders: Juho Halonen and Suat Demirel Artist: Anni Konttinen Artist: Ayako Haapalainen Level Design: Gunwoo Sun Music & Sound Effects: Mira Oja / Dream Lakes Voice Acting: Laura Lindemann / Tilia Notice: This is a student game and it will most likely not to be continued any further but any feedback is definitely appreciated.
row.short_description: 13 Candles is an atmospheric horror game where you play as Sara, 13 year old girl who wakes up in an abandoned hospital. Find your way to the light switch and wake up from your nightmare.

row.name: Ok I Pull Up
row.detailed_description: Pull up as a baby capybara in this 3D rage platformer! You, a capybara, must use your jumping skills to escape the quarantined tree tower. Explore a seamless world, split into three unique levels. Reach the end of the tower and claim unimaginable rewards. Challenging, skill-based gameplay Climb the tower only by jumping Miss a jump, fall, and lose all your progress Start all over again Cute theme with memorable side characters Several fun platforms and challenging obstacles This game will test your patience to the extreme. Good luck. *This game is a student project created over a period of 9 weeks
row.short_description: Ok I Pull Up is a rage platformer, in which you, a capybara, ascend a tree tower only by jumping. This punishing, yet fair game requires extreme patience to complete.

row.name: パズルバトラー！みらい Playtest
Forge of Destiny
row.detailed_description: Faced with the impossibility of halting the extinction of humanity, a planetary contingency plan was activated for the relocation and protection of the surviving people. Promoted and financed by the world's leading technology company of the time, Inductrack, a program was devised to build colossal metropolis contained in domes or vaults, which would be known as Nodes or dome-cities. Although originally there were more than three thousand Nodes, the number of operational dome-cities is not known at present. Political instability and constant internal conflicts, as well as the altercations that occurred during the insurrection of the rebel coalition of Diurna against the government of the Regency of Omnis, provoked confrontations that, in many cases, ended with the total destruction of the structures that provide vital support to the domes. Gradually, the idea of finding another way of life fell into oblivion. The Nodular Governments rewrote the events of the past to maintain absolute control over the inhabitants of the dome-cities, who submitted to the idea of isolation and the impossibility of leaving their own Nodes, believing that there was no existence but themselves. The control of truth . At present, VΣRÐΔÐ is the only truth that exists. The citizens of the Nodes are engaged in the search for arcana in order to increase their influence and thus acquire privileges based on their reputation. Meanwhile, Diurna maintains her combative spirit, organizing assaults and skirmishes, hoping that, one day, the scales will finally tip in her favor. 1st Chapter Enter the universe of 'Forge of Destiny' as an inhabitant of the Fourth Node-capital. Discover the secrets hidden in the sands of the ruin district and witness the beginning of your story. An initial journey that will lead you to discover the reality of a new society built on the ruins of the past. Thus, finding the truth will be essential to discover what really happens within the walls of the Node-capital. The Forge of Destiny This first chapter, which begins the saga 'Forge of Destiny', has been coordinated by Dr. Alberto González Fernández, with the participation of his colleagues from the Nodo Educativo Research Group, as well as the illustrator Francisco Kobo and the composers Nacho Márquez and Víctor Rodríguez. A project funded by the COTEC Foundation and developed by the Video Game Laboratory Nodo Play.
row.short_description: «Forge of Destiny» is the first Spanish RPG to combat disinformation through a steampunk dystopia. Create your character, travel through the Node-capital and venture into the ruins of the forgotten world. Live a unique experience of classic style in which discerning the truth will be a challenge.

row.name: Rootless: Memories Of Green - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: 'Why was I built?' 'What is the value of life?' 'To survive in this rootless world, you have to fit into the mold.' 'What if I am different?' 'Then you must change the world.' FEATURES Classic 2D adventure game set in a futuristic cyberpunk world Play though first chapter of the story and get introduced to the colorful cast of quirky characters Interact with the world and solve intriguing puzzles that challenge your problem-solving skills Original art and sci-fi vibe soundtrack This game is a student project created over the period of 9 weeks.
row.short_description: The story follows a robot girl named Zoe in a futuristic world. She wakes up in a laboratory, alone with no memory. Zoe goes on a journey to discover her past and protect the last hope for the planet. The adventure explores philosophical themes of self-discovery, and a tree.

row.name: IN CELL
row.detailed_description: IN CELL is a kinetic visual novel (linear, no choices) about the epidemic of sexless, nationless, and friendless men. Gender dynamics are currently not functional, sustainable, or beneficial to either men or women. IN CELL is an uncensored conversation between the sexes. Not that such a conversation will solve anything. There are no specific characters, just mostly nameless men, and women. It is better to think of men and women as the characters rather than specific people. There are themes of racism, violence, sex, porn, and pretty much anything you could think of that may bother you. There's a healthy dose of memes too as the subject matter necessitates it. You'll enjoy the hot new dating app 'Let's **** Chad!' You'll consider violence a reasonable solution. You'll hate, you'll love, and you'll be numb. IN CELL while primarily written by me does include direct quotes of men from youtube, 4chan, reddit, and other corners of the internet. IN CELL does not come from a place of wanting to solve the problem. It is merely a talking point in the form of a visual novel. I wanted to write about the modern male experience. I was inspired by innumerable sources that I won't name as they may not want to be associated with this work. I've read books, watched hundreds of thousands of hours of youtube videos, browsed forums, and have gone outside. I, like many other men, do not like this world. IN CELL is about our experience as men.
row.short_description: IN CELL is a kinetic visual novel (linear, no choices) about the epidemic of sexless, nationless, and friendless men. Gender dynamics are currently not functional, sustainable, or beneficial to either men or women. IN CELL is uncensored conversation between the sexes.
row.notes: Racism, sexism, politics, prostitution, porn, violence, drugs.

row.detailed_description: Distributor simulator is open world, third person game. You are company owner and here you have to buy goods al lowest possible price, load it to your car and deliver it to shops. Increase your level and unlock more contracts with other shops and Companys for different cargos. Buy trailers or bigger vehicles to increase load capacity and earn bigger profit. After some time you will notice what price is high, what price is low so you can buy more goods on cheap and store it in your warehouse for next delivery. Eventually became successful merchant and earn your first million. Features: -Physics based vehicles -Attachable trailers -Day night cycles -Dynamic weather -Dynamic economy *More content will be added with future updates.

Avoid the obstacles and enemies with acrobatics moves as your progress your way through your castle and talk with a monster girl at the end of each level. Frame by frame drawn animation. Sountrack entirely composed by me with love. Play as a cute red head vampire.

row.name: Forbidden City Journey
row.detailed_description: What is Forbidden City Journey? This is a VR panoramic tour of the Forbidden City of China. Players can tour the Forbidden City and learn about its history through the game The game has a kitten NPC, which will act as a guide to introduce players to various scenes in the Forbidden City. The Forbidden City is full of fun to visit through the real picture, so that players can feel the solemnity and majesty of the Forbidden City without leaving home. There are also some mini games designed based on cultural and historical events, through which players can have a better understanding of the cultural knowledge of the Forbidden City. This will increase players' interest in the Forbidden City and even Chinese culture.
row.short_description: This is a VR tour game based on the real picture, which can not only allows players to immerse themselves in the majesty of the Forbidden City, but also to understand the culture and history of the Forbidden City through a mini-game.

row.name: Animal Trainer Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: RUN YOUR OWN ANIMAL TRAINING CENTER! Animal Trainer Simulator gives you a unique opportunity to build, design, and run your own Training Center! Create the perfect space to make your pupils feel safe and happy. DEVELOP YOUR TRAINING CENTER Develop your training center with new attractions and amenities - jumping ramps, obstacle courses, slalom poles, tunnels and much more. Manage and expand the entire area, create a hall, add chairs, paint walls, build waiting rooms, and create a play area for animals. You have to remember that in your animal training center, there will be different species of animals - and therefore you have to think about the different spaces where they will stay. After all, each pet has its own unique needs. TAKE CARE OF THEM Exercise and training are not everything - your task in the game also will be to take care of the animals. Pet, brush, wash them and don't forget to give treats! Thanks to this, each pet will feel at home in your training center. TRAIN AND IMPROVE THE SKILLS OF THE ANIMALS One of your main tasks in the game will be to train animals, teach them commands, and tricks. Much will depend on you and your approach to teaching animals, it requires a lot of work and commitment, but animals are able to repay with love and fidelity. Some of the animals will not be so eager to train and learn new habits, you have to find the right way to deal with them. PARTICIPATE IN DIFFERENT COMPETITION Open a stud and a paddock, train them, and maybe one of your horses will win in the world championship! Hard training pays off, make your Training Center the best and known all over the world!
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Manage and develop your animal training center, create a safe and happy place for them! Train different types of animals, and give them a lot of attention and they will surely become calmer with their owners.

row.name: Stories From the Cores
row.detailed_description: Deep beneath the ocean floor, what discoveries are possible? Join science bot Rovee on 3 expeditions with the International Ocean Discovery Project. Drill core samples from below the ocean floor, compare the layers, investigate hypotheses, and piece together dramatic stories of life on Earth. Stores from the Cores is a suite of 3 single-player mini games about deep ocean core science. The games feature multiple choice questions, exploring 3D environments with science bot Rovee via point and click controls. Collecting mineral samples for scientific research, and matching games that all teach players about deep ocean core science. “It’s like a fun game and you can learn from it.” Age 12 The mini games are the following: Mysteries of the Core Why are bits of land plants found in cores drilled from under the sea floor far from shore? “It's a colorful, interesting story, connected to what science is finding out.” Age 40 Deep Dark Life How are microbes able to live inside rocks hundreds of feet below the sea floor? Find out what the Center for Dark Energy Biosphere Investigations has discovered. “I never thought of microbes at the bottom of the sea. I thought it was a dark place with nothing going on.” Age 40s Die-no-saur What do dinosaurs and plankton have in common? What happened on Earth when dinosaurs, plankton and lots of other life went extinct? “Ocean drilling means…getting samples from the ground to play back history to find out what happened.” Age 14 Accuracy These games are based on current scientific data. HOWEVER, we did add googley eyes to the microbes. Funding from This project is funded through National Science Foundation Award #1515856 and the Center for Dark Energy Biosphere Investigations.
row.short_description: In this entertaining and educational game, players analyze evidence from under the ocean floor to unlock dramatic stories.
developers: Ceisel & Associates, Inc. (P Ceisel and B Becker)

row.name: ISO
row.detailed_description: Welcome, exploration unit Nem0-1. Join Nem0-1, a robot tasked with the mission of collecting photos of the life forms of a beautiful, but abandoned and mysterious, post-human planet Earth. Explore the environment, find hidden areas, discover all the animals and make sure to take photos of them in different situations to fill your Compendium and unveil the planet's secret. But be careful, not everything is as you know it, and some creatures might be dangerous... On your journey you'll stumble upon contamination areas, home to the mysterious V-Creatures. You can't stay long in these areas , so you'll have to be quick to snap a pictures of all the V-Creatures and avoid the threats hiding within. What you will find in this game Free exploration with walking, running, crouching, crawling and climbing. A complex camera and photo system with zoom, roll, filters, depth of field and more! A Pro Mode where you can manually set the ISO, Aperture and Shutter Speed of the camera with realistic responses. Lots of animal s to find, each with multiple behaviours to photograph, unlocking a different description that sheds light on the mysteries of the world. A score system based on composition rules . A beautiful world that slightly changes on each play , full of opportunities to get beautiful photos. Please note that ISO is a short experience that lacks a traditional ending.
row.short_description: Join the robot Nem0-1 to collect photos of the animals inhabiting a post-human planet Earth filled with breathtaking sights and mysterious habitats. Complete your compendium by taking better photos, outsmart dangerous predators and explore the ruins of humanity.

row.name: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is a FREE standalone experience from the world of Athenian Rhapsody which is to serve as a demo for the full game. Athenian Rhapsody is a fresh comedic RPG game in which you'll explore the World of Athens! Your goal is to build your very own Rhapsody, the story of you (the player) and your epic tale in this world. Your story will unfold based on your decisions , to the degree of which cannot be replicated by any other player. As you may have taken note, this is NOT Athenian Rhapsody ... This is Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon ! Start off your adventure with a personality quiz and be paired up with a mandatory friendship to complete the dungeon crawl with! Your mission is to maneuver your way through Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon in whatever way you deem fit . You could choose to defeat a massive amount of enemies and collect heaps of EXP, or make friends and complete puzzles that include cute little farm animals! You'll be pursuing a Token in this game as opposed to a Rhapsody, a smaller and more simple version of what your Rhapsody may look like one day. ARhap:TGPD is a turn based RPG which includes intense and fast paced real-time-dodging . You'll be faced with many challenges , and you'll have to brawl your way through the dungeon by either fighting, or finding a way to make friends with your opponents through real estate sales, sharing cream cheese, hiring a plumber, and other strange and wacky interactions. Adventure with one of 12 different companions! - Your time in the dungeon will be drastically affected by the follower you're assigned during your personality test! This partner of yours may be super useful in battle, funny and charming, or maybe just a bit weird ! There's a lot to discover in each potential party member, and a deep friendship to be found within each one. Tons of enemies for you to FIGHT or BEFRIEND! - Thunder Goober has compiled a group of suspicious fellows with which you'll have the choice of engaging in intense battles with! Choose your path carefully , you may end up coming face to face with quite the challenge. Varying battle mechanics to always keep the action fresh! - Many characters will switch up the tactics of battle, you'll be faced with various minigames based on the scenario you find yourself in. Absolutely hilarious. - This game is fast paced, action packed, and full of zany and ironic humor that anyone can have a nice laugh at. Choose your own adventure! - Nothing substantial in this game is up to RNG. You choose your pathway from start to finish, creating an extremely specific pathway which will then be recorded into your playthrough's Rhapsody! Vigorous mental challenges, and intense puzzles! - You may face mind-bendingly difficult challenges such as a 3x3 Slide Puzzle (trust me this is near impossible) and 'Farm Animal Sound Matching' throughout your Token's adventure. Lots of different Tokens to collect! - Based on your actions in TGPD, the Token you receive to commemorate your playthrough will appear differently . You'll also be able to crack it open and see a massive amount of stats and details about your adventure! It's basically a warm-up to your Rhapsody. I wonder if certain hidden challenges will unlock secret types of Tokens , too... Your Token will be redeemable in Athenian Rhapsody's full game! - In the future, you'll be able to redeem your Tokens for rewards in ARhap's full game. This may come in the form of exclusive armors or other in-game items , or maybe even special marks on your Rhapsodies ! Only time will tell... Thunder Freaking Goober, baby! - This game is all about Thunder Goober... You'll see many different sides of this wacky wizard throughout your experience, and maybe you clever players will discover a bit of wizard lore ! Regardless, you'll have to piece everything together in Athenian Rhapsody later on. The common goal of Athenian Rhapsody and Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is to provide a real, impactful experience for everyone who plays it. There's something for everyone and I hope that every player can relate to their story somehow, and maybe even reflect on their own lives. Remember to have fun, it's a game! Similar to a Rhapsody, every decision, action, and event that takes place during a playthrough is recorded into your Token ! Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon may be small, (wizard budget cuts) but there's absolutely no shortage of individuality between two player's tokens. The information contained in a Token ranges from your battle stats as well as the status on any stomach issues your character has . As much as we may pray and hope, Thunder Goober is NOT real and DOES NOT exist in real life. He is definitely not filling out the description for this game, either! Regardless, you most likely should still be afraid of him to a reasonable degree . While your real name might truly be (Insert Name) , and your character in Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is also named (Insert Name) , often Thunder Goober will refer to you as Cornball . This is simply due to the fact that Thunder Goober's wizard brain is completely fried and he sees reality in a different way than you or I might. This is nothing to be concerned about! I believe somewhere, sometime long ago a human named Cornball may have made an impact on Athens, or... Maybe you're Cornball? Who knows! Just keep in mind that he means well.
row.short_description: Athenian Rhapsody: Thunder Goober's Personality Dungeon is a FREE dangerously goofy RPG with fast paced, unique combat and zany secrets and adventures. Your goal is to build your own rhapsody, the story of you - the player - an experience which cannot be replicated by others.

The Reborn update brings massive improvements after months offline: log in now to claim 650 FREE summons, enjoy 70% discount on pulls, and participate in the 'Summon More, Get More' event to build your ultimate team. With Familiars by your side, enjoy stable battle support and cross-season inheritance — your adventure is never lonely! Three new schools — Shadow, Aura, and Corrosion — are set to break tradition with unique bonds and roles for ultimate dominance! Level up once, shared across your entire team! row.name: Inheritance: Ladeina's Path
row.detailed_description: HERE IS INHERITANCE: LADEINA’S PATH ACTION ADVENTURE WITH ADULT CONTENT Join the adventure of Astarte, promising warrior, and protector of the power of Ladeina! Customize your character and play with your style! Beat your enemies, find your way, discover your destiny. Besides the action elements, this game will bring you exciting adult content, full of sex and erotic scenes. As Astarte, you will have a chance to solve conflicts and encounters not only with strength but also with her beauty and love. THE IDEA When we played Witcher 3, we loved the emotional storytelling and the relationships between characters. When we played Skyrim, we loved the open worlds and the hidden gems on the map. ARPG has caught our eye for a long time, and we want to draw inspiration from these games in an adult genre. We imagine having much deeper and uncensored scenes with Geralt. We want to tell a compelling story, make players have an adventure in a rich and expansive world, and have experiences with outstanding erotic feelings! And that's how Inheritance: Ladeina's Path was born. We will release our game for PC, season per season, adding new features, lands, characters, and improvements with each season. It's an amazing journey that we want you to be a part of! AN ANCIENT CONTINENT, EZOS Enter Ezos, a grim and divided piece of land with complex dilemmas. You will find beautiful landscapes, interesting places and small villages inbetween this chaos. Astarte will travel to the different locations of Ezos during her journey to find the missing artifacts of Ladeina. You will start the journey at her village and from there, you will decide where the path will take you. The Clan has been blessed by the Goddess, Ladeina, for thousands of generations in order to protect their power. Now with her clan on the verge of extinction, Astarte must take her first steps into an unknown world. THE MYTHOLOGY OF EZOS Every clan has different beliefs but most agree that there was a time when the Gods were walking on the earth! They gave power to humankind and watched as the clans fought each other to capture the power of the others. The Gods decided to separate this power into 2 parts. That is how the powers of Love and War were born. Goddess Ladeina and God Khain were assigned to protect these powers . One day the Gods started to fight each other. This war took a long time and after this fight, the Gods decided to separate into many pieces and create artifacts made of these powers. Those artifacts were then hidden, although a small amount of them had been given to humankind. Nobody knows how to use these artifacts except for the Clan of Immortals. THERE IS NO LIMIT TO OUR IMAGINATION, JOIN NOW! With our “season per season” release approach, we are going to create a dynamic game design. We won’t have a limit. With every new season we offer new lands, new characters, new features. We are making this game with our community in mind! Come and join, give ideas and experience being a real part of the game!
row.short_description: An adult action adventure with exploration and a rich story.
row.notes: Includes nudity

row.name: Rake Remastered
row.detailed_description: Enter the unknown with Rake Remastered, a spiritual successor to the haunting 2015 classic. Dive into the heart of an unforgiving wilderness where danger lurks in every shadow. As an investigator, you're drawn to a forest shrouded in mystery, tasked with uncovering the truth behind a string of chilling disappearances. Armed with only a handful of tools, you must navigate the eerie landscape, piece together unsettling clues, and face a predator unlike anything you've encountered. The forest holds its secrets close, and the line between hunter and hunted grows thinner with every passing moment. Will you survive the night, or will the Rake claim you as its next victim? The answers are out there. But at what cost?
row.short_description: Survive the pursuit of a monstrous predator in 'Rake Remastered,' a tribute to the 2015 original. Uncover mysteries armed with traps and cameras. Outsmart the Rake, survive the nightmare.
row.notes: Contains Blood, Violence and Gore.

row.name: How long can you survive
row.detailed_description: Game in development, many functions are not implemented. How long can you survive is a survival game in which the more time you spend in the same game, the more difficult it will be to kill the enemies. You control robots made by people who want to find a world to inhabit, since theirs was destroyed. In these worlds live monsters that have already fought against other robots and you will have the opportunity to get 'pieces' by destroying these enemies. The pieces will help you to improve your character and achieve a higher score. Try to reach the top of the leaderboards by achieving the fastest time possible in infinite mode. Gameplay select a character and choose the game mode, campaign mode or infinite mode. campaign: complete the list of missions and get the necessary coins to escape with the ship, if you die you will lose many pieces that will help you to improve your character. infinite: play as long as you want, the more time you spend, the more difficult it will be and the more loot you can get, when you see it too difficult, run away with the ship to avoid loot loss!
row.short_description: How long can you survive is a survival game that the more time you spend in the same game, the harder it will be to kill the enemies.Try to reach the top of the leaderboards by getting the longest time possible in infinite mode.
