row.name: Ragnarök TD
row.detailed_description: RAGNARÖK TD Ragnarök TD is a 2D top-down tower defense game created as a case study of Ninja Kiwi's Bloons TD 6. Follow the story of a small village in the North as they fend off the beasts of Ragnarök. WOLVERINESOFT STUDIO Ragnarök TD was originally created by a 13-person team at the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio, a semester-long voluntary student games studio. This project was in development from September 19th, to December 10th, 2021. Additionally, a 10-person team added on to this project to be a true multiplayer game from September 19th, to December 10th, 2022. RAGNARÖK TD UPDATES (STEAM VERSION) *Play with Friends: You can now invite your friends to play together through Steam in a new multiplayer co-op mode. *Control Your Territory: Place towers in your section of the map and collaborate with your friend to strategically defeat enemies. *Send & Receive Currency: Share resources with your partner to buy towers and make upgrades. *Chat with Friends: Communicate with your friends in-game to make decisions. *Earn Achievements: Earn Steam badges for completing accomplishments and show them off to your friends.
row.short_description: Ragnarök TD is a 2D top-down tower defense game created as a case study of Ninja Kiwi's Bloons TD 6 by the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio. Follow the story of a small village in the North as they fend off the beasts of Ragnarök in this revamped Steam iteration of the original project.

row.name: REAL MAN GOT 100
row.detailed_description: The game is based on the little game 'Men are on the 100th floor' which is popular on the Internet. The only goal is to jump higher! Including mobile platform, conveyor belt and spring, keep jumping up to challenge higher scores! Pay attention to the rhythm of jumping!
row.short_description: A simple platform jumping parkour game

row.name: Inner Abyss
row.detailed_description: You play as Damian; a disgraced Knight Templar forcefully bound to a powerful entity. Together you hunt underground, demon-worshipping cults in a grimdark city. To defeat the cultists you will have to use your combat skills and supernatural abilities to stop them before they summon terrible creatures into our world. A challenging third-person combat game. Strong enemies and low health and resources can make it feel like the odds are against you. However, by utilizing various combos and using timing and the strategy you can swiftly disperse anything or anyone in your way. Explore a dark gothic environment to uncover Red Haven's secrets, and find hidden paths along the way. Keep in mind; those who enter the abyss, may never escape. Engaging Flow The combat is structured around rewarding those risk takers with good timing. Don't be shy! Find your opening and introduce them to your demon infested sword. There are very few defensive moves you can make, aside from dodging, so your best bet is trying to enter what we like to call, the flow. Chain your attacks, string them from one enemy to the other and position yourself up close and personal. You'll become a cultist slayer in no time. Close the Distance Malia is out for blood, be best not to keep her waiting. Activate your warp attack and blink towards a cultist to land a quick strike with style. This consumes ones of your two tokens. If your left with no tokens, you can no longer perform this move. Luckily, defeating a cultist will instantly recharge a token. In other words, be sure to finish the fights you start. Need a boost? Dodging will be your best bet at avoiding an attack. However, did you know that by timing your dodge right before the attack lands you can activate a perfect dodge? Doing so will light up your sword. Aside from making you look like a badass, during a limited amount of time any attacks you land on an enemy will gradually give you health. The best defense, has always been good offense. Enter the Abyss Inner Abyss explores a unique blend of dark gothic fantasy and the early industrial revolution. Clouds of soot dulls the city in a constant dark fog, and the streets are dotted with both oil and electric lamps desperately trying to light up the moldy brick streets. Few are the people who wander the streets, especially at night. For not only is the very air poisonous, but a brooding evil has taken hold. A dreading sense of unease taints the atmosphere - a pressure about to pop. Something is coming, and whatever it is, it’s malevolent. An Entry-Level Soulslike We at Paradice Entertainment are huge fans of the soulsborne genre and we believe we have captured the essence while giving it an interesting twist. Condensing all the epic highs into one blast of an experience. Contrary to the more lengthy and practice heavy playthroughs of the genre, we give a soulsborne experience to those who may not have much spare-time.
row.short_description: The world is riddled with monsters beyond our understanding, from horrors unknown. It is now your task to find out why they are here, and how to get rid of them before it is too late.
row.notes: Contains demonic imagery, depiction of cultists, blood and violence. Themes of imprisonment/slavery are present.

row.name: Witchpunk
row.detailed_description: Do you like Halloween? Do you like skeletons, pumpkins, and witches on skateboards? And most importantly, do you like bashing robots with giant, magic hammers? If you do, then get out your magic wands and your spraypaint, because we know a game that you'll love! Witchpunk is a third-person melee arena combat game where you play as Mollie, a skateboarding witch who battles against a tyrannical corporation seeking to destroy Halloween. Skate around the city and the subway, gaining speed in order to deal devastating blows to robots of all shapes and sizes. Skate faster to slam harder, and use your spells to leave enemies stunned and reeling! Backed with a signature funky beat and comic-inspired visuals, you'll have a blast as you take down wave after wave of these no-good robots. Once you've made your mark on the city, you might even get a chance to show a supremely evil businesswoman what you think about her lousy plans! High-speed hammer-bashing skateboard combat. An array of Halloween-themed robots to demolish. Bright, comic-like visuals. Spooky, funky beats! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Play as a skateboarding witch who battles against a tyrannical corporation seeking to destroy Halloween. Gain speed on your skateboard and use your hammer to deliver devastating melee attacks!

row.name: Cloud House - Virtual Arts Space
row.detailed_description: In the midst of the 2020 pandemic, when performing arts spaces were forced shut, a team of creative and tech collaborators began a mammoth task to document Centre 42's beloved blue house as its own virtual world. Through the process of photogrammetry, we captured a digital rendering of the building. The desire stemmed from preserving memories, but it led to the curiosity in exploring and expanding opportunities to create theatre and build community beyond physical spaces. The Cloud House journey brings the player to a futuristic rendering of Centre 42. It is an invitation to explore its new imagining within a virtual world. You will encounter our very first experience titled 'Love Letters to 42', a single-player filmic story shot in 2020 that captures the history of pre-pandemic C42 at 42 Waterloo Street. In Cloud House, audiences can encounter arts performances, experiences, workshops and interact with artists and other audiences. It is also an invitation and opportunity for digital artists, theatre-makers to imagine their works to be presented in this space. The content, programmes, interactivity functions are being imagined and built as ‘modules’ and updates along the way after this initial launch. The digital possibilities are endless! Please note: the game environment features bright neon lights and special effects, discretion is advised.
row.short_description: Cloud House is a revival of a physical location of a performing arts space, Centre 42 within the digital realm, featuring a single-player experience titled 'Love Letters to 42'.

row.name: Yōkaimaki
row.detailed_description: Test your skills and courage in Yōkaimaki, a 2D horror fishing and cooking simulation game from USC’s Open Alpha! In 19th century Japan, you’re a humble fisherman who has finally taken over your family’s sushi business. Cooking by day and fishing by night, you strive to uphold your family’s legacy. But once a year, during the blood moon, the fish that swim the sea give way to fearsome cryptids from the deep—the yōkai. Over the course of four nights, use your cursor to explore the ocean depths and hook the most fabled of monsters. Then, drag and drop in quick succession as you transform these strange creatures into the most delectable sushi in the land. And make sure to read your journal entries to discover the lore of the fascinatingly frightening world around you! The fate of the restaurant is in your hands! Can you keep your creatures and your customers reeling in?
row.short_description: The blood moon has risen once again, meaning the yōkai (cryptids) have emerged from the murky depths of the sea. As the heir to the family restaurant, use your fishing and cooking skills to serve up some delicious yōkai sushi!

row.name: Fallen Stars
row.detailed_description: Gameplay This game is a puzzle-based VR space themed game. Player need to complete several puzzles in order to progress throughout the game. Several cutscenes are available between scenes. Player need to complete the puzzles accordingly since all the puzzles are gated among each other. In-game voice line will guide player to progress. In-game tutorial is also available for player to practice moving in a Zero-gravity environment using VR. Description Fallen Stars is a immersive First Person VR game that tells the story of a team of astronaut crew performing several duties on the space station. The story started by the user, Thomas Jackson, an astronaut from the present, searching the net for an article about the astronauts during a space mission in January 1975. But some white light flashed through and Thomas fainted. He woke up to be an astronaut from the past, Thomas William at the I.C.E.S 1 (International Centre Energy Space Station). Upon entering the station, Thomas William performed several duties including adjusting the radio frequency, fixing the power supplies and restore the wire connections. After that, three cosmonauts return to their spacecraft and re-enter earth. During their return to earth, unexpected things happen to them. This game challenges player to finish all the puzzles as soon as possible. Features Zero Gravity Movement which provide a very unique way to move in VR Immersive Space Station Environment in VR Easy to understand puzzles for player to play Tutorial option for those who want to experience Zero Gravity Movement before entering the main game Storytelling Cutscenes Voice acting between characters Immersive In-Game Music Fallen Stars is a game developed by FlyStar. We are a team of university students participating a program called 'DICE' which challenges teams to develop a full-functioning VR Application in 3 months period. We do not have any background in game development and due to time constraints, several bugs are expected and the game is not fully optimized. However, we do appreciate all the supports! :)
row.short_description: Fallen Stars is the story of a astronaut called Thomas Jackson who travel to I.C.E.S 1 space station to perform several duties along side with his crewmates. They worked together to perform several duties on the space station. During their journey back earth, unexpected things happen to them.

row.name: HELLCARD: Prologue
row.detailed_description: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game Hellcard: Prologue is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. The prologue lets you try a portion of the main game with only a limited number of cards, artifacts, and monsters. What makes HELLCARD unique and different from most card games is that monster placement actually matters and can be used to your advantage. HELLCARD supports co-op battles with up to three heroes facing the Archdemon's hordes. In singleplayer mode , you can descend into the dungeons solo or recruit computer-controlled companions. In multiplayer mode , your friends or strangers can help you battle the hordes of hell.
row.short_description: HELLCARD: Prologue lets you try the main game's Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own, recruit computer-controlled companions or join other gamers in fast-paced tactical card battles against the armies of darkness and the Archdemon himself!

row.name: Pages of Time: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Solution of Display Problems For players who use Intel core graphics card, or encounter problems such as white screen, black screen, double image of main character, low frame rate, etc., please enter the following launch options in the 'Properties' menu of the Steam library page of this game: -screen-quality Low -screen-fullscreen 0 -screen-height 720 -screen-width 1280 About the Game Witches protect the order of the world in their floating castle, and it has been like this since the creation of the world. However, our little witch, Loretta travels through time, bringing an oracle that disturbs the witches and forces her to embark on a fateful adventure (again). Will she succeed this time? This is the story of the first-ever witch of time and her friends. Gameplay Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Playing as the lovely witch Loretta, in the Magic Academy, use skills such as moving, jumping, recording and rewinding time, and launching magic orbs to solve various puzzles. Visual Experience Pages of Time: Prologue has elaborately drawn scenes and character art performance. When the protagonist activates time magic, the visual performance of the scene will undergo surprising changes. Check it out in the beautiful and spectacular Magic Academy. Story Content Experience the rich story presented in AVG and other forms, and feel the friendship of the witches. Each character has beautiful portraits. Game Process In the game process of about 60~90 minutes, accompanied by wonderful music, you will visit the game scenes with different atmospheres and challenge 13 ingeniously conceived puzzle levels.
row.short_description: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.

row.name: Strix STG
row.detailed_description: 'Strix STG' is a 'Communication-Synchronized Bullet-Hell Casual Vertical-Scrolling Shooting-Game'. Let's aim to capture all 5 stages while destroying enemies. You can also choose from 5 levels of difficulty. * Up to stage 2 has been implemented at the start of early access. * There is a possibility that the contents of the stage will be changed until the final version is released. The best feature of this game is the ability to play two-player co-op online. Simple chat with two types of fixed phrases is available, so please use it for role sharing. * Currently, there is no save function for play data, so it is not possible to record the score. I may add a save function in the future based on user feedback. Method of operation menu SHOT key (Z key): Confirm BOMB key (X key): cancel AUTO-SHOT key (C key): Confirm In-game SHOT key (Z key): shot BOMB key (X key): bomb AUTO-SHOT key (C key): Shot START key (ESC key): Pause menu (single play only) COMM1 key (A key): Send the message 'Leave the small enemy to me!' (co-op play only) COMM2 key (S key): Send the message 'Leave the large enemy to me!' (co-op play only) Common F4 key : Force quit the application This game supports some game controllers. (Only 'Real Arcade Pro.V HAYABUSA' has been confirmed to work.) If you have a compatible controller, you can assign any key. Powered by 'Strix Cloud'. Strix Cloud® is a registered trademark of Soft Gear Co., Ltd. in Japan
row.short_description: 'Strix STG' is a 'Communication-Synchronized Bullet-Hell Casual Vertical-Scrolling Shooting-Game'. Let's aim to capture all 5 stages. The best feature of this game is the ability to play two-player co-op online. A simple chat using two types of fixed phrases is prepared for role sharing.

row.name: The Unfound Soul
row.detailed_description: Unlock the ultimate power as you combine artifacts to create even more powerful ones in this turn-based roguelike adventure. Collect over 1000 weapons, armor pieces, and artifacts as you vanquish your foes and rise to the top as the ultimate soul. Experience intricate and deep turn-based combat as you navigate through challenging levels. Test your skills and strategic planning as you discover powerful artifacts and build your ultimate arsenal. With over 1000 items to find , the possibilities are endless. Join the epic quest to become the master of artifacts and dominate the realm.
row.short_description: Unlock the ultimate power as you combine artifacts to create even more powerful ones in this turn-based roguelike adventure. Collect over 1000 weapons, armor pieces, and artifacts as you vanquish your foes and rise to the top as the ultimate soul.

row.name: Super Beast Hunt
row.detailed_description: Super Beast Hunt is a silly little 2D platformer about a Demon who wants to eat Meat! STORY The land of Isle Historia is facing a strange crisis! A Meat shortage plagues the island, and without the help of its guardian, no-one can hunt the dangerous Beasts and retrieve the Meat everyone deserves. Luckily, a Demon known as Merry turns up. She's an excellent Beast Hunter, and she's also very hungry. FEATURES -20 Stages + 4 Secret stages, spread across 5 vastly different worlds. They can get quite tricky, watch out! -5 difficult challenges for Super players, hosted by a Bunny of course. -A simple yet versatile moveset to traverse the many stages with. -Different spells to shoot at Beasts. -3 funny female protagonists! -A crazy variety of Beasts to jump on, attack, defeat and get attacked by. -A wild story with a twist or two. -A silly cast of characters including a Moth-person, a girl who lives inside a TV and even a Skeleton! -Room customisation. It serves no purpose but it's there anyway.
row.short_description: A crazy platformer about a hungry demon girl who wants to eat lots of meat!

row.name: Extreme Tag!
row.detailed_description: Extreme Tag! is a fun, fast-paced platformer party game. Tag is the main gamemode of Extreme Tag!. One player is selected to be IT and will explode after 30 seconds; however, if they run into another player, they pass the bomb on to them, and some extra seconds are added. The last player remaining wins! In Infection, one player is selected to be IT; they must tag other players to convert them into other Infected before the time runs out. If time runs out, everyone not Infected wins! In Hide and Seek, one player is selected to be the Seeker; this player must single-handedly find ALL other players and tag them before time runs out to win. If time runs out, all the other players win! Laser Tag is a free-for-all gamemode where all players must eliminate each other with their Laser Gun to earn points. At certain intervals, one player is selected to be IT; they will then be worth 3 points per kill instead of 1, but they will stay IT until they are eliminated. The first player to score 15 points wins! Create your own maps with our very own map creator! Import an existing .fbx file as a base, then you can add music and change colors on the objects. Customize your player’s shirt, pants, and shoes to be whatever color you desire! Hats are available in the store for purchase, and a few free ones are given to all players. Additionally, as you level up, you can obtain even more hats for free! We encourage players to try out different clothing color themes to best represent themselves in this fun game for all!
row.short_description: Extreme Tag! is a casual party game for all! Run from tagged players to stay alive. Last one standing wins!

row.name: Ranger Quest: The Adventure Begins
row.detailed_description: A fantasy story full of magic and intrigue that will transport you to a different time and place. Ranger Quest is a 2D top down adventure game that combines exploration with the puzzle aspects of a maze. A modern game that incorporates pixel art to create the nostalgia of an 80’s era top down adventure game. No adventure would be complete without doors to open and rooms to explore. Navigate through the maze to find the elemental orbs and the pieces of the magic map. With each orb you find, more of the maze will open up for you to search. Activate shrines and be transported between floors. Only by moving back and forth between floors will you be able to find the correct path and solve the puzzle. The Minotaur Maze Engine takes a classic 2D Maze and reinvents it by having the walls move. A game designed to be enjoyable and challenging for players of all ages. For anyone who has enjoyed the simple pleasure of completing a maze at some point in their lives. The Minotaur Maze Engine brings the classic maze into the 21st century. Developed with the Godot game engine. Music and sound effects obtained from ZapSplat. The Minotaur Maze Engine. The maze where the walls move.
row.short_description: The adventure begins by navigating your way through the Sanctuary of the Orbs. A mysterious quest, the elemental orbs lying in wait for the ranger to claim and an ancient map to be remade. The Sanctuary of the Orbs is no ordinary building as the corridors twist and turn like a maze.

row.name: Seaberry Holiday
row.detailed_description: The holiday festival in Cozy Village is about to begin! Get to know the friendly residents in town while you help everyone prepare for the big event, and do some holiday shopping to get a gift for Chippy's mom. Find some cats, put up holiday decor, window shop, and decorate cookies! Features Point & click gameplay 2D exploration Story voiced in English Multiple endings Raspberry the flying cat mews when you pet her
row.short_description: It's the day of the holiday festival! Help with preparations, decorate buildings and cookies, and choose the perfect gift for Chippy's mom!

row.name: Cursed
row.detailed_description: You enter on a mission to find the book of cursed souls, but quickly find out there's more to it than just being an interesting read. You must explore this forgotten place to find the items to perform the ritual needed to save your life. Features: Increasing difficulty based on progress Unique points of interest to explore... Just don't linger too long & Enough suspense to give you a good spook
row.short_description: Cursed is a scary atmospheric walking simulator game where you'll need to watch your back and solve a mystery

row.name: Alchemia Story
row.detailed_description: Check out our new game! About the Game Alchemia Story is a modern online MMORPG with traditional Japanese-style RPG elements. You can enjoy many adventures in an alchemy world with the support of your partner character 'YOME'! ◆Design your character freely!◆ Create the character you really want! Adjust your character's hairstyle, height, body structure, eyebrow length, eye color and more! ◆You are not alone, explore with YOME◆ Explore with the help of 'YOME'! YOME will quide you to your destination, support you in battles and help with synthesizing items! Customize your YOME like your character, and create your ideal partner! ◆Solo-Player Mode◆ Use the Solo Player Mode feature to play by yourself! If you feel you wouldn't fit in with MMORPG community, it's okay! Use this mode to play more casually by yourself! ◆Easy communication with Like and Stickers!◆ Send a 'Like' for those players who you want to be friends with! Also, 'Sticker' function will make communication faster and easier! Let's make many friends! ◆Battle hard with easy commands!◆ Simply choose your commands to fight! Cooperate with your 'YOME' and defeat the enemies! Challenge the strong enemies with your friends! Maximum of 8 players can join the battle! ◆Unforgettable story and characters!◆ You will be able to join in this fantastic world with unique characters! Enjoy the fascinating RPG story! ◆Ride your Mount and start new adventures!！◆ Get on a Mamono, explore the world and grow stronger together! The Mounts are not just monsters, but also carpets and macarons...!? ★This game is for you if...★ ・You like MMORPG ・You often play MMORPG games ・You like customizing your character ・You enjoy games where you have various Avatars ◆Story◆ 'A world where magic meets alchemy. It's the eve of the Industrial Revolution. The brave people of the cities are about to leave on an adventure to defeat monsters... Join this journey to conquer the demon kings around the world!'
row.short_description: Create the character you really want, and explore the alchemy world with the help of 'YOME'!

row.name: Gemstones
row.detailed_description: Casual Arcade-Puzzle game, where you move gems around to pair them together! Relax and get the highest score possible, earning cosmetics along the way. How to Play: Pair Gemstones Together to get the highest score possible! Swap gems to get them in position to pair together. Each gem has a unique movement pattern! Features: -3 Gamemodes -9 Unique Gems -12 Unlockable Cosmetics -42 Steam Achievements
row.short_description: Casual Arcade-Puzzle game, where you move gems around to pair them together! Relax and get the highest score possible, earning cosmetics along the way.

row.name: Above Snakes: Prologue
row.detailed_description: About the Prologue In Above Snakes: Prologue you play the beginning of Above Snakes and get a feel for what the game plays like. Survival with a Twist In contrast to other survival games, the world is not generated procedurally. Instead, generate it yourself by placing isometric tile world pieces! Start your journey in the small lumberjack settlement of Hunter's Rest and begin crafting the world around you! Create and Survive Determine the landscape of this world inspired by the Wild West and dictate how it will unfold before you. You have the power to decide what’s next. Craft, Cook, Hunt, and Fish To help the people of Hunter's Rest, you can craft necessary tools from newly discovered resources. Advance in leather working, cloth weaving, and more professions to create the best survival supplies for your adventure! Base Building Invest your resources into your very own cabin and establish a base for defense and shelter. Key Features An immersive prologue about an apocalyptic event in a fictional version of the Wild West An isometric world made of world pieces, created by the player throughout their journey Craft, farm, hunt, fish, build bases, and fight in order to stay alive Deep base building system with extensive outdoor and indoor assets Complete quests at your own pace and unravel the secrets of Above Snakes Accessibility Full controller support, key and button rebinding, disable camera shake, disable smooth camera movements, photosensitive mode, custom volume controls for sfx, music, eating noises, and footsteps.
row.short_description: In the prologue of Above Snakes, you awake in a destroyed settlement and help the survivors rebuild it. After that, expand the world with world pieces, craft, farm, hunt, build a base, and fight to find out more about what happened.
row.notes: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages. Some mild violence, blood and general mature content present in the game.

row.name: The Princess of the Tower Wants a Hero
row.detailed_description: Princess Lumi has been held captive in the demon lord’s castle situated in a land of everlasting winter. She hates it. It’s cold, it’s lonely, the food is bad, and there’s literally nothing to do!  The only good thing about this place is the tea and snacks. Princess:  'I know I said I’d help you out, but I am exhausted. I'd be willing to do something else though.' Hero(?): 'Of course! As long as you don’t kick me out of here.' … These are the days of winter they spent together. -20k+ Words -1 Romance Route -1 Good Ending + a couple of bad ends -5 Unique CGs -Partial Voice Acting -Bad Singing -Bonus POV Side Stories
row.short_description: A sweet winter themed Otome Visual Novel about a princess of a tower who just wants a hero. … Except she ends up with a tone-deaf bard for a roommate, a sassy demon for a butler and no hero. Still stuck in a tower though.

row.name: Fire of Life: New Day Playtest
Aviator: Air Combat
row.detailed_description: Don't let the enemy bomber destroy the city. Do whatever it takes to stop it! You are an ordinary farmer who enjoys a peaceful life not far from civilization. One morning you see a plane moving over you, heading towards the town. And all's well and good, but it's military and... enemy... It's time to roll your old single-engine plane out of the barn and remember everything you learned in flight school... All you have to look forward to: 2 maps... 2 bombers Several different types of shells Opportunity to attack the enemy Dozens of difficulty levels And it will all be accompanied by an awesome soundtrack!
row.short_description: Plunge into the world of sky battles. Pursue an enemy bomber while dodging oncoming missiles. Get your adrenaline pumping and be rewarded with a bonus level.

row.name: Siren Head: The Horror Experience
row.detailed_description: Siren Head - The Horror Experience While working the late shift at the Police Department, you receive a report about some teenagers that went missing in Windermere Woods. Old folk tales mention these woods, and of a monster that is said to lurk there, but those are just stories... right? It is your job to find these teens, but you did not imagine the horrors you would face. The old folks tale states that the mythical monster surrounds its habitat with siren noises of all kinds, luring unsuspecting victims. You must navigate Windermere Woods with torch in hand, leaving the bright lights of the road and venture into the darkness. Find the teens, or their belongings and try get back to your car unharmed. But will your mind let you rest while you sleep? Features Atmospheric and Immersive Environment First Person Perspective Scary Atmosphere Amazing Sound Design Slender Man-Esque Game Play Jump Scares
row.short_description: Some teenagers have gone camping in the woods far out of town after hearing an old folks tale about a monster lurking within the woods. The monster surrounds its habitat with horrifying and distorted siren noises.

row.name: VR Archeology: Secrets of Kulikovo Field
row.detailed_description: Fought on September 8, 1380, the Battle of Kulikovo is considered one of the biggest events of the 14th century that united Rus peoples. Scientists continue searching for traces of the battle. Now you can also join an archaeological expedition, find and restore artifacts to re-enact those historical events. Swords and spears, armor and arrows, coins and bullets. Dig into the artifacts from different eras with the opportunities offered by a field laboratory. Game developers spent time in the Kulikovo Field Museum depository to recreate accurate copies of real archaeological finds collected over decades. Learn about Russian warriors’ full armor and its actual weight, and archers’ medieval multitool. You can witness scenes from across the ages that the Kulikovo Field remembers. Reconstruct a combat bow and test it at a shooting range. Pick an arrowhead to hit different types of armor. Practice your aiming skills and get promoted to the next military rank.
row.short_description: What mysteries and keys to historical secrets are hidden underground? In this interactive VR game, you will explore the roles of modern archaeologists, restoration experts and re-enactors. Discover dozens of unique artifacts dating back to the Battle of Kulikovo on this thrilling expedition.

row.name: Sapiens League
row.detailed_description: Challenge your knowledge against your friends or players from around the world and try to become the best Sapiens by reaching the top of the leaderboard! A Sapiens League match is a multiplayer game based on general knowledge mini-games. Three 3-minute rounds are played, and to win, players must find the most correct answers within the given time limit. Between each mini-game, players gather in an arena with courses, a soccer field, a mirror to change appearance, and other activities... Solo game modes are also available, such as the infinity mode and the training mode. The game is still in development and more features will be added over time! Game Features Online multiplayer : compete against players from around the world in ranked Sapiens League matches with a matchmaking system. Play with friends: challenge your friends in private matches and choose which mini-games to play. Infinity mode : an endless game mode where players try to achieve the highest score possible by answering as many questions as quickly as possible. As long as you don't lose all three lives, the game continues. A leaderboard allows players to compare their scores to others. Become better : improve and progress at your own pace in the training mode. Sapiens Arena : catch your breath between rounds in the arena. Meet other players for a game of soccer, a giant piano piece, obstacle courses, or just to change your appearance! Cross-platform : play with active players on other platforms (Android, iOS, PC, MacOS). Mini-games The Corridor of 1000 Doors: to travel down the infinite corridor without slowing down, players must solve increasingly complex mental arithmetic questions. 1 operation, 3 answer choices. Speed up to get ahead of your competitors. Globe-trotter: move around a giant atlas to position yourself on countries, capitals, flags, or monuments mentioned. Speed, accuracy, and dexterity are as essential as knowledge of geographic landmarks to win the game. Chronological Duel: order a set of historical dates without making any mistakes to move on to the next set. From the publication of the first volume of One Piece to the coronation of Charlemagne, all dates are worth remembering! Tower of Words: spin the rolls to spell the sentences on the pillars correctly. If you succeed, you ascend to space. Get your Bescherelle and reach for the stars and beyond!
row.short_description: Play for free and compare your skills with friends in this exciting competitive multiplayer game.

row.name: The Hellchemist
row.detailed_description: Picture: Flavor Text: In a world ravaged by wars, people sought shelter underground but some dug too deep and too greedily, now they must fight in the arena of The Sun God to prove their worth. The Hellchemist is an intense pve arena shooter where you will fight waves of monsters while one completely random event will happen every 10 seconds. The game is heavily inspired by Doom, Quake and Devil Daggers. Hellchemist Features: Test your might against many unique enemies. Kill said enemies with a wide variety of weapons. Random Events that change the game every 10 seconds. Ever evolving play area. Survive Long enough to reach the top of the Leaderboard. Old school movement that allows for bunny hops and speed boosts. Modernized old school graphics. Intense Heavy Metal Music Created by Meithius. Explosions
row.short_description: The Hellchemist is an intense pve arena shooter where you will fight waves of monsters while random events will alter the way you have to play the game and makes every run unique. The game is heavily inspired by Doom and Quake. Bunny hops, shooting and a whole lot of explosions!

row.name: JUNK! A Demo About Robots Playtest
Monster Racing League
row.detailed_description: Monster Racing League is a multiplayer combat racing game where you don’t have to steer. Harness the power of your monsters to attack and defend your way to the finish line. It's chaos, mayhem, and non-stop fun all rolled into one! Gameplay - Driving Done Differently Monster Racing League is not your usual racing game! In Monster Racing League the driving is streamlined and the focus is on combat. Select your monster and equip your abilities and boosters before each race. Control your position on the track and strategically play your offensive and defensive abilities against your monster rivals. Abilities have cooldown and recharge times so make sure you choose the right boosters for maximum impact! Master your racing skills with finer control using nitro, braking and steering (coming soon). Get in on the action with races contested over short, multi rounds of mayhem with up to 10 players. The monster with the most points at the end takes home the glory! Rack up Knucklebones as you compete, unlocking new monsters and upgrades along the way. Experience the thrill of Monster Racing League with friends! Compete in online multiplayer lobbies or host your own games and invite your pals. With practice mode available, train against a variety of in-house monsters and hone your skills. Monsters Monsters are your drivers. Each monster comes with its own set of unlockable abilities and upgrades. Collect more monsters to access a wider range of awesome abilities and boosters. Unleash your inner collector with Monster Racing League's highly customisable monsters! Drawing inspiration from designer vinyl toys, each monster is a desirable item that you'll want to add to your collection. Configure the look of your monsters through extensive customisation options including helmets, horns, faces, armour, colours, cars and many more. Get ready to create your ultimate monster driving team! For the ultimate collectors out there, don't miss out on the Premium Monster Supporters Pack, featuring exclusive materials and unlocked abilities that will stand out on the track. Look out for more themed monster item packs coming soon, all available as Steam DLC. Tracks Monster Racing League is also about the tracks. With unique features and themes, each one is a wild ride of its own. Different tracks can match different monsters' abilities, strategies and play styles. So if you want to come out on top, you’ll need to learn the twists and turns of each one. Right now, there are two kinds of tracks, multi-lap loop tracks and point-to-point sprints, but lookout for some more hectic rides coming soon. Streaming Gear up for Monster Racing League! It's the perfect game for both spectators and streamers. Races are short and sweet and packed with non-stop action. In spectator mode (coming soon) you can use custom cameras to capture all the epic moments and share them with your audience. In-game monster taunts are perfect for fueling player rivalries and showboating on the track. Grab some friends and go for a burn, with multiplayer mode you can host your own races and stream to your heart's content!
row.short_description: Monster Racing League is a multiplayer combat racing game where you don’t have to steer. Harness the power of your monsters to attack and defend your way to the finish line. It's chaos, mayhem, and non-stop fun all rolled into one!

row.name: Of Frost and Flowers
row.detailed_description: In the early world of Gaia, the capability to use magic is determined by birth, creating a rift between magic and non-magic users. Yet despite the rift, an organization stepped up with a purpose of making magic accessible to everyone: The Crysmalia Project. The story starts with Alto, a craftswoman who joined Zethania's Knights to search for her missing childhood friend. Upon joining them, however, Alto stumbled upon a secret she should not have known, and now her life is on the line... Features: 70,000 words 14 CGs Kisha and Sol's route + 1 mystery route (unlocked after you play the two routes) Team Project Leader: Elseth Sprite & Main Menu Artist: Apririnn Original BG Artists: Kat, Yana OST Composer: Iestyn CG Colorist: tashaj4de Writers: Elseth, Tetora, Llem GUI Artist: tatapb Logo Artist: Kat Proofreaders: lethologicalee, KuroKairin, Selene, WholesomeWraith, Zelan Free BGs: k-after.at.webry, 7b.biglobe.ne.jp, pexels, Izuru Tadafuji Free music / SFX: ontama-m, freesound, freesfx
row.short_description: An otome-fantasy visual novel. Play as Alto, a fearless knight, and enter a world of magic and myths with secrets waiting for you to unveil.

row.name: Roller Champions™
row.detailed_description: Skate, tackle, and roll your way up to glory in Roller Champions™. Discover a free-to-play, team PvP sports game like no other! Welcome to 2032. Arenas are built all over the world and fans rush to the stands to admire their modern-day heroes, the Roller Champions. They roll up to 100 miles an hour, tackle opponents, wall-skate, and dunk while thousands of fans scream their names. As a Roller Champion, compete in a team of three against three. The rules are simple: take the ball, make a lap while maintaining team possession, dodge opponents, and score. Go for more points by completing additional laps before attempting a goal. After each match, gain fans to compete in bigger arenas. Customize characters and create a unique destiny. GATHER YOUR TEAM AND COMPETE Team up with two players and dive into Roller Champions’ gameplay, which combines fun competitive action and collaborative team play. Go head-to-head against the opposing team through speed, wit, crushing tackles, and daring dodges to lap around the arena and be the first team to reach 5 points by throwing the ball through the hoop. Feel the thrill of riding up and down the wall of the arena as you gain speed, quickly stop, pivot, and re-position as your teammates race towards the goal, just one pass away from winning or one interception away from having to start all over again. FROM ZERO TO HERO – BUILD A LIFE OF A WORLD-RENOWNED ATHLETE Write your own legend. Start your sports career as the underdog and roll up to glory as you win matches. Obtain more fans in arena bleachers as you complete spectacular actions and progress to bigger stadiums. Write your name in Roller Champions’ history books as you climb up the leaderboards. Progress through Roller Champions’ ranked mode from Garage league all the way to the Elite Champions’ league. Compete in thrilling time-limited special game mode to gain fans or special lootballs. CREATE AND FULLY CUSTOMIZE YOUR SPORT LEGEND Create your own character and customize your outfit as you progress. Unlock new items, including skates, helmets, fresh attires, gloves, goal effects, emotes, air poses, player titles and banners. Progress through the Roller Pass to gain season-exclusive items, spectacular goal FX and emotes, lootballs and in-game currency (wheels). COME HANG IN THE SKATEPARK Roller Champions’ social hub is THE place to be to meet up and learn the ropes with your friends! Roll around, practice scoring and learn new tricks. Participate to time-limited minigames.
row.short_description: Skate and roll your way up to glory in Roller Champions™. Discover a free-to-play, team PvP sports game like no other!

row.name: SnekMP
row.detailed_description: Compete with your friends in the most brutal(no) snek fight in the history of mankind! Show who has the largest Snek from your company! Grow your snek by eating food pellets ! The first Snek to reach a size of 15 blocks wins! Don't know how to handle a big, fat snek? No worries, if you can't win, make your opponent lose! Ez Pz
row.short_description: Did you ever have a dispute with a friend? Finally there is a way to sort out whos Snek is BIGGER!However, in SnekMP bigger does not necessarily mean better! Having a huge C... khm... Snek definitely helps, but you will also need to be quite agile to win!

row.name: Bounty
row.detailed_description: A student project made in Unreal Engine 4 at SAE Expression College. A demo level from our game Bounty. Bounty is a first-person shooter bounty-hunting game. The player lands on a space station overrun with robotic bounty hunters. The player must locate and kill the bounty. The player is equipped with a six-shooter that shoots explosive rounds. The player fights through the robot bounty hunters to claim the ultimate prize, his reward. The game is a tactical first-person game. The robots are just as deadly as the six shooters the character wields. The player uses a cover system to avoid being shot. The cover system allows the player to return fire in a deadly firefight a little more safely. The game's plot is to create a mix of wild west gunslingers in a future period. The story behind this bounty hunter is that his father owes money to an intergalactic crime syndicate. This bounty is the “last” job for the crime family before he can free his father from his debt or so he thinks.
row.short_description: A sci-fi first-person shooter with a dynamic deployable cover system. A demo level from our game Bounty.

row.name: HOSPICE Vol. 1
row.detailed_description: ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Next Stop, Happy Life! Deli truly believes that life is a merry-go-round. When we get married, we're going to ride on the bus that we call life. Living like there's no tomorrow.⠀ But there is NO tomorrow. And life is a lie. And ride we're looking for going down the road. He believes that he can stop. But no one can stop the time. Nobody can stop the bus. We're just waiting, we're sitting. - Why? Because, we're not going - we're lea-living. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Dead End Club Ends up here... Here is the place for everyone. Place for misfortune , shame and regret . And the club's authority is asking you to take your sit at the table. Hospice is the play of light and shadows. Now is your time to turn the tables. Now is your time to turn on the light. DEVI: - No, isn't yours, silly. It's mine. - Your time will be next time. AKI: - Was it the last time? And if you thought that these inner demons were your biggest issue. Outside is MUCH many demons. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ My Little Sister Can't Be Life goes on. And so we're going for another story, another people, and another day... No, not another time, not any time. He made today-me. Today. I made this game to pay him back. This game is a tribute to Tsukasa Fushimi . The visual novel created with salt and gold. The soulless creature made with soul. ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ♡ﮩ٨ـﮩﮩ٨ـ Features: ✙ Not a siscon, but a story about siscon living like one and losing. ✙ Different look at characters, and MORE characters... looking back at you. ✙ With numerous color illustrations of society and unsociable. ✙ Not the 'ruining', but creating life experience. ✙ Nothing and one femboy . There may be no next time.
row.short_description: Hospice is a kinetic visual novel game about pure brother without his little sister, a men with no hope, a place with no home.
row.notes: This game could contain cartoon violence and trash talk.

row.name: Mindworks: The Great Division
row.detailed_description: A visual novel based on science and art, real life events and how humans tend to spread a false ideology of knowledge. Welcome to the Mindworks universe! In a universe vastly different from our own, humankind is ruled by science and art. These disciplines lived in partial unity, enough for the universe to function, prosper and evolve. Until a new discipline emerges, challenging their ability to stay together under severe circumstances and harsh pasts. Each and every one of your choices will determine whether humankind will fall or rise again, since their fate is closely intertwined with the disciplines' unity or complete division. The key to eternal knowledge is in your hands. Choose wisely. Multiple Outcomes: Three outcomes that are based on your choices which will decide whether the disciplines will end up being united, divided, or partially united Different types of choices: From major choices, to timed choices, to split choices, all will affect your plotline Webcomic Meets Visual Novel: Sprites containing fully drawn scenes and animations that mimic that style of modern webcomics Music room: A special page in-game containing official Mindworks soundtracks to be unlocked and enjoyed Extra content: Unlock concept art, character info, and music in the music room
row.short_description: A choice-based visual novel game about science, division, and the false ideology of knowledge. Each and every one of your choices will determine whether the disciplines will end in unity or complete division. The key to eternal knowledge is in your hands.

row.name: Leaf Blower Man: This Game Blows!
row.detailed_description: Buzz About the Game Leaf Blower Man is a arcade-action game. Not only will you pointlessly blow leaves from one end of the driveway to the other, you will also earn points by annoying the heck out of your neighbors! A dramatic story will lead you through a variety of environments and challenges; perhaps you might even save humanity? Replay the short campaign to get MORE points and beat it FASTER! Will you be the bestest Leaf Blower Person? Aside from the main campaing, enjoy a Horde Mode and fight against an ever-increasing number of militant leaves. Destroy thousands of enemies, strategically gain experience, choose new power-ups / weapons, and try to survive long enough to get to the final Leaf King. Will you topple the tyranny of autumn? Leaf Blower Man provides a fantastic experience without any pay-to-win microtransactions. Any additional packages available for purchase are completely optional and do not provide any gameplay advantages. We are committed to committing towards this commitment.
row.short_description: Blow leaves at 6am on a Sunday and earn points by annoying all the neighbors. But beware - unexpected challenges await on your journey to rid the world of leaves!

row.name: Zako Slayer
row.detailed_description: Story A female super soldier, sleeping in a base, was released by accident during an attack by unknown intruders. Her memory is lost; she doesn't know who she is. The objective is to break through the enemies and escape from the base. Genre 2D Platformer, shooting in bullet hell style with hack and slash. Game play Close and range combat - Close combat with a sword like a warrior. - Shooting in Bullet hell style. Take cover behind an object, even the bodies of enemies and friends. - Sneak behind the enemies and attack them from behind or above. - Complex enemies' behavior. About 10-20 minute of gameplay.
row.short_description: You are a female super soldier trying to escape from the invaded base by unknown intruders. (A 2D Sci-fi Platformer, Megaman-like style, but with hack and slash.)
row.notes: Blood, gore, and dismemberment

row.name: Turn back the clock：Hsinchu
row.detailed_description: 'Turn back the clock：Hsinchu' takes the historical time and space of Hsinchu City, Taiwan as the background of the game. The story revolves around the common adventure between a contemporary historian and an agent of the Time and Space Security Bureau from the future. In the plot, the player needs to alternately play the two protagonists, using a dual-perspective method, to gradually explore the truth of the event in the process of rectifying and repairing historical events. The scene design of this game is based on real historical time and space, creating a very high sense of immersion in the age, allowing players to experience the historical time and space changes and cultural connotations of Hsinchu City while playing. Feature of the product: ■Distinctive art style: The game art is realized in a simple Low Poly style, which simply but completely retains the architectural and humanistic characteristics of Hsinchu in various eras. ■Through the plot based on historical facts: We invite professional film and television screenwriters Monica and Shaballe to write, and plan chapters in the mode of unit drama. The game plot is based on historical events, supplemented by a sci-fi time-space travel worldview, allowing players to have more magical imagination space for established historical events. ■Double protagonist line: Players can choose the characters to play according to the progress of the plot, and experience the same script from different character perspectives as the starting point. The two protagonists will also experience conflict, cooperation, choice, and other plots, adding a touch to the script color. ■Abundant action and puzzle-solving elements: The game is not limited to static observation and puzzle-solving, but also has dynamic action elements for players to complete when encountering emergencies. ■360 Surround View Video Appreciation: Provides five scenic spots with 4K high-resolution stereo shooting in VR 180/360, players can see the current situation of Hsinchu scenic spots.
row.short_description: This is a VR story exploration game with Hsinchu City, Taiwan as the main stage. The story is based on historical events in the Hsinchu area, supplemented by sci-fi elements of time travel to construct the entire worldview. The game adopts a dual-protagonist line.

row.name: Wind Up
row.detailed_description: Let's enter the wonderful world of Wind Up! In this haunted castle, you will get suspicious of each other as clockwork dolls. Here you will experience—— ※Day-Night Cycle The day is clockwork dolls' home field, while the night is the stage of the imposters. Judge the situation to gain advantages for your team. ※Cooperation and Escape Work together to complete the tasks, find the exit, and race against time to escape from the castle. Enjoy the sense of accomplishment brought by the teamwork! ※Hunt and Survival Imposters will show their true appearances and kill clockwork dolls when night falls. Clockwork dolls need to use all means to survive. An exciting chase will happen at night! ※Hotly Debate During the day, clockwork dolls have the right to hold a meeting to accuse someone. You can argue fiercely, and persuade others to vote for your rivals and expel them.
row.short_description: Wind Up is a multiplayer game focusing on social deduction, cooperation, and betrayal. In a complex haunted castle, the clockwork dolls outsmart imposters hiding among them. Who can escape the castle? Who will be banished? Who will be killed by imposters when night falls...

row.name: Death Swap: End As One
row.detailed_description: FRIENDS WHO STAY TOGETHER, DIE TOGETHER Death Swap is a first person online co-op horror game where you are stuck in a secret science facility with a horrific monster! Work as a team to save each other by swapping positions with the creature. Communicate with one another to solve tasks in order to survive and escape the science facility! Features Escape together - The players have to escape together from a secret science facility where a gory monster has broken free. Avoid being caught by the monster and being killed in a gory way. Communicate and discuss with your friend to develop a strong strategy to escape together! Swap - Do you want to save your dear beloved friend from a horrible death? Help him by swapping positions with the monster! Or do you wanna give him a scare to swap with him at the last second? Complete tasks - You have to repair the broken elevator to escape from the science facility! But you don’t know how? Complete tasks with your friend to find items to repair the elevator. Chasing monster - The monster is faster than you! Create a strategy to avoid the monster and not get caught by him. WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES - READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game. IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms. You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued. MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION The developers describe the content like this: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
row.short_description: Death Swap is a first person online co-op horror game where you are stuck in a secret science facility with a horrific monster! Work as a team to save each other by swapping positions with the creature. Communicate with one another to solve tasks in order to survive and escape the science facility!

row.name: MopGarden's Veggie Cart
row.detailed_description: MopGarden’s Veggie Cart is a fast-paced, simulation game where you feed hungry bunnies lots of healthy vegetables! Can you feed them all in time? MopGarden, a variety Twitch streamer, has decided to feed all the local bunnies in her town. As business begins to boom, she moves her veggie cart to other surrounding areas, where the vegetable orders get faster, and faster , and FASTER . Features Play through 4+ different worlds, each with varying difficulties. Bunnies are hungrier and more demanding at different times of day! Test your visual skills and reaction time. As you progress through the game, it gets harder and harder to determine what the bunnies are ordering Look out for other pesky animals! Other animals will drop in to throw a wrench into the vegetable orders. No bad stuff! This game is completely free to play. No advertisements, in-app purchases, or anything of the sort. No animals were harmed in the making of this game!
row.short_description: MopGarden’s Veggie Cart is a fast-paced, simulation game where you feed hungry bunnies lots of healthy vegetables! Can you feed them all in time?

row.name: My Last 20
row.detailed_description: EMBARK THE 'MY LAST 20' MISSION THE COMPANY urgently seeks brave astronauts to enlist on the 'My Last 20' mission. Your objective: extract as many Space Tokens as possible from the Chaos Zone and survive for a ONLY 20 seconds. This mission posses life insurace in case of death.  Are you that brave astronaut? GAMEMODES 🌀 Chaos Zone In My Last 20’s Missions, you’ll face 20 seconds of pure arcade madness. Asteroids? Cows? Tentacles? Each chaos zone is different with it's own difficulty and only the fastest astronauts will make it out alive. ♾️ Endless Arcade Mode Unlimited survival time with power-ups and 3 shields to keep you going. Beat your best run and climb the leaderboards. 🏆 Hardcore Challenges Complete absurd challenges like 'Cook 100 cows with a bomb!' and win extra free rewards. 🎨 Unique Skins Unlock weird and increible skins, you can play as a Double Cheese burger, as a Avocado and even as a Rubber Duck!! WHO ARE YOU? The identity of the person behind the helmet remains a mystery but one thing is certain: sanity is not a quality of you. You are the only one who enlisted willingly to this mission and survived at least twice. KEY FEATURES INCREDIBLY HARD : Being able to complete the My Last 20 mission is not a easy task. 20 seconds sounds like a short time but have to avoid even cows makes it challenging. QUICK GAMEPLAY:  Perfect for those who like to test their reflexes and having to react in matter of seconds to avoid being killed by a Space Tentacle . CRAZY LOOKING GRAPHICS:  A combination of modern and retro pixel art graphics with unique and weird characters make a perfect combination for a real trip.  MULTIPLE CHALLENGES: Play the main missions, complete hard challenges or play endlessly without time limitations and score your best time. AMAZING MUSIC : A perfect blend of nostalgia and space feel all thanks to  Lukasz (X-Ray) Sychowicz to his song Zizibum
row.short_description: A brutal Bullet Hell arcade experience where 20 SECONDS is all you get to WIN. Dodge cows, tentacles & asteroids while grabbing space tokens in pure chaos. Are you ready to complete the most intense space mission ever??
row.reviews: “Think you have the reflexes to survive in deep space while dodging asteroids at lightning speed? In My Last 20 by @DroidGamestd , every second counts. The goal? Stay alive for 20. The reality? Good luck 💀” GX.Games

row.name: Slime Evolution
row.detailed_description: You are a slime. Eat resources to determine your starting element then fight monsters and evolve to get stronger. The stronger you become, the more monsters will be drawn to you. Can you survive their ever increasing amounts and new monsters joining in to hunt you down? But those that unsettle the balance of the forest might draw unwanted attention. You play a slime that eats resources and monsters to grow stronger. Move around the map to attack them, but don't get too close or they might overwhelm you. Survive for as long as you can, because once you die it is all over. No progress carries over and you will start over from scratch. Go down 7 different elemental paths to defeat your enemies and consume their drops to evolve even further to fight the onslaught of new enemies that appear the stronger you get.
row.short_description: A survival roguelike where you play a slime wandering a forest. As you eat resources and fight monsters, you evolve and get ever stronger! But as you unbalance the forest and draw attention of stronger opponents, how long can you survive?

row.name: Wyoming Winter
row.detailed_description: In Wyoming Winter you and a group of fellow employees find yourselves snowed in to the Wyoming department of defence building as a blizzard covers the state. You'll soon find out your group is not the only thing trapped in the building. Find unique hiding spots, help your fellow employees, complete risky lockdown tasks and find a weapon to fight back. Hide in. Hold out. Don't be found. Wyoming Winter is a multiplayer game where one person in the lobby is chosen at random to be the Blight, an almost invincible, fast moving, dark creature that escaped from the lower levels of the Wyoming facility. The rest of the players are employees who's job it is to stop the Blight from escaping the facility. Employees need to kill the Blight before the 10 minutes timer is over or the director of the department will have no choice but to detonate the on site nuclear bomb, killing everyone. Wyoming Winter is best played with 3-8 players. Servers are available in Europe, America & Asia. Employee's start with a notepad of tasks and a watch. The notebook contains a list of tasks to be completed before the employee is given a final task to locate a weapon. The watch shows how much time is lef t until the on-site nuclear bomb detonates, killing everyone, the employees must kill the Blight before this timer ends or face nuclear destruction. The Blight has heightened vision and can see well in dark places along with incredible strength that allows it to snap the neck of any employee in an instant. Both the Blight & employees can climb and crouch into unique and crafty hiding places using the climbing system.
row.short_description: A group of employees find themselves snowed in to the Wyoming department of defence building as a blizzard covers the state. You'll soon find out your group is not the only thing trapped in the building.

row.name: Falsepine
row.detailed_description: Falsepine is a fast-paced action roguelike focusing on difficult combat and exploration. Developed by Voyager Softworks, as a part of our final year at University, Falsepine is a labor of love, pulling all the passion and drive from the team into a brutal and rewarding action roguelike. Hunt Legendary Creatures Falsepine places you in the role of a lineage of monster hunters tasked with tracking down and defeating 5 legendary creatures across the untamed West. Use all your wits and skill to combat these dangerous foes and emerge victorious. Explore a Brutal World Explore a variety of unique locales from the snowy Grizzly Peaks to the dusty Arid Badlands . Track down and collect clues and journals detailing the rich history of each monster. Each clue found may be the key to your success or defeat in the grand showdown against these legendary creatures. Plan Ahead Prepare for the journey ahead in the town of Falsepine, purchase weapons and equipment at Gold and Irons, buy drinks and clues at the Crossroads Saloon, store valuable items at Falsepine Bank, and finally equip gear and take on unique bounties at the Hunters Camp. Once you leave for your hunt there is no turning back. Create a Hunter Unique to You Falsepine offers a variety of playstyles to suit all types of hunters. Do you want to be an unstoppable pickaxe-wielding barbarian or perhaps an agile high-damage sniper? Utilize 35 different weapons and tools, pairing them with a variety of Talismans and Artifacts to create different builds for every new adventure. Complete a Variety of Bounties Take on a variety of bounty missions, each affecting how you will approach an expedition. Hunters that complete the most challenging bounties will be rewarded with unique and powerful Legendary weapons ranging from rapid-fire crossbows to double-action hand cannons.
row.short_description: Join a long lineage of Hunters as you run and gun through the Wild West in this action rogue-like. Take on Bounties, Unlock powerful weapons, and come face-to-face with a gallery of terrifying monsters. Developed by Voyager Softworks, as a part of our final year at University.

row.name: X Invader: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Follow & Add to your wishlist! More upgrade abilities, weapons, bosses and maps are available! About the Game ■ Discord Free version of X Invader, an Action Rogue-lite game. Combining various hacking add-ons to get rid of the boss who is interfering with hacking! ■ The Battle of individual properties through a combination of the various play styles. ► Create a new build for every sale with random choices and rewards. ■ Rogue-lite That Really Comfortable Game. ► A short 15-minute play time that allows users to play repeatedly.. ■ Great Pixel Arts. ■ Fast Adaptable Game Control. ► Users can play games only with WASD, mouse, and spacebar. ■ Features supported by the prologue version. ► Two weapons. ► Four Add-ons. ► Five Avatars. ► One map. ► Session time within 10 minutes ■ Full version to be supported ► 1 more weapon ► Addition of 2 Add-ons ► 3 more bosses ► 10 more minutes of play time ► Add more than 100 hacking add-on nodes ► 8 types of monsters added ► Add on relics ► Ultimate and synergy Add-on ► And... Additional content with updates after release of the full release ■ Use free sounds 1. Song: ORANGE PRODUCTION - Old Street (No Copyright Music) Music provided by Tunetank. Free Download: Video Link: ■ Thanks to Jeep Barnett : English translation advice Hyonide : Sound
row.short_description: Free version of X Invader, an Action Rogue-lite game. Become a master hacker 'X' and hack into the digital world. Use a variety of weapons and hacking add-ons to create your own combat build and wipe out disturbing enemies. Please enjoy the hack and slash action!

row.name: Virago: Herstory
row.detailed_description: After running away from home, a little girl called Willow finds herself to be a victim of stalking Play as Willow in our widely known Virago game, an indie adventure game that tells a story about a girl who after escaping her abusive mother after her divorce, becomes a victim of notorious stalking that affects her psychologically and emotionally. Virago herstory is a 2d adventure platformer with black and white graphics. It has been critically acclaimed for original art, soundtrack and story.
row.short_description: Virago herstory is about a little girl called Willow who after running away from her home becomes a victim of stalking

row.name: NanoWar: Cells VS Virus
row.detailed_description: Fight against the viruses and cure the entire body! A fast-paced real-time strategy game of cell conquest. The Nano War series has already been played by millions of people on the web since 2008. In Nano War you have to conquer infected territories. Send your units to capture the other cells and increase your power to defeat the enemies. It's an intuitive game, user friendly/easy to play, highly addictive and for everyone! STORY Once upon a time in a human body. Thousands of nanoscopic cells lived peacefully for many generations. Among these cells, there is the mother cell, the very first cell and the one that gave birth to all. Three of the most destructive group of viruses had managed to infect the mother cell. The mother cell was forced to produce countless infected cells. But local cells didn't yield and prepared to fight back. We need to defeat all evil and quickly restore balance!!! The Nano War has begun!
row.short_description: Fight against the viruses and cure the entire body! A fast-paced real-time strategy game of cell conquest. Lot of players already got the bug... ready to defend your cells?

row.name: Retail Wars
row.detailed_description: The most realistic retail experience ever created is here! Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining competitive party game where you can pickup and throw any item in the store to either serve customers and gain commission or to sabotage and knock-out your friends. Compete on a range of hazardous work environments, deal with aggressive customers, and out-sell each other in the vicious fight to become employee of the month! Key Features: Throw ANY item in the store to serve customers or knock-out other players! Take advantage of unique map hazards to turn the tide of the match! Up to 4 players can get into the action quickly with simple control schemes! Customise your character from a range of quirky options! Dozens of items available, each with different traits and properties! Jump into 2 wacky maps! Want to play online with your friends? Use Steam Remote Play! Simply get one player to launch the game and then invite everyone else in! Each player will require a controller. Ready to clock in and become employee of the month? Your shift starts now!
row.short_description: Retail Wars is a friendship-ruining 4 player couch competitive party game. Pickup and throw anything in the store to serve customers and knock out your friends in the fight to become the coveted employee of the month!

row.name: MetaBall - Multiplayer Basketball
row.detailed_description: Metaball is a free-to-play, crossplay-enabled online multiplayer sports game that combines fast-paced movements, thrilling PvP matches, and advanced team play. You play as a Rider, trying to bring fame and wealth to his name by winning merciless Metaball League games with his teammates and collecting Metanium and MVP points. Hop on your hoverboard, grab the ball with your chain, and use its swinging power to perform diverse actions. Dunk, shoot, block, and steal the ball while using the nitro to boost your speed or perform double or triple jumps! Use your Perk Points in different Perk Trees to customize your play style! Compete against other riders in various PvP game modes, including 2v2 and 3v3 Quick Matches, or hone your skills in Academy, Champion Road, Free Play, or Custom Match modes! After each match, you will receive MVP points depending on the result. So make sure to win and to be the best Rider to receive a bonus! The more you have MVP points, the more you will unlock rewards! With your hard-earned Metanium and M VP points, progress in the Metapass, and try to collect your favorite equipment and items to use in the game! Items shown may require separate purchases from the in-game store and are subject to availability. Contains in-game purchases.
row.short_description: Experience the thrill of Hoverboard Basketball! Team up or challenge players worldwide in fast-paced crossplay PvP matches. Master the ball, dribble, and outwit your opponents to score impressive goals— with no aim assist. Only skill and creativity matter. Grab your Hoverboard and dominate now!
