row.name: ARTificial
row.detailed_description: Visit the home of an artist you admire and talk to the paintings, and uncover the secrets he is hiding. It's a first-person thriller room escape game made in 3D. Click the arrow to look around the room. You will be a girl who visits the home of an artist you respect and solve various puzzles. 1. You can learn various things that an artist has at home. 2. You can disassemble, combine, or use acquired items. Items in use are displayed in the lower right ui. 3. The various paintings hanging in the artist's house can talk to you and interact with the objects you have acquired. 4. If you do the painting's favor, they will reward you. Solve the puzzle with their reward. 5. The more you solve the puzzle, the more you will learn the secrets of the artist.
row.short_description: Dig into the truth hidden in the artist's strange paintings through the puzzle.

row.name: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE
row.detailed_description: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden. FROM SWEDEN WITH LOVE Welcome to Härunga – a small industrial town in the bible belt of the mid–north of Sweden. You play as Sara, an aspiring writer who, after having been away for 10 years, returns home in order to investigate the tragic fate of her estranged best friend. The days grow short quickly this far up north – and the rain never seems to let up... HÄRUNGA FOREVER Lovingly crafted and richly animated, explore the melancholy atmosphere of a small town that time seemingly forgot. Meet old friends and enemies and piece together the mystery of what happened after your friendship tragically fell apart. As in life, what you say will impact things in hidden ways and not everything may be as it seems. Who is telling whose truth and can you know the difference?
row.short_description: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden.
row.reviews: “A mature and thought-provoking tale that will resonate with many people long after it has been completed.” Keen Gamer “How We Know We're Alive will break your heart.” The Indie Games Website “A deeply touching and emotional game that really hits hard. Highly recommended.” Alpha Beta Gamer
row.notes: Discussions of and reference to suicide, alcoholism, racism and homophobia.

row.name: ZaBaTa!
row.detailed_description: ■ ABOUT THIS GAME ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game that you can enjoy with friends. Keep an eye out to find real players hidden among AI NPCs, and become the last human player standing! Watch out though! Blend in so YOU don't get caught either. Which ones are human? All NPCs appearing in ZaBaTa! use Deep Learning to implement their movements. The character that just passed by, was that a human player or an AI? Find the 'real' players hidden among many AIs! Complete missions faster than everyone else! Certain missions are only for the human players. Complete the missions quickly but remember to act natural and blend in to avoid getting caught! Pretend you're an AI NPC Give your best performance and trick other players. Feel the adrenaline rush of deceiving other humans to win! If you spot a 'real' player, approach them... and attack! Think you found a real player? Approach them - but be careful, they might catch you first! ZaBaTa! is even more fun when you play it with friends! Play Now! ■ Game Features Solo or team modes available. ZaBaTa! can be played in two maps for solo/team battles. Compete with your friends in many different ways! We will keep updating and adding new game modes. Special missions add suspense to the guessing game! Blend in to complete missions without being caught by other human players. You have to keep up the acting until you are the last human standing! Charming characters and unique costumes Tons of cosmetics available for character customization! Make one-of-a-kind avatar and enjoy ZaBaTa!
row.short_description: ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game where you must find human players hidden among AI NPCs. Blend in, complete missions, and most importantly - don't get caught! Play ZaBaTa! with friends for even more fun.

row.name: The Swarm
row.detailed_description: The swarm is an Abysal Boss rush. Defeat your enemy, upgrade your stats, go to the next boss and repeat ! use your remaining life points (materialized by little glowing fireflies) to deal damage. You can only be killed if there is no more firefly surrouding you. How many creatures will you deafeat before being vaniquished ? The Game is still in BETA. Upcoming Updates will add new contents but all the main Gameplay mechanics are already there.
row.short_description: The Swarm is an abyssal boss rush. Defeat your enemy, upgrade your skills, start over.

row.name: Keeper Of The Valley
row.detailed_description: Jump, glide and dash your way to the top of the mountain in this 3D adventure platformer set in an open and enchanting valley! You play as Sky, the Keeper's apprentice, who must venture into the Valley to save her master from succumbing to a deadly illness by finding a unique flower of healing that only grows on top of the mountain. Overcome the platforming trials of the Valley, seek out the Spirits for their blessings along the way, and unlock movement abilities that take you all the way from the low grasslands to the floating islands up high. Find your way and secure the future of the Valley. Keeper of the Valley features a satisfying movement-based design with interesting open-map platforming, original music score, motion captured animations, and a rich and striking visual design. We have developed our own motion matching technology for the animations as well. The game is best experienced with a controller and is open to mouse and keyboard as well.
row.short_description: Jump, glide and dash your way to the top of the mountain in this 3D adventure platformer set in an open and enchanting valley!

row.name: Clay Soldiers
row.detailed_description: Free to play simple strategy Game! Play against people all around the world, in the same room as you, or the computer! A war rages between multiple factions. Take your side of multiple different alliances each with their own special ways to play, with the choice of different bonuses and castles that change the way each faction can play. Play through the campaign, a conquest of your enemies and the lands around them, unifying the tribes and creating a Mitch match army using the strongest characters that each faction has to offer! Spice up with different game modes, like the zombie apocalypse event, that change the playing field in different ways. Or play a more traditional game type with the War mode, advance from the stone age to the future age all while balancing the usage of recourses found around the map! Choose your alliance! The Angels: Servants of religion, they use their collective faith to summon powerful beings into existence. Convert enemy units into your religion. Stall the game long enough to summon gods! or slay the non-believers with faithful knights and crusaders! The Undead: Marching even after death, the undying use the corpses on the battlefield to snowball into an unstoppable force! Infect your opponents with disease and poison, swarm the board with zombies and liches, or drain the lifeforce of your opponent's using vampires! The Mercenaries: Gold is king, this alliance is proud of its stable and reliable income. Build castles and walls to defend key spots of the map, strike quick and hard with calvary, catapults and archers, protect your healers and merchants to keep your units alive and leveling up. And many more will be added later on! As well as new units, bonuses and Castles.
row.short_description: The war rages on, choose to side with the Mercenaries, the Undead, the Angels, and more! Play through the single-player campaign, unifying the factions. Fight against other players and AI in the battleground's mode! Or strive for a conquest that takes you through the ages in war mode.

row.name: LIFTOPIA one more!
row.detailed_description: The big adventure of a square creature! It is a somewhat nostalgic action game drawn with dots. The main character, Lifton, doesn't say anything, but he seems to be heading somewhere. Lifton will capture a variety of stages with the help of the enemies around him (while using them). The feature of this game is to 'lift' the enemy. Enemies picked up by Lifton can be thrown, thrown away, or whatever. By the way, some enemies have some effect while increasing or decreasing.
row.short_description: The big adventure of a square creature!It is a somewhat nostalgic action game drawn with dots.

row.name: Wizard's Wheel 2
row.detailed_description: The Dimension is in peril in this idle RPG, inspired by retro, turned based role playing games. Wizard's Wheel 2 is an epic, retro, pixel-art game, with idle/incremental mechanics and progression. With roughly 80 heroes to recruit, 150 base item types with randomly generated additional modifiers to seek, upgradable wizard powers to grant additional support, item crafting, mini-games and more, Wizard's Wheel 2 offers you limitless ways to play and customization for your chosen adventuring party. Play actively by selecting hero commands, boosting game speed with the wizard's wheel, and playing the unlockable dimensional deck mini-game, or play idly by enabling auto-battle, and letting your heroes do what they do best. As the powerful Wizard of Time, you'll salvage Time Mana from bosses slain, and use it to build statues in the Temple of TIme, granting powerful, permanent upgrades. Progress farther during each attempt at defeating a particular map level by collecting and upgrading equipment, recruiting new heroes or leveling up existing ones, upgrading temple statues and unlocking wizard powers, until you're finally able to conquer and save your dimension Features Include: Idle or Active Game-play - Gain various additional boosts and buffs by participating more often, or let your heroes battle until defeated using Auto-Battle. Incremental Numbers - Grow in power, exponentially, using any of the various systems in place, to deal damage-numbers with more 0's than ever. Tons of Heroes - Customize your 4-hero party by unlocking and recruiting from roughly 80 base hero types, each with an upgraded version, unique active and passive skill, stat growth rate, equipment options and more. Choose from characters such as knights, skeletons, mechs, or, as rumor would have it, dragons. Tons of Loot - As you gain strength and slay increasing numbers of monsters, you'll gain tens, hundreds, even thousands of chests on a game run, with randomly generated items. And don't worry! Wizard's Wheel 2 has a built-in... Loot Filter - Don't want to sit and sell dozens of items after every run? You can configure which items are auto-sold using various customizable toggles, once too much loot drops for your liking. Upgradable Village - Unlock crafters, recruitment areas, item shops, training facilities and more by building and upgrading buildings in your village. Item Crafting - Upgrade your Massive Broadsword of Quick Strikes by improving its bonus level at the blacksmith, its item tier at the manasmith, or its quality with whetstones at the alchemist. Is it socketed? Place an upgradable gem in it for extra elemental damage. Oh, and don't forget to imbue it with an Ascension Token, so that it becomes eternal, no matter what dimension you're in! Altered Gameplay with Timelines - Discover more than 20 alternate timelines, each with game-changing modifications to characters, enemies, items and more. Each timeline has unique items and/or item modifiers only available while adventuring in them. Daily Dungeon - Fight in the Inter-dimensional (or Daily) Dungeon, which lets you take your strongest party as far as they can reach, with its own set of unique loot to claim based on progress each day. Pantheon - Challenge a series of increasingly difficult boss enemies, granting additional permanent buffs and obtainable equipment. Dimensional Deck - Unlock and play a solitaire mini-game using the dimensional deck while on a run with your heroes, granting bonus multipliers to gold, time mana and loot, as well as granting other unique, immediate effects. Unlock and upgrade cards in your dimensional deck by conquering zones with various heroes. Capture Hero Skills with Skill Gems - Create countless hero configurations by capturing the skills of previously unlocked heroes in Skill Gems, granting those skills to any hero which equips them. Pets - Acquire eggs from slain enemies and place them into your hatchery, in order to obtain pets. Pets gain levels while incubating at the hatchery, and each grant up to 3 buffs to help your party advance while active. Breed pets of opposite genders to increasingly powerful buffs. Seasonal Timelines - Participate in seasonal events in order to battle unique enemies and unlock additional characters and loot. And more secrets to uncover... Note: This game requires an internet connection in order for offline progress to be enabled. Wizard's Wheel 2 is free to play. Some permanent boosts are available for a one-time cost. However, gems, the premium currency, can be found in game. There are NO characters, items, or any other areas of game content which require in app purchasing. (Note: A hero acquired with gems is then permanently unlocked.)
row.short_description: An idle and incremental rpg, inspired by retro, turned based role playing games, Wizard's Wheel 2 comes packed with heroes to collect, loot to acquire, equipment to upgrade, and a ton of ways to progress. Recruit, equip, upgrade, and spin the Wizard's Wheel in this deep, retro idle RPG.

row.name: Àrengard-Invasion
row.detailed_description: Àrengard-Invasion is a small online party game developed by myself in 2 weeks (LionDev) to learn multiplayer game development in Unreal Engine and how to publish a game on Steam so don't expect too much. Select one out of four classes and prepare your castle for the Goblins siege in this 'classic' mode. Features: Classes (Archer, Soldier, Mage, Defender) Fighting (PVE / CO-OP) Control siegeengines Different enemy classes (Bomber, Soldier, Siegeengines) Earn gold
row.short_description: Arengard-Invasion is a beat-em-up online-coop game. Swing your sword, shoot a ballista or cast spells to survive the Goblin's siege and keep YOUR beloved gold. Select one out of four classes and prepare your castle for the Goblin's siege

row.name: theBlu
row.detailed_description: theBlu: is a deeply immersive VR series that allows audiences to experience the wonder and majesty of the ocean through different habitats and come face to face with some of the most awe inspiring species on the planet. The series, which is directed by Jake Rowell (Call of Duty, Final Fantasy, Superman Returns), has been designed as beautiful moments in passing or a collection of memories that powerfully tap into the vast potential of VR. The debut episode, featuring an incredible close encounter with an 80 foot whale, is already recognized as one the most iconic room scale VR experiences to date (a Sundance Film Festival 2016 selection). Dive into more DLC experiences: Reef Migration Witness the magnificence of an undersea migration on the edge of a coral reef. Luminous Abyss Venture into the deepest region of the ocean to discover the iridescent abyss. Hammerhead Cove Sun lit Caribbean waters welcome you to a realm where one creature reigns supreme.
row.short_description: Experience the wonder and majesty of the ocean through a series of habitats and come face to face with some of the most awe inspiring species on the planet.

row.name: For Goodness Sake
row.detailed_description: THE NIGHT IS FINALLY HERE Every early December another kid from your school goes missing, and rumors on the playground have circulated that it's related to Krampusnacht- the night that a half-goat half-demon named Krampus comes and steals away naughty children and spares the good. But what is it that determines if people are taken by Krampus? For Goodness Sake is a very short horror text heavy game , focusing on several trolley problem situations. While completing the chores around the house, you find yourself reflecting on situations involving the neighborhood kids that have gone missing & ultimately deciding what you think might have been the right thing to do. Will you be taken by Krampus at the end of the night like the others, or will you be spared? Playtime: 15-20 minutes. 3D first person navigation Ending depends on your answers given Rich audio design and unsettling atmosphere Created in one month, for the HauntedPS1 community's Madvent [3] Calendar project. This was created as a small mental break from DEAD LETTER DEPT , a psychological horror typing game also available on Steam.
row.short_description: In a final attempt to guarantee your place on the nice list, you decide to try and do some chores before midnight. Will Krampus take you? Take the test and find out.

row.name: Thunderbolt Poker

row.name: DepthViewer
row.detailed_description: Creates 3D VR scenes from 2D input using depth estimation machine learning model. Takes any images or videos, estimates the depth using MiDaS model, and draws it in the 3D space for your VR HMD! You can save the depthmap output to use it later, record a 3D VR video to upload on Youtube. This program also can fetch the screen of your desktop and show the depth.
row.short_description: Creates 3D VR scenes from 2D input using depth estimation machine learning model.

row.name: PixiEditor
row.detailed_description: PixiEditor is a free and open-source universal 2D editor. Create clean pixel-perfect sprites, paint with raster tools, or design crisp vector graphics — all on one canvas. Animate frame-by-frame or use the powerful Node Graph to build fully non-destructive visuals and custom effects. It features a clean, familiar interface inspired by popular graphic editors, making it incredibly easy to jump in and start creating. Whether you're sketching, animating, or crafting a game-ready asset, PixiEditor gives you the tools to bring your ideas to life. Toolsets for any scenario PixiEditor comes with three dedicated toolsets: Pixel Art – Tools tailored for clean, pixel-perfect editing Painting – Soft brush, basic painting tools, and anti-aliased shapes Vector – Paths and shapes for scalable, resolution-independent artwork All toolsets can be used on one canvas.  Export to PNG, JPG, SVG, GIF, MP4, and more! Animations Create smooth frame-by-frame animations, or use nodes to animate custom shaders. Vector-based keyframe animation is also on our roadmap. Node Graph The Node Graph powers PixiEditor’s most advanced features. Every effect, layer, and structure is built using nodes or node connections. You can customize every document non-destructively, combining pre-built effects and custom shaders to create stunning visuals and procedural art.
row.short_description: PixiEditor is a universal 2D editor with tools and features for all your 2D needs. It blurs the line between vector and raster graphics. Create animations, procedural graphics, draw pixel-art, edit photos, vectors and more!

row.name: Ecosphere - Prologue
row.detailed_description: In this visual novel, you play as Leily Stirner, the Pirate Princess! Mandated by a mysterious mission's sponsor, she must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb capable of controlling nature: the Ecosphere! But beware: each decision will impact the progress of your mission... Will you manage to steal the precious loot? This free prologue (about twenty minutes of gameplay) will be the opportunity to lay the foundations of a much bigger universe! An atypical universe Enter a universe mixing Fantasy, Steampunk, and Pirates! A planet where magical powers meet technology. A world where humans are born with an Affinity: the mark that gives the ability to master one of the four natural elements! Interactive Fiction During the adventure, you will regularly have choices to decide the best way to enter the Memorial and influence the story. Two ends and several tactics to achieve them. Point & click Explore and interact with your environment using a drag-and-drop system: dragging items from your inventory and dropping them in-game to unlock contents. Battle mode Based on Quick Time Event, a battle mode is integrated for casting spells. Press the button before it's too late: if you click the attack button, you trigger the magic. If you miss it, the opponent attacks, and you suffer damage! Turbomedia It is a comic book designed for digital devices and exploits its technical possibilities, such as animations and interactions. An action sequence is available in this prologue. In-game rewards A gallery of 9 unlockable CGs. Riocamy (Production director, writer, programmer) - Zelyphia (Character artist) - DSittaro (Background artist) - VFX and sound design are licensed from asset stores.
row.short_description: The Pirate Princess must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb with the power to control nature: Ecosphere. Will you manage to steal the precious loot?

row.name: Derision
row.detailed_description: Just Updated * 5/28/2024 UPDATE * Due to negative feedback I have sent the request to Steam to make this game free (instead of $1, the lowest you can make it). If you are looking to purchase Derision now for $1, please wait until the FREE update has gone into effect. Derision was really just a learning experience for me as a Unreal Engine developer and a test run for the Steam SDK. Thanks to everyone who played and gave me constructive feedback. Please look forward to my next game which is already much higher quality. About the Game Derision You awake to the bars of your prison cell sliding open. You apprehensively peak outside and the dark, towering form of a Lich patrolling in the distance is the reason why. Can you find a way to escape this nightmarish dungeon? Use your discernment to navigate your way past Liches, disguise yourself, and find the key to your escape. You will receive aid on your journey, will you aid others after you? Help those imprisoned with you, and those that come after you. Or not... Even if you make it out, will anyone believe you? Or will your stories be met with Derision? These are questions you can provide the answers to with multiple endings based on your decisions. Gameplay Features: - First-person adventure set in an underground prison full of Liches. Try to escape. - Immerse yourself in an original and dark world created by Anatolio. - Independently developed by Anatolio. First UE5 game. - Avoid patrolling AI - Disguise yourself as a Lich to sneak by and get the key to your escape! - Multiple interactions with NPCs and Notes for additional lore. - 1 final cinematic cutscene. - 3 gameplay ratings based on objectives completed. - 3 endings based on rating. Save yourself or help others? - 1 Steam Achievement for escaping. - Options menu for graphics settings. * MATURE WARNING * - 1 scene with humans hanging from chains as they await to be transformed... * DISCLAIMER * This is the first production video game I have made in Unreal Engine 5. Please set your expectations low.
row.short_description: A first-person horror mystery adventure game. Find a way to avoid your captors and escape a nightmarish dungeon in an original world, and first video game, created by Anatolio, an independent developer.
row.notes: * MATURE WARNING * - 1 scene with humans hanging from chains as they await to be transformed... - General dark themes including death, imprisonment, and scary monsters.

row.name: Pillazon: MMO Drug Lord Tycoon Playtest
Balance 97.261/100
row.detailed_description: A patient man uses his hands to adjust the world as he sees it. Balance 97.261/100 is a game of precise placement of objects using both hands, a bit difficult, but with calmness and patience, you can reach the end. You can. Rotate the floor tiles to the correct angle. Stack the messy books vertically. Put the paintings in the art gallery in the right position. Turn the lid of the hand sanitizer in one direction. Even get the earth back to where she should be. This game also supports multiplayer mode with one person controlling one hand, so hopefully you and your partner can achieve a 100% synchronization rate. About the Developer I'm Liujiajun , this is my sixth game on Steam, I hope you like my work and thanks for playing.
row.short_description: A patient person, who uses his hands to adjust the world.

row.name: KIRO II: The Wizards Guild
row.detailed_description: Enter the world of KIRO II: The Wizards Guild, an immersive multiplayer dungeon crawler that combines fantasy and adventure! Gather up to six players online and embark on an epic journey through semi-procedurally generated dungeons. Using a classic text command system, you'll battle ferocious monsters, collect rare loot, and take on mighty dungeon bosses to prove your might. Are you ready to join the Guild and become a true wizard? Randomly Generated Dungeons... Navigate through semi-randomly generated dungeons that each contain a special dungeon boss. Online Multiplayer Up to 6 Players... Join with up to 6 players to adventure through multiple dungeons, each with their own dungeon boss. Work together to find loot chests and defeat enemies in semi-randomly generated worlds. Save Items Between Dungeon Runs... With a rich leveling system similar to classic tabletop games and MMORPG's of the past, players can specialize their playstyle to how they want. With the use of Steam's inventory system, loot collected by players can be traded from player to player and persist from game to game. Real-time Text Commands...
row.short_description: KIRO II: The Wizards Guild is a fantasy based multiplayer dungeon crawler in which up to six players can join online together to navigate through semi-procedurally generated dungeons using a classic text command system to slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat dungeon bosses.

row.name: memories
row.detailed_description: memories is a sapphic visual novel dress-up game where clothes are linked to painful memories of a failed relationship. Merging the genres of dress-up game and visual novel, memories highlights sadness and nostalgia in an immersive, pastel experience. Key Features - Experience an emotional story with choice-based dialogue - Dress-up gameplay that reveal a character’s past and present - Pastel, dream-like color palette and artstyle Credits game made by guiyyu music: Isolation by Lucas King
row.short_description: memories is a sapphic visual novel dress-up game where clothes are linked to painful memories of a failed relationship.
row.reviews: “Halfway through playing i sent the link to my friends so they'd play this too. It's so good!! <3” Sladey_I “first time full out crying at a game. . . just so goood” MangiaGattina “Probably one of the best games I've ever played, I've never related to a game so much it made me cry.” reese

row.name: Spaceflight Factory : Prologue
row.detailed_description: Spaceflight Factory : Prologue: is an Automation and (moving) Base Building inspired by Factorio and Stardeus. During this Prologue, you will focus only on crafting rockets and try to launch them correctly to Earth. On a post-apocalyptic Earth, all cities and settlements have been ravaged by pollution and a hostile biosphere. In a last hope to salvage Earth, a crew of the best astronauts have been sent to a remote planet to collect a mysterious ore capable of turning Earth's destiny. You will have to build an assembly line with conveyor belts, factory(s), foundry(s), insertor(s)... while defending your base from nearby swarms of Zorglings and rebuild an industry capable of launching spacecrafts and sending the supplies back to Earth. With this new hope, you will lead a colony of human remnants. Help them to survive, and expand/gather enough resources to leave Earth. . The game also includes some incremental/idle game mechanics.
row.short_description: Spaceflight: Prologue is an Automation and Base Building game with some survival game mechanics.During this prologue, You will lead a small colony of human remnants. Help them to survive, expand and gather enough resources to leave Earth for their new home planet.

row.name: Edemn
row.detailed_description: Edemn is a fun and dynamic shooter about skeletons who have risen through ancient magic and now fight among themselves. The game is done in the style of games from the early 2000s, which creates a cool atmosphere to play You will have to fight with other players, for the victory with different types of weapons. Each match in Edemn will be varied, and will drag on for a long time. Each of which is unique, will diversify your game experience and add new abilities to your skeleton. Can completely change the style of the game, each skin has a different ability, which distinguishes it from other skeletons. Edemn will be adding new modes. Of the modes that are currently available, it's Deathmatсh
row.short_description: Become the king of Edemn, take part in the battles of the skeletons that have risen thanks to ancient magic. Dynamic Online 3D Shooter that will drag you out for a long time!

row.name: Dominator Idle
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Dominator Idle mixes clicker games with strategy. The controls are very simple just using your left mouse button to click! Train troops and unlock magical upgrades in the associated panels. Troops are your main battle strength and should be the forefront of gaining more battle power. Magical upgrades will enhance your units in battle. Troops first, magic second. Engage in world conquest to take over all of Earth through these battles. Once you have taken all of the territories of earth on the attack page, prestige in order to increase your overall strength! This will reset upgrades but give you a permanent boost to your account! The enemies you face will be more challenging but with your newfound prestige they will be no match for you! Developer Notes I am a solo developer of the game and will be keeping it free forever. More content releases are planned in the future such as cutscenes and more upgrades. Currently in early access as there is a lot that needs improving such as a balance pass, sound, art, ui etc. I hope you all enjoy playing the game and I appreciate your feedback! Discord Server:
row.short_description: Dominator Idle is the ultimate idle game for world domination. Train troops and purchase magical upgrades in order to takeover the entirety of earth. With a powerful prestige system you can grow your power to unfathomable standards allowing you to conquer stronger versions of Earth.
row.notes: There are references to war as you try to take over earth in the 2D space. There is no visible blood or gore just the implication that you are taking over earth with your troops.

row.name: Ricky's Rockin' Arcade
row.detailed_description: Call your friends and prepare to face-off in a virtual arcade showdown! These multiplayer games allow you to band together as a group to save the day, or turn on each other to see who comes out victorious! Designed for in-person gameplay with a crowd, Ricky's Rockin’ Arcade will provide up to five unique arcade games for you to enjoy. The first game is out now, with four more coming this summer! Try your luck in an infiltrator race through a neon landscape with your fellow hackers. Once you’ve experienced Ricky’s first game, you’ll be anxious to see what else he has in store for you! Perfect for game nights, group hangouts, and anytime you’d rather be battling monsters than small-talk!
row.short_description: Ricky’s Rockin’ Arcade allows in person hangouts to gain a digital dimension giving you a virtual arcade to hang out in, and turn an ordinary game night into something unforgettable!

row.name: 2D Dawg 2
row.detailed_description: Продолжение, которое никто не ждал и не просил! Встречайте - 2D Dawg 2! Ну если кто не понял, это типа сиквел той самой первой новеллы, где Макс с Тайхеем вместе... спит. История нашего любимого Смоленчика не закончилась: да, он нашёл себе женщину, вернул Алисону #810рублей, но что-то опять пошло не так. Оставшись совсем один, Давгосик опять попадает в просак от чрезмерной любви к крепкому алкоголю. Но получится ли у него выйти сухим из воды и в этот раз? Максосику нужна ваша помощь Решайте несложные головоломки, проходите квесты и принимайте судьбоносные решения, которые и определят будущее и настоящие нашего любимого Максика! (Внутриигровое, естественно)
row.short_description: Продолжение, которое никто не ждал и не просил! Встречайте - 2D Dawg 2! Ну если кто не понял, это типа сиквел той самой первой новеллы, где Макс с Тайхеем вместе... спит.
row.notes: Употребление алкоголя, курение ,нецензурная брань, мультяшное насилие

row.name: Paper Lily - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Something terrible has happened. You can’t bear to think about it - but you can’t live like this anymore. You stopped attending school, you haven’t left your house in months, you have no reason to get out of bed anymore. There are no choices left. No choice except... that strange golden letter. It’s time to get your life back together. One last try. Paper Lily is a story-driven, psychological horror RPG where each puzzle has multiple solutions and outcomes. There is always another way. Follow Lacie's story as you explore a dangerous hidden world, solve puzzles in multiple different ways, and face strange enemies. The game is playable in about 4 hours and contains multiple endings depending on your actions. Paper Lily - Chapter 1 is the continuation to the prologue, Project Kat, but it can also be enjoyed without having played it. Out of Context Features Multiple ways of solving puzzles! Touch grass, and trees Minigames where you press buttons and push boxes around Call your mother Harmless Snack™ Various things made of paper Bunnies (or whatever those things are) Demons Fast demons Social anxiety simulation Table salt ...Is that Kat? Nah, probably not Bathroom etiquette Death
row.short_description: Paper Lily is an RPG horror game in which you can solve puzzles in different ways. Explore a hidden world, meet strange characters, and guide Lacie as she attempts to find answers about her unusual condition.
row.notes: Contains depictions of blood and light gore. Contains swearing.

row.name: The Year of the Carrot
row.detailed_description: Betsy the Bunny Rabbit wants to pick up some carrots! Hop around, pick up and throw stuff, and try to collect all the carrots! Rock out to amazing chiptune ragtime music! See if you can make it through all 96 rooms! It's a puzzle game that's maybe a little different! You can run around, jump, and pick up & throw various things you may find in the room. When you throw something, it flies around the room and bounces off the walls until it hits the ground. It's fun to just hang out sometimes and keep throwing stuff around! You can pick up marbles and throw them around the room. If three marbles of the same color line up, they flash and disappear! Sometimes you want that to happen. Sometimes you don't. It's part of life to learn what you want! You can pick up and throw critters as well. They can't hurt you, and you can't hurt them. If the mood strikes, you can stand on top of them and ride around. Maybe they can help you reach new places! Featuring 12 worlds with 8 rooms each, for 96 rooms total. The 12 worlds are divided into 3 episodes of 4 worlds each. The worlds in each episode can be tackled in any order. So what awaits in these worlds? Sky High Keep : Home to floating Platforms and flying fish. Why are the fish flying? Why not? Tabby Catacombs : These spooky crypts feature the Drop Bolts, which fall down as you stand on them, as well as the Bass Knobs, which fall slower than the bolts but retract faster. You may also find the Anti-Bolts and Treble Knobs, which rise up when you stand on them! Woods of Hermia : Here come the Rocket Blocks! When you stand on them, they move left or right; after you jump off of them, they move back to their original position. Titania Capitol : The Diamond and Heart Blocks will allow you to super-jump and double jump if you jump off of them. Equinox Isle : The Bubble Pots will continuously create bubbles that you can jump on. But be careful! You can’t stand on them for long! Temple of Helena : You’re going to love this! The Magi Blocks appear & disappear at set intervals. Also, there are flying pigs! Mercurial Mines : In the mines, you’ll find Arrow Zingers, which will Zing thrown marbles and critters in all sorts of different directions. Hazy Shade Land : This frozen world has the Elevators, which activate as long as you’re standing on them, and stop otherwise. Also, it has everyone’s favorite: Ice Blocks you can slip on! Plus, there’s 4 more worlds that mix & match all these things to give you a nice finale! Oh, and I almost forgot: the POWERUPS ! The Keys will cause the Door Blocks to open. The Mushrooms will cause the Invisible (hollow) Blocks to appear. The Music Notes will cause all marbles of the same color to flash and disappear. The Gems will turn all marbles of the same color in Metal Balls, which don’t match with anything. …Except for the Metal Gem , which will turn all Metal Balls into Wildcard Marbles, which match with all colors! The Book reverses gravity for Betsy, so you can run on the ceiling! The Magnets change gravity for the marbles, so they will fall in different directions! And the Carrots ! Gotta get those carrots! They’ve got Vitamin A!
row.short_description: A cool game where you pick up carrots, throw stuff around and watch it bounce off the walls.

row.name: Project Regolith
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord! About the Game Explore the Mystery of Outpost Rhea Project Regolith is a 2-Player Cooperative Puzzler made by a small team of 4 in Melbourne, Australia, where you and a partner are tasked with uncovering the mystery behind the vanished crew of Outpost Rhea, a deep-space research facility overseen by a Corporate body that enforces strict NDA clauses and communications embargoes amongst it's employees. The rules of time and space are breaking down aboard the station. Communication is key, as the two of you might not be seeing the same thing. Were those walls there before? Did the door just move? Wait, are you walking on the ceiling !? The station's research has led to some bizarre anomalies that have begun to warp environments on a whim - Explore a series of non-Euclidean puzzles together with your partner to uncover the fate of Outpost Rhea and the experiment at the heart of it all - Project Regolith. KEY FEATURES 2 Player Coop Puzzling - Team up with a partner, friend, enemy, stranger, or anything in-between to uncover the mystery behind Project Regolith. Non-Euclidean Spaces - As the anomalies plaguing Outpost Rhea worsen, you'll come across warped spaces that defy physics, and objects that defy your senses. The Lives of Rhea's Crew - Learn more about the major players aboard Outpost Rhea, from the station's Executive Director, to the humble catering staffers. Thirty (30) collectible Audio Logs tell the story of the station, and help shed light on the experiments aboard the station, and the lives of the crew affected by them. Voiced by an incredibly talented cast made possible by our Kickstarter backers!
row.short_description: Work together with a partner to solve a series of non-Euclidean Escape Room puzzles to uncover the mystery behind the vanished crew of Outpost Rhea, a deep-space research facility experiencing strange spatial anomalies.

row.name: Embracing Darkness
row.detailed_description: 'Embracing Darkness' is a fan visual novel in which players can enjoy a short encounter with Local Villains Tiefedorf and Shuraomaru in the form of an interactive fiction story. FEATURES Japanese & English languages available 3 scenarios Non-gendered protagonist that can be read as either male or female Completely free STORY Shuraomaru's story Every day, you get lunch at your favorite café, and you sit down at your favorite table to eat. This time, however, there's someone already on your seat when you get there, and he seems to be waiting for you... Tiefedorf's story After getting lost in the woods during a winter storm, you end up at a mysterious mansion. With nowhere else to turn to, you find yourself accepting the invitation of its owner to stay for tea... Bonus Scenario Ever since you inherited your grandfather's mystic shop, you've been used to dealing with all kinds of phantoms and shady figures. But there's something about two of your newest clients you can't quite put your finger on..
row.short_description: 'Embracing Darkness' is a fan visual novel in which players can enjoy a short encounter with Local Villains Tiefedorf and Shuraomaru.

row.name: Game of Rollink
row.detailed_description: Join the arena and play Rollink! Challenge a friend to a 1v1 battle or compete against up to 7 opponents to claim the Crown of Destiny! Join our discord to share your feedback! Experience a unique and innovative combination of cards and autochess set in a medieval fantasy world. Feel the adrenaline rush as your cards turn and your troops clash. Strategize and make the best hands to compete for the crown of destiny, a symbol of supreme power, or risk watching your gold be taken by other competitors. Uncover ancient family histories and missions on the table of fate while you play as medieval lords with distinct voice acting and personalities. The story takes place in the era of turbulence under the reign of ill-fated Caesar XV, where the next successor shall rise from the arena to subdue the queen of pirates, who has closed secret deals with the monstrous flying dragons. Take a glimpse of Caesar Empire's former splendour through the marble-pillared corridor, sumptuous palace, and magnificant arena. The solemn yet majestic fuse of orchestra and choir, along with clinking drops of gold and belligerent speech of the lords, invite you to a mythical land far, far away. Summon powerful creatures and valiant troops for a spectacular fight in the arena. Trample your enemies with powerful lord skills as your cards turn into units and battle to death for you. Fold or all in! The odds are changing every minute. Bet strategically because winning is only secured with the right blend of cards, spells and skills. Inspired by but beyond the classic Texas Hold'em gameplay, Game of Rollink holds infinite replayability given its vast combination of lords, hands and spells. Even beginners will get a hang of the game mechanics and be intrigued in a few rounds.
row.short_description: Game of Rollink is a PvP card game with auto-battler made with CliCli, where you play as a medieval lord to outwit sinister opponents on the gaming table and seize the supreme throne. Bet wisely because gold and countless lives of loyal soldiers are at stake.
row.notes: The game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work. This may include: Violence or Gore

row.name: Candyboy
row.detailed_description: It's Halloween night - a time for fear and fright. For tricks and treats. A time... to dine on candy! Join Candyboy on his quest to gather as many sweets as he can before the night is through. But look out! Danger lurks around every corner, and even Candyboy has reason to be afraid. Features Inspired by the old school, tough as nails NES platformers Multiple endings Platformer PACIFICISM! Candyboy can't beat up his bullies, so he evades them instead 6 enemies to beware of, from bad bullies to rabid bats Cool chiptunes to listen to A fun time for audiences of all ages Enjoy the sweetest game of the year with Candyboy!
row.short_description: Make it through Halloween in this NES inspired, candy filled adventure!
row.notes: Harm to trick or treaters

row.name: Extinction / Zombie İnvasion 1
row.detailed_description: We need to destroy Mahmut, who started the zombie epidemic, and we go through various ways to destroy him. Various zombies and islands are waiting for us, we return to our island after destroying Mahmut. 10 DIFFERENT ISLANDS The game world with 10 maps offers you many areas to explore. More than 10 regions are waiting to be discovered. WEAPONS Find weapons like pistols, rifles to protect yourself from bloodthirsty zombies. HUN OR FISH Food for milk, health kit etc. Avoid falling into the trap of various types of zombies. Also, use hints to collect keys to advance to other levels. FIRST PERSON There is also a camera angle in the game: First-person DISCOVER EVERYWHERE Explore the world and collect food and ammo to help you survive. 3x100 BLOOD You only have 3X100 health, but you can increase your health. But if you run out of health, the checkpoint will be canceled and you will be back to the beginning.
row.short_description: We are trying to kill the doctor who started the zombie epidemic. And various zombies and scary events await us on this journey.

row.name: Disavowed
row.detailed_description: Embark on a journey in this Metroidvania to help a lowly reject exact revenge on its sadistic creator, the Tinkerer. Explore diverse zones including The Scrapyard, Plush Kingdom, Prismatic Waterways, and more in an attempt to become stronger for your ultimate revenge. The reject will use the very abilities his brethren were born with to dismantle its foes. The player can learn to wall jump, double jump, dash, and even fire a fully controllable stun shot that nearly freezes time. Anyone who stands in the way of the reject can be sliced down with his sword and various perks he purchased from the Trinkiteer. At the end of the day, The Tinkerer must fall.
row.short_description: Disavowed is a Metroidvania that allows the player to freeze time and set up pinpoint shots to stun enemies. It is set in a world of plush and cute creatures where the player has been cast out and needs to go on a journey to gather more strength and get back at his creator for tossing him out.

row.name: Chasmal
row.detailed_description: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths. Featuring over 100 items and weapons, four playable characters, and three difficulty settings.
row.short_description: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths.

row.name: Shiitake Showdown
row.detailed_description: A parasitical race of Myconids has recently surfaced within the world, infecting and wiping out many civilisations. They desire to assimilate everything within their Mycelium network and create a dark world, shrouded in the shadow of their fungi so that they can live on the surface without fear of the light. However, their next target, a collection of cold-blooded Serpents are devout worshippers of the Sun and refuse to let this happen and will do everything in their power to prevent this threat from winning. Unique weapons Battle it out with your friends or foes using a variety of different weapons that each excel in their own scenario. Change from using a shotgun at close range to a sniper from afar to make the most of each weapons strong point. Elemental utility Utilise your power over the elements with 4 to chose from. Wield 2 of these elements at the same time to adapt depending on the situation. Each element suits a different playstyle so try them all and see what suits you best. Diferent maps and game modes With 4 different maps and 4 gamemodes to play on each of them play them all and find what combination is your favorite! Customization Change your caracter skin and color to suit your style. With loads of combinations to choose from there is something to suit everyone!
row.short_description: The showdown between Snakes and Shrooms rages on in this high action first person arena shooter. Use your control over the elements and your experience with a gun to show up your friends and slay your enemies!

row.name: Blood Wizard Odyssey
row.detailed_description: Blood Wizard Odyssey is an RPG about a little Wizard on a big, big adventure... Assemble your team of wretched magicians to traverse a fetid world of Ogres, Ghouls, Blood Imps, Blood, and more(!), and journey to uncover the secrets that this terrible blood earth holds. Includes: -blood wizards -nasty hags -ogres -blood ghouls -dwarves -meat -vinegar -the word of God -several former United States presidents
row.short_description: An absurd comedy turn-based RPG about wizards in a blood world
row.notes: This game contains explicit language and sexual references.

row.name: Spherum 3D
row.detailed_description: A whole VR-city, Volumetric avatars, free movement, interactive live objects,  and more… Spherum Volumetric Player enables users to discover connections that was not possible before. Thanks to STEAM and Spherum Volumetric Player technology, you can Join us in 'exploring' this exciting new era of VR! Spherum Volumetric Player Metaverse is a Next-Gen Web3 Metaverse with Volumetric avatars to become the first metaverse that truly combines the best of VR and Volumetric technology worlds using for communication and interaction.  Spherum Volumetric Player users are able to to walk and explore a new three-dimensional world and its inhabitants, view and respond new content appearing on the platform and explore new features of Volumetric video. Spherum Volumetric Player metaverse enable users to curate, discover, and explore meaningful interactions on the metaverse in a way that was not possible before. We do volumetric video or volumetric capture. We’ve captured athletes, musicians, and public figures. We pride ourselves on extremely high-quality, high-resolution capture—the closest thing to the real thing of standing next to or sitting across from or observing that person. Looking to the future, there are also aspects of live volumetric video on the horizon where we’re live broadcasting musicians or performances into the metaverse as well. Join Our Community! Welcome to the Metaverse!
row.short_description: Spherum Volumetric Player metaverse! A whole VR-city, Volumetric avatars, free movement, interactive live objects,  and more. Spherum Volumetric Player metaverse enable users to curate, discover, and explore meaningful interactions on the metaverse in a way that was not possible before metaverse!

row.name: Fantasy Mercenary Wars
row.detailed_description: Recruit a team! Unlock from a roster of 23 units and pick 9 to take into battle! A variety of attack, defense, health, speed, cost, and range stats gives every unit a place though not every unit is required. What will be your favorite team? Direct your troops! Your troops will move on their own initiative to engage the enemy at their castle, but the entire battlefield is full of resources! Move troops around with the UI or keyboard to capture tiles for more resources! These resources can in turn be spent for a greater quality or quantity of troops! Play through a variety of levels! Conquer 28 levels as the battlefield evolves and the enemy focuses on different units! As you progress the levels will get larger and more complex, however the rewards for completion will increase as well! Sales have been discontinued due to sounds licensed from one company that may have been stolen from another company. They may continue once issue has been resolved or sounds replaced. Thank you!
row.short_description: Fantasy Mercenary Wars is a tile and lane based strategy game where units move across a lane on their own and capture tiles as they move. The player can choose to move units to different lanes to better suit their unit's attack, to intercept the enemy, or capture additional resources in tiles.

row.name: Hedgewars
row.detailed_description: Hedgewars is a turn-based strategy, artillery, action and comedy game, featuring the antics of pink hedgehogs with attitude as they battle from the depths of hell to the depths of space. As commander, it's your job to assemble your crack team of hedgehog soldiers and bring the war to your enemy. Key Features. Hilarious and strategic turn based combat for up to 8 players. Both local and network multiplayer, with optional AI opponents. Two singleplayer campaigns with a total of 24 missions. Utilize about 58 devastating weapons and utilities! Defeat your foes with simple weapons like grenades or take it to the next level and trash entire landscapes with weapons like the watermelon bomb or piano strike. Improve your skills in a total of more than 25 single missions for learning the game, target practice, challenges and just for fun. Battle on an infinite number of randomly generated maps with 37 environments, or choose from 44 set image maps, or even draw your own in an editor. Play the game your with 25 different game modifiers, tweak almost every aspect of the match. Save your favourite gameplay settings in schemes. Customize your team, with over 280 hats/costumes, 32 graves, 13 forts, 100s of flags and 13 unique voice packs.
row.short_description: Turn-based strategy, artillery, action and comedy game, featuring the antics of pink hedgehogs with attitude as they battle from the depths of hell to the depths of space.

row.name: Crystal Maidens: Unleashed
row.detailed_description: Crystal Maidens is back with more lewd fun, more strategy, and a lot less clothing. Command your dream team of seductive girls in this naughty adventure.   Lead your army of stunning babes into battles and unlock mind-blowing sex scenes. It’s brains, brawn, and booty… exactly how you like it!   Every choice matters, from the skills you use to the maidens you seduce. Pleasure and power go hand in hand with combat and uncensored animations.   Lead your crew through mysterious lands, intense missions, and forbidden desires. The world of Crystal Maidens is yours to conquer.
row.short_description: A twisted wizard has corrupted the Maidens and their land. It’s up to you to summon your own harem of stunning waifus, fight back against the dark forces, and liberate them in this lewd RPG adventure. Let your desires get unleashed!

row.name: MalovMetaArt Metaverse
row.detailed_description: MalovMetaArt is a metaverse of world art, a digital museum that allows you to view the digital twins of world masterpieces that are identical to their physical counterparts. The key distinction among MalovMetaArt and similar projects is the 100% accurate replication of artworks. Using photogrammetry and laser scanning techniques, we have created a way to create precise digital twins of the masterpieces of world art you see in the app. You can even touch, zoom and examine the artworks from all sides. In virtual space, you can hold an item (which is not allowed in a real museum) or get up close to unique paintings, so close that they can see the texture of each touch of the genius’s brush. Non-traditional exhibition galleries are another feature of MalovMetaArt. Here you may admire glass artworks exhibited under the starry sky of faraway planets, as well as masterpieces of painting in a subway hall of mid-20th century. Many of us don't frequently visit regular museums. So, give a go to a virtual one. You'll like it. Furthermore, MalovMetaArt Metaverse is better and more convenient than a traditional museum in many aspects.
row.short_description: MalovMetaArt is a Metaverse of World Art. VR Digital Museum with 100% accurate 3D copies of sculptures, paintings, artworks. You can touch and see the artworks from all sides.
row.notes: Great artists have always been drawn to the beauty of the nude female body and have portrayed it in paintings and sculptures. Some people may consider it to be too extreme.

row.name: Kairos
row.detailed_description: Kairos is an RTS fantasy experience that pits the player against the corruption in the world. The player must build structures and train soldiers, archers, and mages to fight alongside the hero and defeat the corruption. If left to its own devices, the corruption will send corrupted units to defeat the player's forces as well as expand and overrun the land until the player has nowhere left to hide. You must not only train soldiers to fight corrupted enemies but also create purifiers to reclaim the corrupted land. The primary enemy the player will face is a corruption that slowly expands across the continent. The corruptions will not only hurt the players units, but it will build up it’s own army of monsters to take down the player’s kingdom. As such, it is the players job to keep his kingdom alive and, with enough effort, cure their homeland of this vile plague. Using a collection of different units, structures, and magic, the player will be able to build and expand their kingdom into the corrupted parts of the world. As you expand, more resources will become available to the player. This will allow the player to continue to expand into the deeper corruption. Eventually, with enough effort, the player will completely purify the continent, making it a prosperous land.
row.short_description: Kairos is an RTS game set in a medieval fantasy world consumed by Corruption. As a last bastion of life, you must build bases and lead your armies to fight the endless hunger. Discover new magics to purify the land and reclaim what was lost. At the end of times, will you win? Or you will die trying?

row.name: Animal Survivors
row.detailed_description: Animal Survivors is a casual survival game with minimalistic time-based gameplay with simplistic roguelike elements. Control cute animals using just 4 keys on your keyboard to collect experience gems, defeat the hordes of evil creatures that have invaded your home, and earn coins during your 15-minute run. Skills are used automatically, you just need to pick the most suitable ones from the list of available skills in the level.
row.short_description: Animal Survivors is a casual game with elements of a simplified roguelike. A time-based survival game with minimalistic gameplay and elements of a simplified roguelike.

row.name: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE
row.detailed_description: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island in the middle of nowhere. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a 'recovery operation' without being privy to too many details. They said the facility had been abandoned for decades, but once in place it was immediately apparent that something was wrong. Discover the dark secrets of the facility's years of operation, up until the accident that led to the extreme consequences you are involved in. Every time you die, you will control a new volunteer sent to the place. Your starting equipment will be randomized and each level will be generated with a new layout. Dark corridors and cold rooms. Abominable creatures and bloody fights. Puzzles to solve, equipment, logs and documents to recover await you in this roguelite survival horror. Random generated maps every time you enter a new level or you die A top down perspective surrounded by darkness Scavenge weapons, ammo and gadgets to raise your chance to survive Manage your inventory to make room for what you deem vital Different types of enemies will hunt you down each room of the facility Buy upgrades and devices to help you during fights Find logs and documents from the 1950s to unveil the stories of the people who worked there
row.short_description: EMPTY SHELL: PROLOGUE will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a 'recovery operation' without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

row.name: Jump Dash Soar
row.detailed_description: Jump Dash Soar ...is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping , strafe running , slope jumps , and bounce pads ! But Jump Dash Soar isn't just about going fast. It's about quickly, but smoothly and precisely, directing that speed to traverse maps, solve timed puzzles, and find hard-to-reach collectibles. Ready to test your FPS skills with some throw-back Boomer Shooter movement? Collectibles Each level is packed with collectibles. Some are a mere rocket jump away, but others are much trickier, and many might seem downright impossible to reach! Some are over 40 meters high. Some are stashed behind laser speed gates, the kind that'll give you a nasty singe if you don't meet the minimum speed. But the most challenging are locked away behind timed doors: activate the door by shooting a button, watch the countdown start, and go fast! The hardest will only give you a single second to make it through! Are you up for the challenge? Tutorials If you're not a seasoned FPS pro, don't worry, Jump Dash Soar has comprehensive tutorials that cover every movement technique available. You can time your rocket jumps down to the millisecond, angle your rocket sprints to a tenth of a degree, and reach ridiculous heights with a slope dash jump all by using information presented clearly on the HUD. You can even check out the view rotation meter to see a real-time readout of how effective your strafe running is at building speed. Even better, Jump Dash Soar has a built-in Macro editor that makes these advanced movement techniques only a key-bind away! Speedruns Once you've first figured out how to get all the collectibles, why not try to get them all... but really fast? Jump Dash Soar has a built-in speedrun mode! Continually improve your time by finding new routes, pickup sequences, and work-arounds. Each collectible has an 'intended' solution, but any movement technique you can use to reach it is fair game! Maps Jump Dash Soar is the work of a single developer, and includes three maps: The Sludge Factory Start your Jump Dash Soar journey in the expansive and intricate Sludge Factory. Learn the basics of dashing, rocket jumping, and slope jumping, and use those skills to reach 48 total collectibles! Some are relatively easy to reach, but others will test all the skills you've learned. Can you speedrun them all in under 8 minutes? The Sanctum of Sludge Ready to go faster, further, and higher? The Sanctum of Sludge is a massive level that'll introduce you to Jump Dash Soar's advanced movement techniques: rocket wall climbs, the incredibly powerful rocket dash jump, strafe jumping, rocket wall runs, and the rocket dash sprint! You could stay on the tutorial path, but why not take on some of the challenge rooms? You'll need everything you've learned to tackle some of these! Try a speedrun to see just how fast you can find all 48 collectibles! Smooth Frog Classic SFC is a throwback level to the old classic deathmatch maps. The Tutorial Guys are now targets! Practice your movement, traverse the map, and improve your shot accuracy!
row.short_description: Jump Dash Soar is a frenetic, fast, and fun movement-based FPS. Build incredible speed with a powerful dash mechanic combined with rocket jumping, strafe running, slope jumps, and bounce pads!

row.name: Turtle Racer
row.detailed_description: Turtle Racer is an educational racing game designed for players to learn about biological marine life and their environment. Players take the role of the humble sea turtle as they explore the ocean to learn about sea life and test their knowledge in a thrilling race through an exotic ocean trench! Players have access to two different game modes: A free, relaxed exploration of the ocean floor where they learn various facts about ocean life. The exciting and fast-paced race where your knowledge on marine biology may be the only thing between victory or defeat. Play the game as you wish! Confident in your marine knowledge? Head straight into the race! If not, take your time and learn about the secrets of sea life. But be warned, throughout your race the sea will present various questions to you. Swim through the correct answer and the ocean current will give your turtle a brief speed boost! But answer wrong and your opponent may pull ahead.
row.short_description: Turtle Racing is an educational undersea experience where you speed through an ocean trench and use your knowledge of marine life to reach the finish before your opponent!
publishers: TDSDP is Transdisciplinary Data Scholars Development Program (TDSDP) - TDSDP Games Transdisciplinary Data Scholars Development Program at Bethune-Cookman University

row.name: Grape Juice City
row.detailed_description: Choose your Juicer, paint the town with fruit, & win the hearts of Grape Juice City on a hot day! Grape Juice City is a match-based party shooter, where you play as anthropomorphic tropical birds competing to splash the most pedestrians with your team’s juice. Bounce around a tropical metropolis gathering fruit and recyclables, crafting these items into juicy drinks, and tossing them to the people of Grape Juice City in this a friendly but competitive party game for all ages!
row.short_description: A friendly but competitive couch party game for all ages! Play as tropical birds competing to splash pedestrians with your team’s juice in this match-based party game. Bounce around a tropical metropolis, gather fruit and recyclables, craft juicy drinks, and splash the people of Grape Juice City!

Players have to survive from numerous of bullets. Teleporting in all directions to avoid being attacked. row.name: Temanava
row.detailed_description: After surviving a crash on an unknown island, Amelia, a young co-pilot is now alone, separated from her commander. In her quest to find him and get off the island, she will discover the mysterious language of 'Temanava'. Temanava is populated by strange islanders. Learning a new language will enable Amelia to communicate with temanavians and obtain their help. - Speak with islanders : Select and use the right symbols to build correct sentences and converse with Temanavians. - Try & learn: Check notes of discovered symbols, test them on anything or anyone, anytime and anywhere you want. - Use your Notebook: Your notebook is going to be your best tool to get through this unknown language. - Interact with the world: Use the language to interact with nature and items in order to unlock and explore new places. - A cute and wholesome adventure: Embark on a 3D stylized journey with cute islanders and cozy visuals that makes you want to stay here forever. - An unique language: Temanava's language exists nowhere else and was built based on research made on ancient and faraway languages like Inuit, Pawnee, Arabic or Latin.
row.short_description: TEMANAVA is an Adventure/Exploration game where you play as a co-pilot who survived a crash. You will have to learn an unknown language in order to communicate with strange islanders and use your mysterious powers to find your commander!

row.name: Out of Three
row.detailed_description: Out of Three is a 3-player Local Multiplayer Boss Rush game. Lost in a dungeon, you and your two comrades must survive a terrible monster: Gorgon. Beware! 3 inexperienced villagers like yourselves are obviously no match. Fortunately, the gods are merciful and decide to lend you the 3 weapons of the trinity. The Bloody Fists: These boxing gloves belonged to the infamous Tiger-eyed Boxer. Wearing them allows you to drain your enemy's life points when hitting them, restoring your own. The Spield: Can't make up your mind between a spear or a shield? The Spield is the perfect choice. Attack your ennemy while reflecting some damage when shielding at the right time! The Lyre: If music is your thing, you should use the Lyre to harm Gorgon from afar with your false notes. Amidst chaos and disarray, you must find a way to cooperate with your friends to beat the boss. Swap weapons with your teammates and come up with the best strategy. Start from scratch, become true heroes. You'll have to swap weapons during battle if you want your party to be the most efficient. Studying each weapon will come in handy to become a real asset for your team. thank you Pernambuco for these amazing musics! You can go on his spotify or Youtube channel to see his work !
row.short_description: Out of Three is a local multiplayer Boss Rush game that can be played with 3 players. The goal: defeat the Boss Gorgone by cooperating with your team members. You and your 2 faithful comrades find yourselves in an unknown dungeon, face to face with a giant medusa. Your fate seems inevitable!

row.name: Robbie's Tale
row.detailed_description: In the golden age of peace, the land of Eire has not seen war for many centuries. But all of that is about to change. Take control of our hero, Robbie, as he ventures on a journey to piece together the shattered history of his people while a dark force is growing stronger.
row.short_description: An action-packed turn-based RPG. Every decision you make shapes the world around you. 24 Playable classes! A unique crafting system. Test your might in the monster arena! A rich and driven story that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

row.name: BAPBAP
row.detailed_description: BAPBAP is a roguelike party game where you craft the most unfair builds to make your friends hate you. Invite and play with up to 7 friends in an all out brawl. Pick a random power after every round and craft the most ridiculous (or regrettable) build possible. BAPBAP is best played with friends who can handle betrayal. Set up custom games with wild rulesets, or jump into community-run servers and embrace the chaos. No matchmaking. No ranks. Just pure, dumb fun. Tight, free-flowing combat that’ll have you screaming for your mom to get the camera. Everything is dodgeable so if you get clapped, that’s on you. Or a goldfish piloting a mech. Or a Russian samurai. Or ramen with legs. Each characters comes with it’s own unique skillset and there’s a character design for everyone—even the freaks 👁️👄👁️. Whether it’s turning into a giant metallic duck, speccing into turretmancy, or literal poison, every game will present you with freshly randomized build combos to gamba with. Build synergies, get winnergies. Block escape routes with a crane’s payload, transform into a vending machine for a sneaky ambush, or do a drive-by in a 1942 Panzerkampfwagon Tiger Tank. BAPBAP is a PvP sandbox where nothing make sense but also everything makes sense. On top of all that, you could get ganked by a roaming giga slime, fish up a nuclear bomb or come face to tentacle with [redacted]  - the better you are at adapting, the more you’ll win. Whether it’s the turnaround 1v3, hitting a sweet multi-target knock up or just watching your mates get hit by their own trap – BAPBAP is here to help you get that sweet hit of dopamine in this increasingly depressing world. Welcome to BAPBAP, where logic goes to die.
row.short_description: Join BAPBAP, the Roguelike Party game where no two matches are ever the same. Round up your homies, pick a character, and build a giga-unfair build that'll make them hate you - then do it all over again!

row.name: Redumption
row.detailed_description: Your friends have been transformed into trash! Now it's up to you, as the only one left, to save them. With a little help from the Good Witch of the Woods and her magical broom, sprint across the waste cleaning up trash, fight the evil minions and save your friends. Reclaim lost items and gain power ups to help you on your quest to defeat the Evil Witch of the Waste. Become the hero and save the town from being consumed by junk and debris! Genre: 3d single player action adventure Audience: Recommended for 10 + Platform: Built for PC Features: Open exploration Combat or stealth Level up Controller support
row.short_description: Redumption is an action adventure game where you explore a town consumed by the waste. Fight bosses and retrieve precious items to save your friends from the witch's curse. Can you clean up the town and achieve redumption?

row.name: Aggregator Elevator System
row.detailed_description: 'Aggregator Elevator System' is a strategic logic-based number puzzle game, designed and developed with a fresh original gameplay foundation. It caters to those who enjoy faintly similar games like Sudoku, Picross etc. The game involves strategically arranging blocks within a grid to make the horizontal and vertical signal numbers add up correctly. The blocks have intuitive logical properties such as adding, combining, equalizing, XY, distance etc and more which you can use to manipulate the values of the signals to solve each levels. A highly solvable combinatorial puzzle game. Focusing on a deep,versatile and balanced gameplay experience. The game involves the use of number logic, but it will not bog you down with any mind numbing math. The real focus is on analyzing number patterns and clever logical manipulations within tight constraints. The game is designed to respect both your time and your intelligence. CHOOSE AMONG 2 GAME MODES - 60 LEVELS EACH Over 60 semi hand-crafted levels which you can play for hours. The level composition are carefully set by hand but the solutions are randomly arranged through a custom seed. High replay value, as you can start new games using new seeds to generate fresh set of unique levels. Experience simple to complex puzzle systems through the emergent combination of many primitive block operations working in perfect synergy with each other. Multiple difficulty levels. Levels are carefully optimized separately for the two game modes. Aggregator is all about the mental satisfaction of solving logic based number puzzles. No artificial hindrance like timers or move counters. Optional tip and cheat feature to help pass challenging levels. Mouse/Keyboard/Gamepad support. Steam cloud save and achievements integration.
row.short_description: Challenge your logic and strategy in new ways in this deductive tile-placement puzzle game. Master a rich system of logical rules where you must arrange blocks within a grid to make everything add up perfectly.

row.name: December 1914
row.detailed_description: A comic-style narrative-oriented game based on the Christmas Eve Truce during World War I. Players will experience December 1914, playing the role of a soldier who has left his family to fight on the battlefield. The game is approximately 30 minutes long. 80% of the proceeds will be donated to countries affected by war. Four interactive mini-games Experience the life of soldiers on the battlefield through simple games with objectives, including: Killing enemy soldiers Delivering supplies past enemy lines Firing your weapon to deter the enemy and guard positions Executing stubborn captives At night Soldiers will have the opportunity to rest briefly at night. This is also when they will receive updates on the war, communicate with friends, enjoy simple military rations, smoke, and look at photos of their loved ones. Sanity value There is a sanity meter in the game, which will change based on the soldier's actions. For example, killing someone will lower the sanity value. The sanity value may also decrease after completing a mission. When the sanity value is too low, the player's perspective will change, colors will fade, and vision will become distorted. Supplies and thoughts of loved ones at night can restore the soldier's sanity. Christmas Eve The Pope proposed a ceasefire for Christmas, but the proposal was rejected by the officials of the warring countries. However, on Christmas Eve, a miracle occurred, starting with a few brave soldiers... Game Size One ending 52 illustrations
row.short_description: A comic-style narrative-oriented game based on the Christmas Eve Truce during World War I.

row.name: Eon of the Green: Area Delta (Prologue)
row.detailed_description: WARNING: The game's cutscenes potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. After a dramatic failure of an undercover mission you become part of the top secret Klaassen Project. You are still unsettled by your past and wary about the intentions of your superiors. Recurring transmissions take you to Earth in 1 billion years. See breathtaking things and gain the knowledge for your research. You have to find out how life deals with the deadly power of the Sun. Your task is risky though. Can you deal with its stresses and strains? Discuss the weird future lifeforms with your assistant, Agent C. Show what you have learned during the transmissions. Along the way you carve out a unique relationship with her. You have to win her trust but keep up your autonomy at the same time. Both stats will be constantly modified by your answers and checks on them can be passed or failed. At crucial points a failed check means the end of your mission. Agent C wants you to take a psyche test to evaluate your qualities as a researcher. Are you willing to share your true self? It might be risky to fully open up. At the same time, you might be caught lying if you don't. Learn about Arthur Klaassen, the discoverer of Eon of the Green. Agent C will share parts of his diary with you. Haven't you heard of him before? Pay close attention to find out more about the complexities of the Klaassen Project. Key Features: unique game loop of text-based interaction and visuals 25k+ words of interactive fiction hints to the consequences of your choices allow for a tactical approach experimental CGI cut scenes with sound, simulating mental time travel several musical themes to enhance the game's atmosphere
row.short_description: A secret scientific research on life’s final terrene days. Your consciousness serves as a vessel gathering information on a future period they dubbed Eon of the Green. Slowly but surely it takes hold of your mind and the only human factor is that colleague on the intercom.
