row.name: Water 2050
row.detailed_description: Water 2050 is a 2d isometric city manager about dealing with water pollution today so that we can have a future tomorrow. Playing as the Major, you’ll run the last inhabitable city in a not-so-distant future in which we turned our planet into a massive polluted landfill. Most water in Water 2050 is very polluted and barely apt for humans; there is a lot of environmental damage that have almost end life on Earth. Nothing that a little time travel can’t fix. Jump in time to the past to implement real-world technologies and behaviours that will reduce water pollution in the future. Deal with natural calamities, contaminated areas, hard choices, and a weirdly long-lived engineer that will assist you as much as possible. The future of Earth can be fixed today. The game is developed in association by the Water Environment Asociation , and aims to raise awareness of current practices and technologies that are being implemented to reduce our water pollution, thus ensuring a better tomorrow for all of us. Part of the money raised with this game is allocated by the WEF to research, dissemination and programs that address solutions to the water crisis. Game Features: Amazing cartoonish 2d isometric graphics. City builder and resource management mechanics. Awesome time traveling tech that enables to manage the city both in the future and in the past. Improving things in the past makes the future better as a consequence. 14 real-world technologies to research and achieve water sustainability Unlock Special buildings as Stadium, Cemetery, Observatory, Space Rocket Launch Site and many more, each with special events to resolve. Natural calamities as heat waves, smog, electric storm, acid rain, drought, blizzards, sandstorms and more will test your ability to keep the city alive. Dozens of events on which to make decisions with an impact on the survival of the city An informative but lighthearted way to address a very serious issue: How to clean and preserve our water. This is an amazing game that takes the adventure, resource management, city building and survival genres, mixing them with the real world water crisis to create a rich and powerful experience that raises awareness about what could happen to water in the future.
row.short_description: Take on the ultimate challenge of being mayor of the last city with clean water reserves in 2050. Manage resources, discover new technologies and tackle the global water crisis with Water 2050. An innovative blend of city building, resource management, adventure, and survival genres all in one game.

row.name: Ball Animals
row.detailed_description: The Background of Animal Ball Animal Ball is a joyful, local multiplayer, competitive, party game. The story is about small animals. Each player can control a small animal and try to use their belly to collide with the rear of others. Being the last character on the field is your goal. The first player to get three wins will obtain the final victory! Diverse Game Modes The game currently has two game modes, come and choose your favorite! Basic Mode: Play on a fixed map. Endless Mode: Fight on an endless scrolling map. Endangered Animal Characters In the game, you can switch between a variety of animal characters, all of which are endangered species: Golden monkey, crested ibis, panda, monk seal, macaw, elk, Siberian tiger... Various Maps Selection Meteorites, magma, bushes and ice fields Multiple Control Methods This game supports controller and keyboard/mouse. Press and hold to charge, release to attack! ATTENTION! Find the timing of release to achieve super bounce! Behind the Animal Ball... Although the atmosphere of the game seems to be joyful and funny, the story behind it is not peaceful: why do animals of different species fight in the same place and try to stay till the end? If they did have a tolerable environment to live in, who would choose to leave their homeland and fight other creatures in a strange place? What kind of truth is behind these tragedies? Do we humans need to take on certain responsibilities? Protecting the environment and protecting animals is an issue that is so often brought up that it will feel numb when you look at it again. Human beings gradually choose to turn a blind eye because of pain or guilt, and immerse themselves in their own happiness, but all these tragedies are still happening... So we made this free game to bring joy to players, but we also hope that everyone who has experienced this joy can pay attention to and think about the story behind this game, maybe the person who can save them and the world is you. About the Developing Team Animal Ball is developed by a group of friends who love animals. There is a detailed list of all developers in the game. Controllers Required! Ball Animals is a local multiplayer game, you will need one or more controllers to enjoy this game with your friends!
row.short_description: Animal Ball is a local party game, where 2 to 4 animal balls fight against each other...Use your bouncy belly to bounce others away!

row.name: Mysterious Lab
row.detailed_description: The player has two weapons to fight the zombies. The player will find supplyments in zombies's cropse and all the items in the map. Supplyments include bullets, heal medicine, and cards which could be equipped to the weapons and strengthen them. The map and every item is generated randomly and player uses the door to get into another room.
row.short_description: A Rouge like game which the player will explore an abandoned Lab. During which, player will fight with zombles and pick up supplyments to strengthen their weapons.

row.name: Vampiric Tower Remix
row.detailed_description: Victoria the Vampire ascends the Vampiric Tower once more! A brand-new game featuring rooms from both Vampiric Tower 1 & 2, as well as plenty of new ones. Plus, it has all new graphics and music! And it's much easier than 2! For the uninitiated, Vampiric Tower is a box-pushing puzzle game. The original game was made way back in 2000, when I was 16. Vampiric Tower Remix is the best & definitive entry of the series! Push the boxes around to block the spells from the Pumpkins and the Ghosts. Try to pick up all the vials in each room without getting zapped, and then get to the exit! If you do get zapped, do not fret! You have unlimited lives in this game, so just try again! Turn into a bat to fly over spikes, water, pots, and other stuff in your way! Cast ice spells to turn the denizens of the tower into ice cubes that you can push around! Rock out to amazing chiptune remixes of Mozart classics! Featuring 15 worlds with 8 rooms each, for 120 rooms total. The 15 worlds are divided into 5 episodes of 3 worlds each. The worlds in each episode can be tackled in any order. Let’s check out those worlds! The Old Tower : Featuring classics from the original game! Get re-acquainted with the Pumpkins and Ghosts! Jiangshi Junction : The Jiangshis hop around and stop in place if they touch Victoria. Faerie Gardens : Faeries move back and forth to block Victoria’s progress. Nothing a well-placed ice spell can’t fix! Magick Library : Say hello to the Witches! They are intently reading their books, but when the last vial is collected, look out! Tomb of the Sun : The Mummies can be frozen, but they’ll fall apart afterward. Since you can only freeze them once, make it count! Bodacious Botany : These alien plants from Venus just won’t stop re-growing! Medusa’s Lair : Like the Witches, the Snakes wake up when all vials are collected. Their fireballs move pretty fast! Atlantean Shrine : The Shades cast ice spells, just like Victoria! Lil’ Bot Factory : The industrious Lil’ Bots walk back and forth, pushing boxes, pots, flasks, or anything else they find. Ethereal Palace : Imps like to bop back and forth and get in the way. Silly Imps! World Tree Roots : The Sorceresses have mastered a spell that can travel through pillars and pots, just like the Pumpkins and Ghosts! Luckily, it moves much slower than theirs. The Pearly Gates : The Doubles are perfect copies of Victoria. Whatever she does, they follow! Awesome Alchemy : Wisps move about and disintegrate when they touch Victoria. They have no resolve! All Hail Mars : The formidable Knights are invincible and immune to all magic. The Grand Finale : Put your skills to the test in the final world! Can Victoria make it through the 120 rooms of this new tower? Play the game and find out!
row.short_description: A puzzle game where you can fly around as a bat and try not to get zapped by pumpkins.

row.name: DO_OR_DIE Hunt to Survive
row.detailed_description: “DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive” presents an action-packed multiplayer game with a focus on competitive gameplay and diverse game modes. The primary objective is to connect players on a server and client to engage in intense battles within a give time limit, using various weapons to earn high scores and emerge as the winner. The game allows both solo and team-based play, with up to 8 players connecting to a match. The game features three different type of maps, each offering unique game-play experiences: Free For All: In this mode, all players are connected individually, and their scores are tracked separately. Players spawn at different locations with default weapons. The objective is to fight against each other, acquiring weapons from the environment, and scoring points by eliminating opponents. The addition of buffs adds depth and excitement to the gameplay, and players re-spawn with different locations upon death. Team Death Match: Players are divided into two teams automatically, namely the “Red Team” and the “Blue Team.” If there are four players connected, each team will have two players. The teams compete against each other, and the player’s objective is to work with their team members to defeat the opposing team. Upon death, players re-spawn at their team’s locations. Sword Capture: Similar to Team Death Match, this game mode introduces a scoring system based on capturing the enemy team’s sword and bringing it to their team’s sword table. The team with the most points at the end of the match wins. Players must defend their own sword while attempting to capture the enemy team’s sword. The game boasts breathtaking visuals, interesting gameplay effects, and stylized game modes, encouraging players to engage in winning streaks and experience an energetic and thrilling gaming experience. Players can compete with friends and others, enhancing the competitive spirit of “DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive” Overall, the game seems to offer a balanced mix of fast-paced action, strategic gameplay, and teamwork, making it an exciting prospect for players seeking an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer shooter experience. No In-game Purchases and Micro Transactions. Follow us on Discord:
row.short_description: The concept of 'DO OR DIE – Hunt To Survive' revolves around intense player elimination, diverse weaponry, and buffs, with a primary objective of achieving high scores within a given time limit. The game features three distinct game modes, each offering a unique gameplay experience.

row.name: The last door
row.detailed_description: You control a combat robot. Your task is to go through the maze, destroy all the enemy robots and get to the finish line. The passages to the other rooms of the maze are littered with stones. You need to use bombs to free the passages. Your robot can shoot to destroy other robots, you can also use bombs for this. To take the bomb, you just need to approach it, the robot takes it from the ground itself, while the timer starts counting down. After dropping the bomb, do not forget to move a decent distance away, otherwise you will explode. You can not touch walls, stones and other robots - an explosion will occur. A number is indicated on the opponent's robot - how many hits are needed to destroy it. Different robots have different skills - some do not shoot, others shoot different projectiles. At some levels, you have the opportunity to take a super weapon - it destroys robots with one shot.
row.short_description: You control a combat robot. Your task is to go through the maze, destroy all the enemy robots and get to the finish line. The passages to the other rooms of the maze are littered with stones. You need to use bombs to free the passages.

row.name: Etherion Online
row.detailed_description: Gear up! Obtain secret items or master a skill - and join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure! Etherion Online RPG is a modern-2D action MMORPG which takes place on a newly inhabited planet called Etherion which features scarce resources and a beautiful agrestic architecture. Purchase a weapon, level it up by using it on monsters or other players, and prestige it for rewards! Capture bases with a clan or create your own and attempt to take over the land of Etherion! If you're more of a lone-wolf player - venture off and defeat bosses for extremely rare items or become the solidified as the best duelist in the game at Eden Spar. All weapons in Etherion feature attachments, levels, and reward skins for prestiging - which makes every gun unique in its own way. Complete the unique battle pass which releases every 90 days with exclusive, themed, and limited content! Create your own personal character with our custom character creation system features customizable heads, eyebrows, mouths, eyes, beards, and more! Create your Character Etherion Online RPG features a FREE customization system which utilizes tons of different assets for hair, eyebrows, eyes, beards, mouths, and a variety of colors. There are currently over a million different combinations. If you want to create your own CUSTOM outfit then purchase an upload ticket from the store and find the outfit templates on our Discord! Skills Etherion currently features skills such as weaponry, health, mining, and smithing - but we are working on woodcutting, fishing, firemaking, cooking, bounty hunting, crafting, and much more! Skills also feature a secret pet for each skill - they are extremely rare! Open-World PvP & PvM On Etherion you can battle against entire clans, individual players in a spar match, or go defeat rare bosses for their super-rare items / weapons and trophies. You choose your own path! Collecting In the world of Etherion, there are many different secret items, rewards, and collectibles. Sometimes you’ll have to find them, You can dig for them, or get lucky by defeating something and have them rewarded! From secret pets to weapons, to expensive items and trophies, there’s a lot in store for those who enjoy collecting novelty items.
row.short_description: Gear up! Become a prestige master in weapons or master a skill - join thousands of other players in this massive 2D adventure!

row.name: NOX: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: NOX: Chapter 1 is a puzzle game, where we play the role of Gabi, an 11-year-old boy/girl who suffers from night terrors and sleep paralysis. In order to escape from their nightmares, you will have to go deep into their traumas and discover the intricate puzzle that is their life. FEATURES Paradoxial Spaces NOX has a series of non-Euclidean spaces, which the player must use to solve different logic puzzles. Everchanging Gravity Gabi's nightmares are inspired by the work of Escher, The Artist creates space made up of doors that act as portals, curves and ramps that will allow you to make gravity changes through space. Projections In the dreams you will find different drawings made by Gabi, some of them will help you to project new ways to escape from their nightmare.
row.short_description: NOX: Chapter 1 is a first-person puzzle game, where the player has to make use of gravity changes, gravity shifts and portals to explore the dreams and nightmares of a child. All this, in a world inspired by the work of Escher.

row.name: Skeletery
row.detailed_description: Join Our Community About the Game Living as ordinary skeleton is hard - you are dead, but now you need to defend your cemetery against evil humans. Features Unconventional setting of being a good skeleton, trying to live the undead life in your cemetery. Attack with weapons! Block with shield! Roll with style! Collect bones ! Buy buildings ! Get buffs ! Doot ! Dark fantasy RPG, with light touch on story and heavy focus on melee combat and base building. Complex fighting, where success is achieved by a careful balance between attacks, blocks and movement. Base building in Skeletery unlocks powerful buffs that will increase your chances to survive waves of humans. A single-player game with levels progression, where each level represents a unique cemetery that attracts new types of enemies.
row.short_description: Living as ordinary skeleton is hard - you are dead, but now you need to defend your cemetery against evil humans.
row.notes: Violence and blood.

row.name: Those Who Crawl
row.detailed_description: ​As you progressed through the cave tunnels, they slowly tightened until you could not even stand. Now, as you crawl, you wonder if you are not alone in the darkness. Those Who Crawl is a tense horror game about crawling and climbing through cave tunnels. Each hand is controlled individually with a unique crawling and climbing system. The walls are closing in. As you progress, the stone walls become flesh and bone. The water in flooded tunnels is now blood red. This would be a horrible place to die. Now in the darkness, you hear something moving ... something with many legs. Cut the flesh. Utilize sharpened bone knives to cut away at the sinue and flesh that blocks your path. Stab them into the walls to make improvised handholds. Be careful, however, as the fragile bone will break after several uses, leaving you without a lifeline. Things are moving in the dark. Creatures lurk deep within the tunnels. They are bigger than you and faster. You can't fight back. Your best bet is to run - or rather desperately crawl. You could try using your knives, but would that even work against these monsters?
row.short_description: Escape an ever-shrinking cave tunnel in this tense spelunking horror. As the stone walls transform into flesh, you'll face perilous claustrophobic spaces, flooded passages, and twisted inhuman creatures.
row.notes: Gore and Scary situations

row.name: A Familiar World
row.detailed_description: A Familiar World gives the usual jigsaw puzzle genre a different spin. Not only does it feature good-looking models in exciting environments and situations, but it also offers a story element that you unlock by completing puzzles. You can do each puzzle in five different difficulties ranging from surprisingly easy to frustratingly impossible. People who seek a challenge can enjoy this game just as much as those that want to lay back and do some simple jigsaw puzzles. The game plays in and around a castle in a post-apocalyptic world. A long and brutal war left only a few strong men alive. Each settled down in their own part of the world. Those men quickly became the center point of small functioning societies comprised of the remaining females. A Familiar World tells the story of nine women, how they found each other, and how they eventually managed to flee their cruel reality. The story element of this game that can be unlocked by completing puzzles works as a Prologue of a visual novel, A Foreign World . The main story will talk about the struggles those nine women face in this new world they flee to. Can you help them?
row.short_description: Solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock exciting scenes. Discover the mysterious circumstances that led nine women to leave their world and run towards a new life.
row.notes: This game features sexually-themed jigsaw puzzles. By finishing them, you get to see a scene using the image of the puzzle. This can be a sex scene. This game's content includes but is not limited to kissing, cunnilingus, and wax play.

Hop in to Heroic City and visit the art gallery, drop in and out of speedy and fun games, swag up your character and do good while you're at it! By completing missions and playing games you'll get impact items which you can then hatch and send them out to the real world to plant trees, remove plastic waste from oceans and offset carbon from the atmosphere! The choice is yours - the community together decides which issues we focus on. Be bold, be Heroic! Every tree you plant in Heroic City will be planted to the real world by our partner Ecologi.
row.short_description: A Party MMO with real-world impact. Hang out with your friends and play dozens of action-packed multiplayer games. Team up and unlock impact items to be moved into real world impact such as planted trees and carbon removed from the atmosphere!

row.name: Iragon: Prologue
row.detailed_description: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game About the Game Iragon: Prologue is the beginning of a story-driven adventure RPG that draws inspiration from anime series like Fullmetal Alchemist, Attack on Titan, and Berserk. It is set in a fantasy world filled with monstrous creatures and merciless soldiers as well as beautiful women who are eager to show you a good time and rock your world. In this prologue, you play as the aspiring knight Darick, thrown into the middle of a war between two nations by a mysterious young woman in need of his help. Iragon: Prologue allows you to experience living out a high fantasy adventure where you are in control of your destiny! It is best experienced in VR, but we've dedicated an equal amount of care and time to make sure that playing without a VR headset packs just as much of a punch. Story You play as Darick, a poor kid from a small village, who won't let anything stand in the way of his dream of becoming a knight and a hero. Everything changes when you meet a young woman who gets ambushed by soldiers of the Empire. You must learn to use your magic and journey into a dangerous world on your quest to bring her home safe. Along the way, you will battle enemy soldiers, undead skeletons, and perhaps cross paths with seductive creatures of the frozen land while you unlock new erotic adventures. Be the hero, live the story, and go on the adventure of a lifetime while immersing yourself fully in the world of Iragon: Prologue. The story is delivered with motion-captured animations and full voice acting from a professional cast. For those who prefer to just get on with slaying witches and laying bitches, we have also made all the cutscenes and interactions skippable. Features Whether you play in VR or not, you can expect us to deliver: A beautiful love interest Interactive experiences with your love interest Different outfits for the love interest Voice acting Motion captured animations A dynamic combat system that features both magic and melee Destructible environments A dialogue choice system that influences the response you get Gameplay This is not just a story with pretty girls. It's an adventure! Fight your way through tough enemies, master the elements with your magic, collect loot, upgrade your powers, go on quests, interact with whoever catches your eye. Immerse yourself fully in the world, the characters, and the story of a full-fledged fantasy adventure RPG.
row.short_description: The Prologue to an Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.
row.notes: This Game contains content that is not appropriate for young players and may not be appropriate for viewing at work. It contains Violence, Blood and gore, Sexual Content and Strong Language.

row.name: Syren and Friends Roast the Dev
row.detailed_description: Join Syren and friends as they roast the dev for failing to be good at anything! The poor dev has tried over and over, but has been unsuccessful at completing any R18 projects lately. Syren, Aoi and Lola expose the slacker in this hard-hitting expose! Syren and Friends Roast the Dev is a short comedic diversion not too dissimilar from a heavily railroaded kinetic novel that lacks momentum. Enjoy the cute and curvy cast as they talk about things only a geriatric millennial would understand. Not quite a game, not quite a visual novel. This software has a few rare and sporadic interactive elements that do not impact the overall narrative. Assuming there was a narrative, to begin with. It does have a few neato hidden object puzzles to solve, a few painful unskippable videos, and some semi-lewd load screens if you are into that sort of thing. All characters are 18 years or older.

Customize your creature’s appearance, shape your survival story, and face the brutal realities of nature. As a predator, master the hunt and learn to outwit other players, or scavenge from the remains of fallen animals—but beware, danger is everywhere. Trust no one; every encounter could be your last. Dynamic Seasons and Temperature Prepare for seasonal challenges: survive freezing winters, scorch under summer heatwaves, and manage your creature’s body temperature to avoid hypothermia or exhaustion. Strategic planning is key to thriving in this ever-changing environment. Game Modes Sandbox : Practice, fight, and explore without the fear of permanent death. Perfect for learning the ropes and meeting other players. Survival : Dive into the true test of endurance—grow from a young animal to a formidable survivor. row.name: Project Sphinx
row.detailed_description: Project Sphinx is a first person puzzle platformer, in which you make your way through a space station by teleporting. In Project Sphinx, you take the role of a robot sent to a seemingly abandoned space station by a corporation. Your mission is to retrieve crucial data left somewhere on the station's premises. Unfortunately, as is often the case with derelict facilities in the middle of the galaxy - it's in a state of absolute mess and chaos. You're going to have to make your way through destroyed halls, broken down stairways and rooms with seemingly no way out. But you're not just any robot. You're a unit equipped with PAWS - the Portable Arm-mounted Wormhole Slinger (name not approved by the Galactic Corporations Committee). This highly advanced piece of future-tech will let you turn your robot hand into a ball, shoot it, and teleport to it after it bounces off of any solid surface! No, this is not a lie. This is what the future looks like. Using your teleportation power along with your puzzle-solving and platform-jumping skills, there's no way you won't be able to complete your mission. Right? RIGHT? Well, only one way to find out! FEATURES: - Teleport to explore and progress Teleportation is the main means of traversal in the game and it is FUN! You're going to be using your PAWS to jump through the portals you create in order to fulfill your mission. You can teleport almost anywhere, but the blue pools of liquid look pretty dodgy - don't teleport into those, please. - Fast paced traversal Use your skills and bounce around FAST! You can use your robot legs to walk around, sure. But you're a robot with a hand that shoots teleportation portals. Now that sounds like something that could make you go quicker. That's what every robot learns at the 'How to go fast, have fun and not lose too many screws' course in primary school, anyway. It's common robot knowledge. - Mind (and coil) bending puzzles Think the mission will be a walk in the park? Don't worry your little robot head, it definitely will not. You'll have to use every bit of your computing skills to make your way through the station. Rooms will be PUZZLES, corridors will be mazes and your wits will be what sets you apart from other robots on the block. - The ricochet mechanic Teleporting is cool, but there's a trick for it to work. To be able to do it, you have to RICOCHET off of a wall, or any other solid surface, first. Sounds complicated? It's not. Sounds exciting? You bet it is! Thanks to that, you'll be able to gain momentum and speed needed to solve puzzles, move faster and - as an added bonus - look like the coolest robot ever.
row.short_description: In this first-person puzzle-solving game, you're a robot with a mission on a space station. And like any great robot, you're going to have to explore, teleport and ricochet your way around the base, in which each room and corridor is a puzzle to solve.

About the Game Pan’orama is a tile-placing puzzle game of creating beautiful, mellow landscapes, that calms your mind and lets your imagination run free. In Pan’orama, your goal is to score as many points as possible by connecting pieces of land with each other to create a larger environment. You gather points by placing the colorful tiles to create ever-evolving biomes, placing structures and completing quests, which require you to think ahead and plan accordingly. FEATURES: Sculpt your own world Freedom to create is what drives Pan’orama’s gameplay. Shape your own little world out of fields, forests, meadows and structures. Place tiles of the same kind next to each other to transform the terrain into breathtaking vistas! Complete quests and earn rewards Quests of different shapes and sizes will often pop up, requiring you to place specific tiles in specific places. Placing them in the perfect spot and fulfilling their conditions will net you extra points, as all of your previously placed tiles count towards the quest goals. You’ll have to think tactically to get the most out of them! Discover and build structures Well placed tiles will get you points, and after reaching a certain threshold, you’ll be able to pick one of 3 boosters with structures. These will grant you extra tiles and a structure with a special power (to get even more points!). There are 48 structures in total and once you build them all, you get to place an epic Monument! Sculpt epic mountain ranges, fill lakes and meadows with water, create picturesque towns surrounded by plains and forests. In Pan’orama, nothing stops you from using your imagination to its fullest!

row.name: Iso Racer
row.detailed_description: In Iso Racer, players take control of a variety of racing cars and compete in a range of events across different tracks. The game features multiplayer mode, allowing players to compete against AI or other players online. The physics of the game are also realistic combined with drifting to make the game more interesting. Players have the ability to customize their vehicles and improve their performance. Drifting Style! The beginning of the game is simple, it looks like a typical top-down racing game, but don't let that fool you! You need to properly cut your speed before the corners in order to pass them with a perfect drift! Car damage is only visual Iso Racer is a racing game developed and published by Pogo Concepts. The game features top-down perspective and is heavily inspired by classic racing games, while still offering modern features such as online multiplayer. We also care about interaction between players, which is why, among other things, we decided to have chat in the form of clouds above the vehicles, and we plan to add more types of competition in the future, beyond the standard races during the same game. Overall, Iso Racing offers a fun and challenging racing experience that is both nostalgic and modern. Its emphasis on strategy and customization sets it apart from other arcade-style racing games, and its online multiplayer mode offers endless replayability for those looking to compete against other players around the world.
row.short_description: Iso Racer is a top-down multiplayer racing game focusing on realistic driving physics combined with drifting. It contains a variety of tracks, cars and the ability to personalize vehicles. It's a great experience for casual and hardcore racing fans.

row.name: Parsec
row.detailed_description: In Parsec you pilot a spaceship through a field of asteroids trying to destroy as many as possible before they destroy you. You have three different weapons that can be picked up around the world, their spawning is random. Health can also be picked up from random spawns and sometimes dropped by asteroids. WEAPONS Blaster Your starting weapon is the Blaster, it has a fairly lackluster firerate but can destroy any asteroid in four shots or less. Minigun The Minigun is exactly what the name implies, a Many-Gun! It has a very fast firerate and only slightly less damage than the blaster, making it a much more effective weapon. Sniper The Sniper Laser has extremely high damage allowing it to destroy any asteroid in a single shot. It can even penetrate multiple with a single shot, but beware of its very low firerate. HAZARDS Small Asteroid Typically breaking off of a passing comet, small asteroids may not look like much but they can pick up incredible speed and quickly destroy any spaceship in their path and push other asteroids very far. They deal 25 damage if stationary but are likely to do vastly more at speed. Medium Asteroid Floating peacefully through space at a leisurely pace, medium asteroids are far less volatile than small ones. They deal 50 damage, while being more than small asteroids they are far less likely to slam into you at a high speed. Large Asteroid Sitting almost stationary, large asteroids are extremely dangerous if you bump into them but incredibly easy to hit and hard not to avoid. They deal 75 damage. Debris When hit asteroids can break into multiple smaller pieces. While the clutter may be annoying they are largely harmless. They deal 25 damage. Health You have 150 health, each 50 is represented by a full blue square in the bottom left of the GUI. Each size of asteroid deals varying levels of damage and you can replenish 50 with a health pickup, represented by a grey square with '+50' on it. Score Multiplier The score multiplier is a special pickup that doubles the points you receive from any asteroids you destroy while it is active. It is represented by a grey square with '2x' on it and you know it's active when '2x' is over your score. Your high score saves between games, see how high you can get!

row.detailed_description: Tonight we hunt Howl of Iron is a 3rd Person Action Adventure title with a focus of hunting your enemies. The city offers several paths and heights to move and attack. Travel through the streets of steamfall your way stalking the enemies that scatter the streets and rooftops of the buildings, fighting them melee, avoiding their powerful shots to avoid being defeated, using your combos to finish them off. Death from above Explore back-to back each section to find the patrols’ weak spots. Climb buildings to attack from above and escape unfavorable encounters. Execute unaware enemies. combine light and heavy slashes for greater effect while you dash through their formation. Make them fear you Use your thundering howl to make your adversaries lose their composure, opening them for a quick finishing blow. This game is a university project made thanks to the combined efforts of U-tad students from the Master of Art, Design, Programming and Production.

row.name: 异世界的雪与奇迹

row.name: Battlemon
row.detailed_description: Cute, chaotic, and competitive — Battlemon lets you and your friends face off with quirky creatures in dynamic arena battles. Step into the world of Battlemon , a fast-paced local multiplayer fighting game where quirky creatures clash in vibrant arenas. Whether you’re going head-to-head with a friend or testing your skills in challenging events, every fight is a chance to discover new strategies and unleash the true power of your favorite Battlemon. Battlemon blends party-game fun with competitive fighting depth , making it perfect for both casual players and those who love finding clever combos. With its charming art style, evolving roster, and easy pick-up-and-play design, it’s a game that keeps surprising you every match. Key Features  Real-Time Arena Battles Engage in vibrant, head-to-head brawls. Battles are handled in real time, so stay sharp and react quickly! Huge and Growing Cast of Characters Choose from a quirky line-up: Dunse, Abble, Blink, Pelage —and more are frequently added via updates. Varied Modes & Events Dive into more than just versus battles—test your skills in raids, boss fights, and other engaging event formats. Free to Play Jump in without paying a penny. Extras like early access characters can be accessed via optional DLCs. Couch-PvP Fun Perfect for casual local multiplayer sessions—just grab a controller, sit side by side, and duke it out. Why It Stands Out Charming Visuals Meet Competitive Depth Cute creature fighters bring a whimsical aesthetic, while unique movesets ensure strategic battles. Inclusive, Local Party Play No online connection needed—perfect for living room fun with friends or siblings. Constant Evolution A continuously expanding roster and event systems mean there's always something new to discover.

row.name: I Won't Forget Hue
row.detailed_description: Mystery of the multi-coloured glasses: I Won’t Forget Hue is a first-person, psychedelic thriller game. Disorganized and alone, a woman finds herself crafting new glasses in order to view her own home through a different lens. Throughout the home, you will go searching for new and different coloured lenses, while the house seems to be alive and ever-changing around you. You have the ability to craft new glasses, making you able to see even more of the seemingly multi-coloured house. During your journey through the house, you will hear many noises that seem impossible to explain. But these noises have a cause, only you can’t see them, yet. But once you see them using the correct glasses, they will see you too. Chasing you down the hallways, not letting you have any rest in this altering house. Gameplay: In I Won’t Forget Hue, you will be walking around the narrow hallways and rooms of a dark, old house. But while you explore this mansion, you find that you might not be alone. Different glasses cause the house around you to change. Once the evil finds you looking around, it will chase you all over. You must find a way to use the colours to your advantage, to find new parts and figure out what how to hide from the evil. All while you try to figure out what happened to the rest of your family. But beware as the game progresses, the evil increases. Play alone in this 3D single player game. Find and use the coloured lenses and torn painting pieces. Switch between the different coloured lenses on your glasses to see new parts of the mansion, but also see the evil that hides within it. Stay out of sight when in colour, and find ways to hide from the enemies. Try different types of strategies to discover and progress. Key Features: Living enemies: Enemies listen to your sounds and movements, and will chase you when seen. Psychedelic thriller: Experience colours which cause the surroundings around you to change. 3D horror adventure gaming experience Hide and Sneak: Sneak, hide and move around while staying out of the enemies grasp. Rediscovery: Walk through the same areas, but see and discover new changes every time. Collecting: Find all the torn painting pieces and coloured lenses throughout the mansion. I Won’t Forget Hue is being actively developed by a team of seventeen students. We need your feedback to make I Won’t Forget Hue the great game we want it to be for the players. Get in touch with us via the community Discord, social media or e-mail to tell us what you think and we *will* get back to you!
row.short_description: Disorganized and alone, a woman finds herself crafting new glasses in order to look at her own home with different shaded views. I won’t forget Hue is a psychedelic thriller experience. You’ll go searching for new lenses, try to figure out what is happening to her home and why she is all alone.

And then step by step restore and improve eco-situation of the Earth. In the end of your game you will get your statistics on how successful your mission was. Play ecology world simulator Save the earth. It’s one of the excellent nature games. Eco-friendly app. Planet Earth and the solar system needs protection. In our world simulator you can rebuild the world and create a good Earth strategy of saving. In our nature and solar system games you can develop modern green projects. Build correct good Earth strategy and tactics to avoid climate smash. Find out more about ocean problems, water poisoning or Earth lighting. Disaster games might be very useful. Playing Save the Earth you can create your own world. Your strategy may either save the planet or smash the world. Play solar system games and learn more about world’s protection. It contains ecological characteristics of real regions of our Terra. Play our strategy game and you’ll be able to make our planet a better place. Civilization and eco sphere need your protection. Saving our world in the strategy game will help to maintain our planet in reality but not only in strategy games. Playing the clicker you may not depend on the internet connection. Solving ecology problems in the world simulator you learn how to do it in the real world. Eco questions do worry our civilization not only in nature games. Take part in saving our planet together with us! We ourselves are in fact active preservationists of so part of the money we get from sales of the game we put to charity.

row.name: VMVA - Virtual Museum for Virtual Art
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Virtual Museum for Virtual Art! It is a freely accessible museum, which exclusively exhibits virtual art. Like in many video games, the visitor walks around the museum in a first person perspective using their mouse and keyboard. The museum has five main rooms, with four of them following the ”white cube” format. The fifth and biggest room is the main hall where visitors get orientations about the current exhibition. Although most video games and virtual worlds are inhabited by designed objects and textures, these tend to serve a secondary, decorative role. Often acting as scenery or props, the most common aesthetic experience of virtual art is of a peripheral nature. Whether or not something is regarded as an object of ’fine art’ or rather as a decorative object is a matter of perception. This difference in perception has much to do with the context in which the given artwork occurs. By mimicking the architectural style of a classical art museum, Virtual Museum for Virtual Art seeks to provide a platform for virtual artworks to be perceived and considered as fine art.
row.short_description: Welcome to Virtual Museum for Virtual Art! It is a freely accessible museum, which exclusively exhibits virtual art. The museum has five main rooms, with four of them following the ”white cube” format. In the main hall visitors can get orientations about the current exhibition.

row.name: Qiybz
row.detailed_description: Qiybz is a game where you control an automatically jumping cube with other randomized cubes being as platforms and / or enemies. The main goal is to achieve the largest true highscore possible, but beware! The higher the score, the higher the difficulty. The spawned cubes are randomized and there are over 20 different cube types that can be spawned, provided certain in-game conditions are met. With randomization also comes the so-called probability hierarchy, with some cubes being so rare that you might not see one even after ten thousand cubes. Familiarizing yourself with the cube types also gains an advantage over randomly jumping on cubes. The gaps between the cubes ensure that precision in landing on to the platforms is crucial. Enemy elimination is also important, as you will see if you try this game... Note that spontaneous change of character skin is not possible, and you must change the skin manually if you want it to change. The same goes for backgrounds. Based on player feedback this can be subject to change, and spontaneous change especially for backgrounds might become a feature in the future. Soundtracks can change based on in-game conditions, but not all soundtracks are available this way, and some must be activated manually if one wants to listen to them. Some important, additional information : The enemies start to spawn after a score of 5, where enemy cubes (the cubes with an 'L' character in them) must be destroyed by jumping on them a number of times in order to get lives. Lives act as a shield against enemy projectiles (for example, the blood cubes), and are also needed to transform score into currency (2 lives per exchange) by jumping on the gray cubes with a peculiar symbol in them. The currency can then be used in the shop to alter the game in some ways. A boss cube can be summoned when the player reaches a score of 10k, and bosses start to automatically spawn after a score of 20k (the higher the score, the harder the bosses that can spawn).
row.short_description: Qiybz is a cube-filled auto-platformer with randomized platforms and experimental music, respecting skill, precision and a good balance between cautious and reckless behaviour.

row.name: The Visitor
row.detailed_description: Summary 'The Visitor' is a singleplayer first-person phycological-horror game where you play as an author who suffers from a mental illness. She has procrastinated on completing her book and won't get paid until she finishes it. Unfortunately for her, not only is she running out of money, she is also running out of her medication. There are chapters that you are expected to redo in order to get paid. Her medication had allowed her to stay up until a normal time until she felt tired and had to sleep, as her medication drains she has become exhausted far more quickly. This leads to her sleeping more than usual which, since your are almost out of medication and your deadline for your book is closing in, is not a good thing! Since her medication is low you will experience noises, and visions that you normally wouldn't. Are they real? Who knows. Complete the chapters and get paid in order to return to living your average life. Gameplay In 'The Visitor' you will play as an author named Rachel. Your goal is to complete your book chapter by chapter before the deadline that is coming up. You will be running out of medication so you will start to lose touch of reality. The longer you sit and type, the more you will slip into a schizophrenia state of mind. After each completed chapter you will need to get some rest so you get keep a clear mind and continue your book. If writing is too much, take breaks and explore the farmhouse. The further you progress in the game, the more unstable you will become. Key Features AI There are 2 main AI enemies. One will stalk you and one will chase you. Immersive 3D Sound The sound profile is very important. It will guide you to survival and it will create a suspenseful atmosphere. Headphones are highly recommended.
row.short_description: In 'The Visitor' you will play as an author named Rachel. Your goal is to complete your book chapter by chapter before the deadline that is coming up. The longer you sit and type, the more you will slip into a schizophrenia state of mind. Complete the chapters and return to a normal average life!

row.name: Rabbit Hole Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: You can support us by purchasing the full game on Steam. The full version of the game contains 3 chapters and the continuation of the story. PLOT: Sean Turner came to the small provincial town of Rabbit Hole to see his daughter. When Sean arrives there, he realized that something terrible had happened in that town. There were no people around, but its empty streets were filled with terrible creatures. Now Sean Turner must save his daughter and get out of this hell. But soon he will realize that there is more in this than meets the eye, and the evil he is fighting with has entered our world for a reason. ABOUT THE GAME: The deeper Sean dives into this mysterious adventure, the more shocking circumstances arise. Sean learns the terrible secrets that the townspeople hid behind the walls of their homes. You’ll visit numerous atmospheric locations, solve varied puzzles and most importantly have to survive the attacks of a myriad of dangerous creatures. The plot unfolds rapidly and immerses you in a complex and supernatural story written in all the best traditions of the Survival Horror genre. GAME FEATURES: A Mysterious thriller with a gripping plot. A large atmospheric town with explorable buildings. Alluring graphics and detailed locations. Varied monsters that react to you based on sight and sound. Multiple viable approaches to combat: fight directly or take a stealthy approach. Numerous mysteries and conundrums to solve.
row.short_description: An ancient evil has descended upon the rural town of Rabbit Hole. Now Shaun Turner not only has to untangle a twisted web of supernatural events and mysteries to save his family but also escape from the hellish remains of his hometown.

row.name: Never Immortal
row.detailed_description: Never Immortal Never Immortal is a 2D multiplayer topdown shooter featuring two different exciting gamemodes: Wave Survival and Zombie Mystery? Wave Survival (PvE) Can be played alone or with friends In the Wave Survival gamemode, you need to survive waves of zombies to avoid being eaten alive. You can try to survive as many waves as you can or you can also try to beat the map. You can also buy weapons, ammo, attachments or grenades in the shop. Every 5 waves you fight a boss. They have a lot of health so make sure to replenish your health and ammo! You can also try to get the Weapon Upgrade machine which will allow you to give your weapon special powers. Zombie Mystery (PvP) Requires a minimum of 3 players, but recommended for 6+ players In this gamemode you have three roles: Human Zombie Detective Humans and the detective have to survive or find and eliminate the zombies. Zombies have to eliminate the humans and the detective. The zombies at first glance look like the humans but they can transform into their zombie form which gives them speed but at the cost of being able to shoot bullets which means they have to kill the others by walking through them.  All players can buy weapons and items in the shop, with money which can be earned by playing the objective and winning. The zombies have exclusive items they can use to help them win. The detective does twice as much damage as the other players and also has exclusive items. Humans and detectives must refrain from killing other humans. Players can identify bodies by pressing 'Q' by default.
row.short_description: Never Immortal is a 2D multiplayer topdown shooter with two different exciting gamemodes. Battle with other players against either hordes of zombies in the Wave Survival gamemode, or against each other in the Zombie Mystery gamemode.
row.notes: The game contains pixelated blood, bloody pixelated corpses, and depictions of drugs.

row.name: Ghouls Of Divinity
row.detailed_description: Step into the role of a deity in this fast-paced 3D real-time strategy and god simulation game. Command a civilization of ghouls in a swampy fantasy world, utilizing physics-based combat to lead your tribe to victory. Key Features: Lead a Ghoul Civilization Command a variety of ghouls, each with distinct perks. Manage resources like food and mana to expand your tribe. Equip your ghouls with melee or ranged weapons, engaging in dynamic physics-based combat with throwable weapons. Customize and Strategize Influence your ghouls' behavior by distributing skill points across various stats. Tailor your strategy by enhancing specific attributes to suit your playstyle. Unlock new ghoul types and spells as you progress through the game. Conquer and Expand Use powerful spells to support your tribe or hinder your enemies. Construct buildings to produce weapons, generate mana, and expand your control. Face off against rival ghoul tribes and formidable bosses. Level Editor Create your own levels with a powerful, tool-assisted editor. Design levels effortlessly by setting key details—the rest is automatically generated. Gameplay Overview: As a deity, your mission is to grow and lead your ghoul civilization while managing essential resources like food and mana. Your ghouls have their own behaviors but can be guided to gather resources, build structures, and engage enemies. Food allows them to reproduce and pray, generating mana for casting powerful spells. Customize your tribe through a dynamic skill system that lets you enhance specific attributes of your ghouls, influencing their abilities and tactics. Whether you prefer aggressive combat, resource efficiency, or strategic spellcasting, you can tailor your approach to each scenario. Engage in thrilling physics-based combat where every thrown weapon and environmental interaction can change the course of battle. Equip your ghouls with melee weapons or staffs for ranged attacks to your advantage. Use a variety of spells to bolster your ghouls or disrupt your foes, altering the battlefield and influencing the outcome of engagements. Construct buildings to expand your territory, produce weapons, and generate additional mana. Immerse yourself in a vibrant world where strategy and quick thinking are key. Lead your tribe to ultimate supremacy in this unique blend of real-time strategy and god simulation.
row.short_description: Command a civilization of dancing ghouls in this fast-paced 3D real-time strategy and god simulation game. Utilize physics-based combat with throwable weapons to expand your tribe. Manage resources, cast powerful spells, and eliminate rival ghoul races to achieve total domination.

row.name: ResttW
row.detailed_description: Restt is an addictive game, which will test how well can you handle your anger and stress. The game is in hand-made graphics with a retro touch. The whole game is inspired by Slovak streamer resttpowered. There are fifty-seven unique levels in this game. Six of those levels are bosses. The entire game runs in a 2D. row.name: BABBDI
row.detailed_description: BABBDI is a short, first person exploration experience with light narrative and platforming elements. Visit the town of BABBDI, a forsaken district in the outer ring of the megalopolis. Meet its inhabitants and discover how to escape. You will find various items unlocking special movement abilities, such as the baseball bat, the pickaxe and the motorcycle. Secret collectible objects can be found all around town. There is no combat in BABBDI. Press F12 to take a screenshot. (screenshots will be saved to your picture folder in addition to the steam screenshots)
row.short_description: Find your way out of BABBDI. A short, first person exploration experience.

row.name: StarRaver
row.detailed_description: Hang out with your friends and party in this sci-fi music experience! Visit the unique clubs defining Starcade Arcade and enjoy the casual multiplayer party games in each room. Test your aim in a sci-fi western saloon with a game of Space Pong, enjoy classics like VR Tic-Tac Toe, vibe with all species of aliens in the notorious Club Jazz, party with DJ Inkers while you play with Space Slurpies. Finally, relax and enjoy the show as you attend the StarRaver Concert. You are a VIP guest in the Starcade Arcade universe. Welcome to our multiversal club.
row.short_description: Hang out with your friends and party in this sci-fi music experience! Visit the unique clubs defining Starcade Arcade and enjoy the casual multiplayer party games in each room.

row.name: Silence In The Cabin
row.detailed_description: About 'Silence In The Cabin' is an Open Map Survival Horror Game, where you must survive Dark linear story sections in order to unlock more areas of the world. With gameplay heavily inspired by 'Resident Evil 7' and a tone more similar to 'P.T.' and 'Silent Hill'. Silence In The Cabin aims to be one Heck of a Horror Experience. What sets it apart from other indie games like it, is The Impressive visual quality, focus on dark Atmosphere, and Great Presentation. Combat is Hard, interesting and crucial to the gameplay formula. row.name: Christmas Luge
row.detailed_description: The penguins in the villages below need some Christmas cheer! Slide your way down the snowy mountains, gathering scarves along the way, and toss them to penguins in need. Features Slide down the luge, hitting the ramps and corkscrews on the way Throw scarves at cold penguins Charming Christmas atmosphere
row.short_description: The penguins in the villages below need some Christmas cheer! Slide your way down the snowy mountains, gathering scarves along the way, and toss them to penguins in need.

row.name: 流浪荒岛
row.detailed_description: Thrilling battles Wandering Desert Island features powerful bosses, dangerous dungeons, and monsters spawning in different island biomes. You can match weapons and equipment to unlock powerful skills to slash, block, tumble and destroy these monsters to survive! Classic sandbox survival gameplay Farming and fishing, cutting down trees and digging for mines, building huts, these are all indispensable. However, you don't need pickaxes and axes to sabotage here, an iron sword is enough. Unlock and grow technology Technology changes lives, and with these technologies, you can upgrade your home. Expanded lighting, rapid watering, resource regeneration... Explore the island and visit NPCs Not all islands are deserted, and some are inhabited by residents! Deal with the residents and trade goods with them. Each island has unique creatures and resources to explore.
row.short_description: Wandering is a pixel-style sandbox action-adventure where you play as a drifting desert island adventurer trying to survive on a pristine desert island. You can explore unknown islands on a raft and get unique resources and treasures. Conquer powerful enemies and acquire rare equipment.

row.name: Chex
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Chex, an exciting new twist on the classic strategy game of chess! In this thrilling game, you'll need to use all of your cunning and strategy to outwit your opponent on the hexagonal board. Each player starts with a set of pieces, each with their own special abilities and movement patterns. You'll need to carefully plan your moves and anticipate your opponent's actions in order to capture their pieces and emerge victorious. But beware! The hexagonal board introduces new challenges and opportunities for your pieces. Diagonal lines of attack are now a possibility, and you'll need to think creatively to navigate the curved borders of the board. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate hexagonal chess master? Play Chex now and find out! -- ChatGPT Features included: * Gliński's hexagonal chess variant * Undo by pressing 'Z' * Win/Loose by a king's death!
row.short_description: Chex is a strategic board game currently based on Gliński's hexagonal variant of chess. Players must use their pieces to capture their opponent's king. The hexagonal board introduces new challenges and opportunities.

row.name: Julia: A Science Journey
row.detailed_description: Julia: a Science Journey is a narrative adventure about viruses, society, and life choices. The story begins in 2020 as our main character lives a humdrum teenage life while she deals with high school, her family and her friends. Will you help Julia navigate through the complexities of adult life while the COVID-19 pandemic changes her world forever? Features Experience the first episode of a story-rich tale of personal growth amidst the covid-19 pandemic Contribute to a citizen science project Play mechanics inspired by everyday challenges: detect fake news, deal with teachers, bike faster! Face adulthood by surviving high school while preserving your mental health
row.short_description: Julia: a Science Journey is a narrative adventure about viruses, society, and life choices.

row.name: The Showdown Effect: Reloaded
row.detailed_description: Experience fast-paced over-the-top multiplayer action in The Showdown Effect: Reloaded. Join players from around the world to engage in high-octane battles filled with bullets, explosions, and one-liners! Hone your skills fighting against unique characters! Choose from a roster of 10 distinct characters, each with their own unique moves and playstyle! Victory hinges on your ability to leverage your character's strengths against your opponents' vulnerabilities. Master the intricacies of each combatant to dominate the showdown and emerge as the champion! Battle across time and space! From a medieval fortress in `Battle of the Bandits` to the bright neon lights of `Downtown Beatdown`, battle across 6 large maps from across time to see who the true champion of the world is! Showcase your style with unique skins for your character and weapons! Make your character your own with millions of possible skin combinations. Customize your character and weapons so you can be victorious in style! Go solo or team up in a variety of game-modes! Change up the experience with 4 different game-modes. Battle against the world in the free-for-all 'Showdown' mode; craft strategy and team up to defeat your opponents in 'Team Elimination'; take down the enemy henchman who have come to hunt you down in 'The Expendables'; and rise to top in 'One Man Army'. There is no shortage of ways to battle! Make the game your own with customizable rulesets! Create custom-servers with custom rules to play how you want. Increase the intensity with 'explosive throws' or stop worrying about having to reload with 'infinite reload'. With billions of combinations, the possibilities are endless to make the game your own! Fight for glory and climb the leaderboard in ranked combat! Climb the leaderboard in the ranked 'Showdown' and 'Team Elimination' game-modes, where you can earn elo over time. Only one can reign at the top!
row.short_description: Experience fast-paced over-the-top multiplayer action in The Showdown Effect: Reloaded. Join players from around the world to engage in high-octane battles filled with bullets, explosions, and one-liners!

row.name: 三国大领主

row.name: Eight Winds
row.detailed_description: Master your sword, master your body, master your own mind to overcome your opponents. Master your own limits and surpass them. Lightning paced action, one bad move could spell your doom. Play Locally Play locally to improve your mastery without interference Obstacle Mode Destroy all the targets as quickly as possible to test your limits More will be seen in the future!

row.name: HappySnowMan
row.detailed_description: To celebrate Christmas in 2022! The purpose of this game is to travel through various platforms to the last island. Run to the stable on the last island, enjoying a simple and casual calm song. Depending on which platform you step on, the speed of movement and jumping power will vary. Don't forget to save your progress by pressing the 'E' key on the island's landmark. =Platform= On the desert platform, speed and jump power are greatly reduced On the magma platform, the speed is very low, but the jumping power is greatly increased. On the ice platform, the speed is very high. =Control= W move forward A move left S move backward D move right SPACEBAR j ump =etc= Automatically respawn at -20y height. The character is movable in the air without drag. At the landmark on the center of the island, you can press E key to change the respawn point and it will be marked with a green flag. This game will not be updated for the time being.

row.name: 幻想乡之玉
row.detailed_description: Player Communication Group : 743660183 Game Introduction 'Gensokyo Orb' is a uniquely styled and deeply engaging 2D strategy board game, featuring both PVP duels and PVE adventure modes, as well as the option to embark on co-op adventures with friends. Game Features Form a unique team with 3 out of more than 20 distinctive Gensokyo girls, and engage in strategy-rich battles against other players Command the girls in detail during battles, offering higher freedom within turns compared to traditional tactical games, allowing for movement interspersed among skill releases to gain advantages in battle Freely destroy or modify terrain to create more favorable battle conditions Grow in battle! As the battle progresses, purchase spell cards, unlocking more powerful abilities for the girls Collect Gensokyo Orbs to unlock unique and exclusive spell cards for your girls. Embark on many interesting Gensokyo adventures, vanquishing various youkais causing incidents Unpredictable events are like sudden storms! Touhou Project Original Creator: Team Shanghai Alice Game Development: Tri-eye This game complies with the Touhou Project Steam Publication Policy.

row.name: The Specter Chronicles: Episode 1 - The False Prophet
row.detailed_description: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat. You are a Specter, a highly-trained enforcer of the Warden who rules over humanity as a godlike algorithmic entity. You have suffered a severe memory loss during a mission to track down the Prophet, a rebel leader who defies the Warden’s regime. With the help of a neural engineer, you must restore your memories by reliving them. But what will you discover in your own memories? Explore a dystopian world through branching narratives driven by your decisions Are you a brute who decimates everyone and everything that stands in your path? Or are you a smooth operator who prefers to avoid confrontation? The decision is yours. Defeat your opponents using a unique combat system Engage in turn-based combat where you can combine 6 basic attacks into combos, counters, and feints. Tailor your gear to suit your fighting style Install mods into your weapon and armor to infuse unique properties and functions, such as adding bonus points to an attribute or granting a buff during combat. Randomized runs The fragments of memories that you encounter during a run will be randomly drawn, allowing you to revisit the memories that you want and discard the ones that you don’t. This game is for you if you… Enjoy text-based adventures that read like novellas. Are looking for a break from card battlers and typical RPG combat - the combat system in The Specter Chronicles is definitely one-of-a-kind! Are a comic book fan. This game is NOT for you if you… Don’t like text-heavy games. Prefer action-based combat over turn-based combat.
row.short_description: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Comic Book Violence, Fictional Drug Use

row.name: Forest Life
row.detailed_description: Forest Life is an adventure game which propagates environmental protection. In this game, players will play as five different characters and experience five environmental theme scenes relating to sustainable palm oil, orangutan conservation, rainforest protection, etc. Players need to make a variety of choices through their own understanding, and reach different story endings. Through the game, players will learn how the market demands for palm oil would affect the rainforests, thus establishing a deeper understanding of the changes in the ecological environment of wildlife; understanding the difficulties faced by orangutans in coexistence with humans; and recognizing the importance of environmental protection, and finally, establishing environmental awareness and developing environment-friendly living habits. Storyline: rich and full of metaphors, each play brings a different experience and inspiration to the player. Gameplay: creates an explorative adventure and extends the level of discovery beyond the game. Choices: decision-based narrative, inviting players to choose based on their interests and explore reactions that might happen. There are right or wrong answers, but different choices will lead to new possibilities! Chain Effects: Each decision made by the player may influence the game world, creating a butterfly effect.
row.short_description: Players will play as five different characters and experience five environmental theme scenes relating to sustainable palm oil, orangutan conservation, rainforest protection, etc. Players need to make a variety of choices through their own understanding, and reach different story endings.

row.name: Forest of Frequencies
row.detailed_description: Step into a world where music, magic and nature collide. Forest of Frequencies is a single player music adventure strategy game where you can explore a world filled with dangerous creatures, breath taking flora and spirits looking for their bodies. Music, visual art & gameplay comes together to form a unique experience made for those who love the interplay and combination of art forms. Features Tune into the power of magical frequencies Effect the world around you with music. Search for magical frequencies using a radio to aid you on your journey. Hypnotise enemies, guide souls and defeat hungry hollow husks all through the power of music. Protector of musical spirits The forest is suffering. Musical spirits have become separated from their bodies and have had to go into hiding to avoid predation. Find these spirits and safely guide them back to their bodies. Dangers of the Forest On your journey you will encounter different enemies that all pose a unique danger. Some can be hypnotised by music, some are drawn to music and others will detune your radio. You must come up with a plan to keep you and the spirits safe. Choose your own path Find your own way through the environment. The clearest path might not be the safest one… or the most adventurous. Breath-taking environment The magic of music has not only affected the creatures within the world but the flora as well. Glowing mushrooms and coral like fungi dot the landscape. Lose yourself in this rich environment. About the team Forest of Frequencies was made within 14 weeks by Dapper Pigeon, a team of 16 students without prior game design or development experience. Everything in the game from models to the music has been produced by the team itself. The team would like to thank everybody who helped during the process of developing our game and of course you the players! Can't wait? Whishlist now to be notified as soon as Forest of Frequencies is released!
row.short_description: Forest of Frequencies is a single player music adventure-strategy game where you must guide spirits back to their bodies. Explore a world filled with dangerous creatures and breathtaking flora.

row.name: Force of Nature 2: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Force of Nature 2: Prologue offers incredible adventures full of mystery in the world of magic and danger. Play through the first world and uncover its secrets. You will have to gather resources, prepare food, build houses and constructions, grow plants and create hybrids, tame and care for animals, craft clothes and weapons, fight enemies and bosses, touch the world of magic, solve the mysteries of the Force of Nature stone, restore the balance of power and find a way to get home. Experience all the main mechanics of the main game and explore the world. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management. Key features: Procedurally generated world Day/night cycle and dynamic weather Gathering and crafting of items Building of constructions and houses Farming and animals Different biomes Exploration of dungeons Boss fights Storyline with two possible endings Side quests Character customization Plot At the dawn of times, the far stretching lands of this world were empty and uncontrolled. The Ancient Gods were left desolate, with no one to glorify them nor to lead. Combining the power of all elements they created a stone. The Force of Nature. By the use of its power the gods opened the gates to other worlds and resettled different races through there, populating the earth. The power of the Stone was enormous, using magical wind and streams. Making it possible for all walks of life to live in peace and harmony. This lasted for thousands of years, until one day the Stone was destroyed...
row.short_description: Force of Nature 2: Prologue is an introduction to the world of the main game. Explore one of the many worlds and uncover its mystery. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management

row.name: Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzles
row.detailed_description: Solve jigsaw puzzles and discover a new world of fantasy. Piece together stylistic digital artwork featuring elves, dwarves, wizards, goblins and much more! Enjoy a selection of 24 fantasy puzzles, expandable to over 200 with DLC. Customize your game with jigsaw size and piece shape options. The puzzles can be as challenging as you decide. Enjoy an immersive fantasy experience, with atmospheric interface and soundtrack. Are you ready? Begin your fantasy puzzle adventure!
row.short_description: A selection of fantasy jigsaw puzzles. Customize your puzzle experience and expand the game with DLC.

row.name: To the Top
row.detailed_description: an·ger/ˈaNGɡər/: a strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility. I made this game to make you angry. To the Top is a punishing 2D platformer, a short introduction and homage to the 'rage-game' genre. You move left, right, aim with the mouse, and launch yourself onto platforms. That's the game. Throw in an ounce of log-collecting gameplay and a small story and you've got yourself 'To the Top'. With enough time and practice, you can truly fly through the game, climbing your way towards the top of each new challenging area. Or you could fall down over, and over, and over again. Your choice. Leap through new areas with the power of your own legs Indulge in a short, wholesome narrative Listen to soothing piano tracks Make temporary progress with permanent anger Experience the wonderful sensation of rage
row.short_description: It's her wish that you climb to the top. It's mine to make you angry doing it.

row.name: Battle Support
row.detailed_description: • shop You can spend gold coins to open the parts box or spend gold coins to buy supplies • Armory Obtaining parts can be used to upgrade troops, and can also upgrade assets and defensive weapons. • Combat: The skill box will be dropped during the battle. Players need to manually destroy the skill box. After destroying the skill box, a skill will be randomly selected to assist the player. If the opponent still has troops, you can choose to use the remaining troops for your own use or to reward gold coins after killing. After winning the victory, the player can customize how many troops and supplies to deploy. This function will only trigger other modes in the regional battle. • AI: In the setting interface, the player can customize the name and the name of the AI. The AI will randomly attack in a certain direction in the regional battle. The level of the AI unit is random, and the AI ​​is equipped with a random unit. • How to play: Area war gameplay One game in the area is divided into 3 small area, and players need to win all the small area to win. Single player mode There are 3 dots in the middle, whoever steps on the most dots and persists until the end of the game time will win. Offensive and defensive mode The defensive team needs to defend until the end of the time to win, and the offensive team needs to win 3 areas to win. • Area war: There are 2,280 areas in the entire map. Any one of the teams occupying most of the areas will be considered as the strong side, and then the other two teams will be given the option to surrender. If one of the teams does not surrender, they will continue to fight. If they all surrender, the strong side will You can obtain all the troops and materials of the opponent and win the final victory. Players need to occupy all areas to achieve the final victory. Players must not only occupy the area but also consider the strength and materials of each area. If there is a shortage of materials in a certain area, the troops will drop Therefore, the materials must be replenished in time. The deployed troops and materials can be changed at any time. You can also deploy multiple material factories and material warehouses in the area. After the material factories are deployed and produced, the players can choose to allocate them to any area or material warehouse in the material warehouse. There is a lot of storage space to upgrade the factory storage space will also increase accordingly. The material warehouse is used to store materials and cannot be used for supplies. After the final victory, the materials in the material warehouse will be distributed to the players, so players must protect the material warehouse, material factories and materials. Libraries can be moved to any region at any time. • Challenge tasks: The system will generate different tasks every time. The tasks have time limit and no time limit. Players only need to complete the task within the specified time to get rich rewards. If they are dissatisfied with the reward or the task, they can skip it at any time. • Season Pass: There is no time limit for the pass, and the experience value of the pass is upgraded according to the player's playing time. There are a lot of rewards in the pass, including new troops. When the new season is updated, there will be new assets, new units, new maps, etc., and the specific update will notify players through announcements. When purchasing the different versions of the game, the following bonuses are included in the game: • Standard Edition: 1000 gold coins 3000 common parts 1500 rare parts 300 epic parts 10 legendary parts 10000 troops 100000 materials Gift: barbed wire • Deluxe Edition: 5000 gold coins 6000 common parts 3000 rare parts 600 epic parts 15 legendary parts 50000 troops 500000 supplies Gift: barbed wire, machine gun tower. • Ultimate version: 10000 gold coins 12000 common parts 6000 Rare Parts 1200 epic parts 20 legendary parts 100000 troops 1000000 supplies Gift: barbed wire, machine gun tower, material factory.
row.short_description: The three factions fight for the entire area, build your own army and your two opponents to compete for the area and seize the enemy's supplies You can manage the supplies and troops in your own area Use vehicles and military technology to support your troops and obtain victory.

row.name: City Z
row.detailed_description: Fear or desire to survive - which is closer to you? The VR zombie shooter City Z is your way to find out the answer. To get out of the ruins of the City, you will have to walk along the parapet over the abyss, learn to navigate in the dark and shoot hundreds of walking dead. You have no limits other than your own fears. Zombies have no desires other than the desire to kill. Are you ready for such a rehearsal of the apocalypse? Put on your armor, choose a rifle or a shotgun - now you are part of a special forces group. Your mission is to get to the top of the building and stay alive.
row.short_description: Put on your armor, choose a rifle or a shotgun - now you are part of a special forces group. Shoot your way out of a skyscraper full of zombies.

row.name: Margo
row.detailed_description: Margo is a short (30 min), point and click slice-of-life game. It follows the character of Margo, who has just awoken from an accidental nap. The player must complete various click-and-drag tasks to guide Margo through her evening.
row.short_description: Margo just woke up from a nap! Will you help her get back on track?
